lesson_wordStory_2.cn: 路飞和克比为了找到索隆，来到了海军所在的小岛。见到了索隆之后，他们发现索隆被绑在一个十字架上...
lesson_wordStory_2.en: In order to look for Zoro, Luffy and Koby came to the Marine Island. After seeing Zoro, they discovered that Zoro was tied up on a cross...
lesson_wordStory_2.th: ลูฟี่กับโคบี้มาถึงเกาะเล็กๆที่เป็นที่อยู่ของกองทัพเรือเพื่อตามหาโซโร หลังจากได้เห็นโซโร พวกเขาพบว่าโซโรถูกมัดติดกับไม้กางเขน...
lesson_wordStory_2.tw: 魯夫和克比為了找到索隆，來到了海軍所在的小島。見到了索隆之後，他們發現索隆被綁在一個十字架上...
lesson_wordStory_2.vi: Luffy và Koby đã đến đảo Hải Quân tìm Zoro. Sau khi gặp Zoro, họ phát hiện Zoro đang bị trói trên giá...
lesson_wordStory_2.de: Um Zorro zu finden, kamen Ruffy und Coby auf die kleine Insel, auf der sich die Marine befand. Nachdem sie Zorro gesehen hatten, stellten sie fest, dass Zorro an ein Kreuz gebunden war...
lesson_wordStory_2.pt: Luffy e Koby chegam em uma pequena ilha marinha para encontrar Zoro. Depois de conhecer Zoro, encontraram-no amarrado a uma cruz.

lesson_wordStory_4.cn: 在路飞和索隆联手对抗蒙卡的同时，一位神秘少女悄悄潜入了蒙卡的基地，她是谁？她又想做什么？
lesson_wordStory_4.en: While Luffy and Zoro were fighting against Morgan, a mysterious girl secretly snuck into Morgan's base. Who is this girl? What else does she want to do?
lesson_wordStory_4.th: ขณะที่ลูฟี่กับโซโรร่วมมือกันต้านมอร์แกน หญิงสาวลึกลับคนหนึ่งแอบเข้าไปในฐานของมอร์แกน เธอเป็นใคร？คิดจะทำอะไร？
lesson_wordStory_4.tw: 在魯夫和索隆聯手對抗蒙卡的同時，一位神秘少女悄悄潛入了蒙卡的基地，她是誰？她又想做什麼？
lesson_wordStory_4.vi: Khi Luffy và Zoro liên kết đối phó Morgan, một cô gái thần bí đã lẻn vào căn cứ của hắn, cô ấy là ai? Và muốn làm gì?
lesson_wordStory_4.de: Während Ruffy und Zorro sich zusammenschlossen, um gegen Morgan zu kämpfen, schlich sich ein mysteriöses Mädchen in Morgans Basis. Wer ist sie? Was möchte sie machen?
lesson_wordStory_4.pt: Enquanto Luffy e Zoro estavam lutando contra Morgan, uma garota misteriosa secretamente entrou na base de Morgan. Quem é essa garota?  O que mais ela quer fazer?

lesson_wordStory_8.cn: 面对残暴的海军大佐蒙卡的攻击，索隆终于答应加入路飞的海贼团队，于是他们联手打倒了蒙卡，也解救了基地官兵和岛上的居民。
lesson_wordStory_8.en: In the face of the attack of the brutal Marine Colonel, Morgan. Zoro finally agreed to join Luffy's Pirates. Therefore, they joined force to defeat Morgan and liberated the troops at the base and the residence on the island.
lesson_wordStory_8.th: เผชิญหน้ากับการโจมตีอย่างรุนแรงของนาวาเอกมอร์แกนแห่งกองทัพเรือ ในที่สุดโซโรก็ตกลงเข้าร่วมกลุ่มโจรสลัดของลูฟี่ พวกเขาร่วมมือกันล้มมอร์แกน ช่วยเหลือทหารและชาวบ้านบนเกาะได้สำเร็จ
lesson_wordStory_8.tw: 面對殘暴的海軍大佐蒙卡的攻擊，索隆終於答應加入魯夫的海賊團隊，於是他們聯手打倒了蒙卡，也解救了基地官兵和島上的居民。
lesson_wordStory_8.vi: Đối mặt với sự tấn công tàn bạo từ Đại Tá Hải Quân Morgan, Zoro cuối cùng cũng chịu tham gia Băng Hải Tặc của Luffy, họ liên kết lật đổ Morgan, cứu quan binh và cư dân trên đảo.
lesson_wordStory_8.de: Angesichts des Angriffs des brutalen Marine-Obersts Morgan stimmte Zorro schließlich zu, sich Ruffys Piratenteam anzuschließen. Sie besiegten gemeinsam Morgan und retteten die Offiziere und Soldaten der Basis und die Bewohner der Insel.
lesson_wordStory_8.pt: Diante do ataque do brutal Coronel da Marinha, Morgan. Zoro finalmente concordou em se juntar aos Piratas de Luffy. Portanto, eles uniram forças para derrotar Morgan e libertaram as tropas na base e a residência na ilha.

lesson_wordStory_12.cn: 索隆让巴基尝了自己的特制巴基炮弹之后，身受重伤的他还是不支倒地。巴基派出了驯兽师摩奇来对付他们，摩奇指挥狮子来攻击路飞，在驯兽师的攻击下，路飞能获胜吗？
lesson_wordStory_12.en: After Zoro let Buggy try his own special Buggy cannon ball. He still collapsed due to the severe wound he sustained. Buggy sent out Mohji, the animal trainer to deal with them. Mohji commanded lions to attack Luffy. Can Luffy win against the vicious animals?
lesson_wordStory_12.th: หลังจากโซโรถูกระเบิดของบากี้ ร่างกายบาดเจ็บหนักและล้มลงในที่สุด บากี้ส่งนักฝึกสัตว์ป่าโมจี้มารับมือกับพวกเขา โมจี้สั่งสิงโตโจมตีลูฟี่ ภายใต้การโจมตีของนักฝึกสัตว์ป่า ลูฟี่จะเอาชนะได้หรือไม่？
lesson_wordStory_12.tw: 索隆讓巴基嘗了自己的特製巴基炮彈之後，身受重傷的他還是不支倒地。巴基派出了馴獸師摩奇來對付他們，摩奇指揮獅子來攻擊魯夫，在馴獸師的攻擊下，魯夫能獲勝嗎？
lesson_wordStory_12.vi: Zoro sau khi khiến Buggy nếm thử Bom Đặc Chế Buggy của mình, người bị thương và lăn ra đất. Buggy đã cử Tuần Thú Sư Mohji đến đối phó, Mohji chỉ huy sư tử tấn công Luffy, dưới sự tấn công của Tuần Thú Sư, Luffy có thể thắng không ?
lesson_wordStory_12.de: Nachdem Zorro Buggy seine speziellen Bucky-Muscheln probieren gelassen hat, wurde er schwer verletzt und fiel zu Boden. Buggy schickte den Tiertrainer Mohji, um sie zu handeln. Mohji wies den Löwen an, Ruffy anzugreifen. Kann Ruffy unter dem Angriff des Tiertrainers gewinnen?
lesson_wordStory_12.pt: Depois que Zoro deixou Buggy tentar sua própria bala de canhão Buggy especial. Ele ainda desmaiou devido ao ferimento grave que sofreu. Buggy enviou Mohji, o treinador de animais para acabar com eles. Mohji ordenou que os leões atacassem Luffy. Mas será que Luffy pode vencer os animais ferozes?

lesson_wordStory_16.cn: 为了帮助村长保卫村子，路飞和索隆又去找巴基船长。这回是耍剑的杂技卡巴吉出来应战，身受重伤的索隆为了大剑客的名誉，只好负伤出来迎战。
lesson_wordStory_16.en: In order to help the village elder to protect the village, Luffy and Zoro went after Buggy again. This time, it was the sword juggler, Cabaji, who came out to fight. Zoro still wanted to fight for his honor as a great swordsman, he still agreed to fight him despite of his severe wound.
lesson_wordStory_16.th: เพื่อช่วยผู้ใหญ่บ้านปกป้องหมู่บ้าน ลูฟี่กับโซโรไปหากัปตันบากี้อีกครั้ง คราวนี้เป็นนักสู้กายกรรมคาบาจิออกมารับศึก โซโรที่บาดเจ็บหนัก เพื่อชื่อเสียงของนักดาบผู้ยิ่งใหญ่แล้ว จำต้องออกไปต่อสู้ด้วย
lesson_wordStory_16.tw: 為了幫助村長保衛村子，魯夫和索隆又去找巴基船長。這回是耍劍的雜技卡巴吉出來應戰，身受重傷的索隆為了大劍客的名譽，只好負傷出來迎戰。
lesson_wordStory_16.vi: Để giúp trưởng làng bảo vệ làng, Luffy và Zoro đi tìm thuyền trưởng Buggy. Lần này Cabaji ra ứng chiến, Zoro thân mang trọng thương vì danh dự kiếm khách, chỉ đành ra nghênh chiến.
lesson_wordStory_16.de: Um dem Dorfvorsteher bei der Verteidigung des Dorfes zu helfen, gingen Ruffy und Zorro erneut zu Kapitän Buggy. Diesmal kam Cabaji, schwertspielende Akrobatik, heraus, und Zorro, der schwer verletzt war, musste auftreten, um für den Ruf eines großen Schwertkämpfers zu kämpfen.
lesson_wordStory_16.pt: A fim de ajudar o ancião da vila a proteger a vila, Luffy e Zoro foram atrás de Buggy novamente. Desta vez, foi o malabarista de espadas, Cabaji, que saiu para lutar. Zoro ainda queria lutar por sua honra como um grande espadachim, ele ainda concordou em lutar contra ele apesar de seu ferimento grave.

lesson_wordStory_20.cn: 巴基说出了他跟香克斯的一段恩怨，原来他们曾经是同一艘海贼船上的海贼见习生，因为香克斯让巴基不小心吞下了恶魔果实，永远不能游泳而失去了当海贼的资格，因此巴基非常痛恨香克斯。
lesson_wordStory_20.en: Buggy told his story with Shanks. It turned out that they were both pirate trainees on the same pirate ship before. Because Shanks made Buggy swallow the devil fruit, rendering him unable to swim and be a pirate anymore. Therefore, Buggy hates Shanks to guts.
lesson_wordStory_20.th: บากี้บอกเล่าความแค้นช่วงหนึ่งของเขากับแชงคูส ที่แท้พวกเขาเคยอยู่บนเรือโจรสลัดลำเดียวกัน เพราะแชงคูสทำให้บากี้ไม่ทันระวังกินผลไม้ปีศาจเข้าไป ว่ายน้ำไม่ได้ตลอดชีวิตและสูญเสียคุณสมบัติการเป็นโจรสลัดไป ดังนั้นบากี้จึงเกลียดแชงคูสมาก
lesson_wordStory_20.tw: 巴基說出了他跟香克斯的一段恩怨，原來他們曾經是同一艘海賊船上的海賊見習生，因為香克斯讓巴基不小心吞下了惡魔果實，永遠不能游泳而失去了當海賊的資格，因此巴基非常痛恨香克斯。
lesson_wordStory_20.vi: Buggy tiết lộ mối thù giữa anh và Shanks, hóa ra họ là Hải Tặc thực tập sinh trên cùng con tàu Hải Tặc, vì Shanks để Buggy vô tình nuốt Trái Ác Quỷ, không biết bơi nên mất tư cách Hải Tặc, Vì vậy Buggy rất ghét Shanks.
lesson_wordStory_20.de: Buggy sprach über seine Probleme mit Shanks. Sie waren früher beide Schüler auf einem Piratenschiff. Weil Shanks aus Versehen Buggy eine Teufelsfrucht gab, konnte er nie wieder schwimmen, und verlor die Qualität, um ein Pirat zu werden. Deswegen hasst Buggy Shanks sehr.
lesson_wordStory_20.pt: Buggy contou sua história com Shanks. Descobriu-se que ambos eram estagiários piratas no mesmo navio pirata antes. Como Shanks fez Buggy engolir a Akuma no Mi, isso o tornou incapaz de nadar e ser um pirata mais. Portanto, Buggy odeia Shanks profundamente por isso.

lesson_wordStory_24.cn: 为了补充人员和物资，路飞他们来到了一个小岛，结果在岛上遇见了爱吹牛的乌索普，他自称是乌索普海贼团的首领，手下有青椒头、红萝卜头和洋葱头三个部下。
lesson_wordStory_24.en: In order replenish men power and supplies, Luffy and his friends came to an island. In the end, they ran into the bluffing Usopp. He referred to himself as the captain of Usopp Pirates. He has three goons, Piiman, Ninjin, and Tamanegi.
lesson_wordStory_24.th: เพื่อเพิ่มเติมวัตถุดิบและสมาชิก พวกลูฟี่มาถึงเกาะเล็กๆแห่งหนึ่ง ได้พบกับอุซปขี้โกหก เขาเรียกตัวเองว่ากัปตันกลุ่มโจรสลัดอุซป มีลูกน้องสามคนคือนินจิน พีมังและเจ้าหอมใหญ่
lesson_wordStory_24.tw: 為了補充人員和物資，魯夫他們來到了一個小島，結果在島上遇見了愛吹牛的騙人布，他自稱是騙人布海賊團的首領，手下有青椒頭、紅蘿蔔頭和洋蔥頭三個部下。
lesson_wordStory_24.vi: Để bổ sung nhân sự và vật dụng, nhóm Luffy đến một hòn đảo nhỏ, họ gặp Usopp đang khoác lác trên đảo, hắn tự xưng là thủ lĩnh của nhóm hải tặc Usopp, thuộc hạ có ớt xanh, cà rốt và hành.
lesson_wordStory_24.de: Um Personal und Vorräte aufzufüllen, kamen Ruffy und die anderen auf eine kleine Insel. Sie trafen den prahlerischen Lysop auf der Insel. Er behauptete, der Anführer der Lysop-Piratenbande mit grünem Paprika, Karotten und Zwiebeln zu sein.
lesson_wordStory_24.pt: Para reabastecer o poder e os suprimentos dos homens, Luffy e seus amigos chegaram a uma ilha. No final, eles encontraram o blefe Usopp. Ele se referiu a si mesmo como o capitão dos Piratas Usopp. Ele tem três capangas, Piiman, Ninjin e Tamanegi.

lesson_wordStory_28.cn: 乌索普得知克拉巴特尔要跟海贼里应外合攻击村子、杀害可雅的事情，急忙去告诉村民们，结果村民们根本不相信他的话，连可雅也觉得乌索普是怨恨克拉巴特尔，才编出了这个谎话。伤心之余，乌索普决定自己去对付那些海贼，保卫他最喜欢的这个村子。路飞听了乌索普的决定，决定要帮助他对付克洛海贼团。
lesson_wordStory_28.en: Usopp learned that Klahadore was about to attack the village with the pirates and murder Kaya. He rushed to inform the villagers. The villagers wouldn't listen to him. Even Kaya thought that Usopp was making up this lie out of his jealousy against Klahadore. Broken hearted, Usopp still decided to go against those pirates himself, to protect his favorite village. Luffy learned about Usopp's determination, and decided to help him fight against Kuro Pirates.
lesson_wordStory_28.th: อุซปรู้เรื่องที่คุระฮาโดลร่วมมือกับโจรสลัดโจมตีหมู่บ้าน、ฆ่าคายะ ก็รีบไปบอกเหล่าชาวบ้าน ผลคือชาวบ้านไม่เชื่อคำพูดของเขา แม้แต่คายะก็รู้สึกว่าอุซปเคียดแค้นคุระฮาโดล จึงแต่งเรื่องโกหกขึ้นมา อุซปเสียใจมากและตัดสินใจออกไปรับมือโจรสลัดเหล่านั้นเอง เพื่อปกป้องหมู่บ้านที่เขารักแห่งนี้ ลูฟี่ได้ฟังการตัดสินใจของอุซป ก็อยากช่วยเขารับมือกับกลุ่มโจรสลัดคุโระ
lesson_wordStory_28.tw: 騙人布得知克拉巴特爾要跟海賊裡應外合攻擊村子、殺害可雅的事情，急忙去告訴村民們，結果村民們根本不相信他的話，連可雅也覺得騙人布是怨恨克拉巴特爾，才編出了這個謊話。傷心之餘，騙人布決定自己去對付那些海賊，保衛他最喜歡的這個村子。魯夫聽了騙人布的決定，決定要幫助他對付克洛海賊團。
lesson_wordStory_28.vi: Usopp biết chuyện Kurahadoru tiếp tay với Hải Tặc tấn công làng và giết Kaya, vội vàng nói cho dân làng, nhưng không ai tin lời hắn nói, đến Kaya còn cảm thấy Usopp ghét Kurahadoru, mới nói dối như vậy. Usopp quyết định tự mình đối phó với Hải Tặc, bảo vệ ngôi làng yêu thích của mình. Luffy biết được quyết định của Usopp, quyết giúp hắn đối phó với Băng Hải Tặc Kuro.
lesson_wordStory_28.de: Lysop erfuhr, dass Krabatel sich mit den Piraten zusammenschließen würde, um das Dorf anzugreifen und Kaya zu töten. Er beeilte sich, es den Dorfbewohnern zu sagen. Infolgedessen glaubten die Dorfbewohner ihm überhaupt nicht. Selbst Kaya hatte das Gefühl, dass Lysop Krabatel hasste und log. Traurig beschloss Lysop, sich mit den Piraten zu befassen und sein Lieblingsdorf zu verteidigen. Ruffy hörte auf Lysops Entscheidung und beschloss, ihm zu helfen, Käpt'n Black-Piraten zu handeln.
lesson_wordStory_28.pt: Usopp soube que Klahadore estava prestes a atacar a vila com os piratas e matar Kaya. Ele correu para informar os aldeões. Os aldeões não o ouviram. Até Kaya pensou que Usopp estava inventando essa mentira por ciúmes de Klahadore. Com o coração partido, Usopp ainda decidiu ir ele mesmo contra aqueles piratas, para proteger sua vila favorita.  Luffy descobriu sobre a determinação de Usopp e decidiu ajudá-lo a lutar contra os piratas Kuro.

lesson_wordStory_32.cn: 为了在航海旅程上得到均衡的营养，路飞决定要找一位厨师。于是他们来到海上餐厅，路飞却因为弄坏餐厅而被大厨抓了起来。而在餐厅里耀武扬威的海军大尉霍波迪，却被大厨副手山治修理了一顿。
lesson_wordStory_32.en: In order to get a balance diet in the voyage, Luffy decided to look for a chef. Therefore, they came to Floating Restaurant. Luffy was captured by the main chef because of vandalism in the restaurant. The Marine Captain Fullbody made a scene in the restaurant, but then he was taken care of by Sanji, the assistant of the big chef.
lesson_wordStory_32.th: เพื่อโภชนาการที่สมดุลขณะเดินทาง ลูฟี่ตัดสินใจหาพ่อครัว ด้วยเหตุนี้พวกเขาจึงมาถึงภัตตาคารลอยทะเล เพราะลูฟี่ทำร้านพังและถูกพ่อครัวจับตัว ส่วนเรือเอกฟูลบอดี้แห่งกองทัพเรือที่วางอำนาจในร้าน ก็ถูกซันจิรองเชฟสั่งสอน
lesson_wordStory_32.tw: 為了在航海旅程上得到均衡的營養，魯夫決定要找一位廚師。於是他們來到海上餐廳，魯夫卻因為弄壞餐廳而被大廚抓了起來。而在餐廳裡耀武揚威的海軍大尉霍波迪，卻被大廚副手香起士修理了一頓。
lesson_wordStory_32.vi: Để có được dinh dưỡng cân bằng trong chuyến hành trình, Luffy quyết định tìm một đầu bếp, họ đến Nhà Hàng Trên Biển, nhưng Luffy đã bị đầu bếp bắt vì anh ta phá nhà hàng. Và trong nhà hàng, thuyền trưởng Hải Quân tự hào Hobodi đã được sửa chữa bởi bếp phó Sanji.
lesson_wordStory_32.de: Um auf der Segelreise eine ausgewogene Ernährung zu erhalten, entschied sich Ruffy, einen Koch zu finden. Daher kamen sie zum See-Restaurant, aber Ruffy wurde vom Küchenchef erwischt, weil er das Restaurant zerbrochen hatte. Im Restaurant wurde der Marinekapitän Fullbody, der seine Macht zur Schau stellte, vom Stellvertreter des Küchenchefs, Sanji, eine Lehre gegeben.
lesson_wordStory_32.pt: A fim de conseguir uma dieta equilibrada na viagem, Luffy decidiu procurar um chef. Portanto, eles vieram para o Restaurante Flutuante. Luffy foi capturado pelo chef principal por causa do vandalismo no restaurante O Capitão Fuzileiro Fullbody fez uma cena no restaurante, mas depois foi cuidado por Sanji, o ajudante do grande chef.

lesson_wordStory_36.cn: 拥有五十艘海贼舰队的提督克利克出现在海上餐厅，他说他已经快饿死了，要求一些食物和水。所有的人都反对，只有山治拿食物给他吃，吃饱之后他果然翻脸要霸占海上餐厅...
lesson_wordStory_36.en: The Admiral Krieg who possesses fifty pirate fleets have showed up at Floating Restaurant. He demanded some food and water because he was about to die of hunger and thirst. Everyone is against it except for Sanji, who took out some food for him. After finishing the food, he flipped as expected and wanted to take over the whole Floating Restaurant...
lesson_wordStory_36.th: นายพลเรือครีกที่มีกองเรือโจรสลัด50ลำปรากฏตัวที่ภัตตาคารลอยทะเล เขาบอกว่าหิวแทบตาย ต้องการอาหารและน้ำ ทุกคนต่างคัดค้าน มีเพียงซันจิที่เอาอาหารให้เขากิน เมื่อกินอิ่มแล้วเขากลับบอกว่าต้องการยึดครองภัตตาคารลอยทะเล...
lesson_wordStory_36.tw: 擁有五十艘海賊艦隊的提督克利克出現在海上餐廳，他說他已經快餓死了，要求一些食物和水。所有的人都反對，只有香起士拿食物給他吃，吃飽之後他果然翻臉要霸佔海上餐廳...
lesson_wordStory_36.vi: Đô Đốc Krieg người sở hữu 50 thuyền Hải Tặc xuất hiện ở Nhà Hàng Trên Biển, hắn nói hắn sắp chết đói rối, cần mot5 ít thức ăn và nước uống. Tất cả mọi người đều phản đối, chỉ có Sanji lấy thức ăn cho hắn, sau khi ăn xong quả nhiên lật mặt muốn chiếm Nhà Hàng Trên Biển...
lesson_wordStory_36.de: Admiral Creek, der fünfzig Piratenflotten besitzt, erschien im See-Restaurant. Er sagte, er sei verhungert und bat um etwas Essen und Wasser. Alle waren dagegen. Nur Sanji gab ihm Essen. Nachdem er voll war, drehte er sein Gesicht und wollte das See-Restaurant besetzen...
lesson_wordStory_36.pt: O Almirante Krieg, que possui cinquenta frotas piratas, apareceu no Restaurante Flutuante. Ele exigiu comida e água porque estava prestes a morrer de fome e sede. Todos são contra, exceto Sanji, que trouxe comida para ele. Depois de terminar a comida, ele virou como esperado e quis assumir todo o Restaurante Flutuante...

lesson_wordStory_40.cn: 世界第一的剑士鹰眼米霍克出现了，他就是索隆想要击败的对手。索隆为了实现跟古伊娜的约定，坚持要跟他决一胜负，即使被杀也不退让。
lesson_wordStory_40.en: The first swordsman in the world, Mihawk the Hawkeye has shown up. He was the opponent that Zoro wished to defeat. In order to fulfill the promise he made with Kuina, Zoro insisted on dueling with him, even if it meant that he would get killed.
lesson_wordStory_40.th: ตาเหยี่ยวมิฮอว์คนักดาบอันดับหนึ่งของโลกปรากฏตัวแล้ว เขาคือคู่ต่อสู้ที่โซโรต้องการเอาชนะให้ได้ เพื่อทำตามสัญญาที่ให้ไว้กับคุอินะ ยืนหยัดต่อสู้กับเขา แม้ถูกฆ่าตายก็ไม่ถอย
lesson_wordStory_40.tw: 世界第一的劍士鷹眼米霍克出現了，他就是索隆想要擊敗的對手。索隆為了實現跟古伊娜的約定，堅持要跟他決一勝負，即使被殺也不退讓。
lesson_wordStory_40.vi: Đệ nhất kiếm sĩ Mihawk xuất hiện rồi, hắn là đối thủ Zoro muốn đánh bại. Zoro vì thực hiện lời hứa với Kuina, khăng khăng muốn đấu với hắn, thà chết không lui.
lesson_wordStory_40.de: Dracule Mihawk, der beste Schwertkämpfer der Welt, erschien und er war der Gegner, den Zorro besiegen wollte. Um die Vereinbarung mit Guina zu erfüllen, bestand Zorro auf einem Kampf mit ihm, auch wenn er getötet wurde.
lesson_wordStory_40.pt: O primeiro espadachim do mundo, Mihawk o Hawkeye apareceu. Ele era o oponente que Zoro desejava derrotar. Para cumprir a promessa que fez com Kuina, Zoro insistiu em duelar com ele, mesmo que isso significasse que ele seria morto.

lesson_wordStory_44.cn: 发怒的克利克首领用毒气弹来对付所有人，阿金为了保护山治和路飞将面罩丢给他们两个用。面对路飞一再积极的攻击，克利克终于也使出了最大的本领。
lesson_wordStory_44.en: The enraged Krieg unleashed poison gas, hoping to take out everyone. In order to protect Sanji and Luffy, Gin threw out the mask for them. In the face of Luffy's active attack, Krieg has finally brought up his greatest skill.
lesson_wordStory_44.th: ผู้บัญชาการครีกที่โกรธเกรี้ยวใช้ระเบิดแก๊สพิษรับมือกับทุกคน เพื่อปกป้องซันจิกับลูฟี่ กิงมอบหน้ากากให้พวกเขาสองคนใช้ เมื่อเผชิญหน้ากับการโจมตีของลูฟี่อีกครั้ง ในที่สุดครีกก็ใช้ความสามารถสูงสุด
lesson_wordStory_44.tw: 發怒的克利克首領用毒氣彈來對付所有人，阿金為了保護香起士和魯夫將面罩丟給他們兩個用。面對魯夫一再積極的攻擊，克利克終於也使出了最大的本領。
lesson_wordStory_44.vi: Thuyền trưởng Don Krieg tức giận dùng đạn khí độc để đối phó với mọi người, Akin vì để bảo vệ Sanji và Luffy đã ném mặt nạ phòng hộ cho họ. Trước những đòn tấn công dồn dập của Luffy, Krieg cuối cùng cũng đã sử dụng đến Skill đặc biệt của mình.
lesson_wordStory_44.de: Der wütende Anführer Creek benutzt die Giftbomben, um die Feinde aus dem Weg zu räumen. Gin gab zum Schutz Sanji und Ruffy Masken. Als Creek sich immer mehr werdenden Angriffen von Ruffy stellen musste, musste auch er sein ganzes Können benutzen.
lesson_wordStory_44.pt: O enfurecido Krieg lançou gás venenoso, na esperança de matar todos. A fim de proteger Sanji e Luffy, Gin jogou fora a máscara para eles. Diante do ataque ativo de Luffy, Krieg finalmente mostrou sua maior habilidade.

lesson_wordStory_48.cn: 索隆好不容易找到娜美，想不到她居然跟阿龙是一伙的，但是当索隆自己跳海自杀时娜美却忍不住去救他，阿龙的势力逐渐威胁着娜美的故乡可可亚西村，原来娜美之所以为阿龙效命是因为她和阿龙之间协定好，让她用一亿元的代价将村子买下来
lesson_wordStory_48.en: Zoro finally managed to find Nami, but he didn't expect that Nami was actually working with Arlong. But when Zoro was about to jump into the sea to commit suicide, Nami couldn't help but went to save him. The power of Arlong gradually endangered Nami's hometown, Cocoyasi. It turned out that Nami was forced to work for Arlong because of the agreement she made with Arlong before. She has agreed to buy the village from him at the price of one hundred million Belly.
lesson_wordStory_48.th: โซโรหานามิเจออย่างยากลำบาก ไม่นึกว่าเธอจะเป็นพวกเดียวกับอารอน แต่ตอนโซโรกระโดดลงทะเลฆ่าตัวตาย นามิกลับช่วยเหลือเขา อำนาจของอารอนค่อยๆคุกคามหมู่บ้านโคโคยาชิบ้านเกิดของนามิ ที่นามิรับใช้อารอนก็เพราะข้อตกลงระหว่างเธอกับอารอน ให้เธอใช้เงิน100ล้านเบรีซื้อหมู่บ้านกลับไป
lesson_wordStory_48.tw: 索隆好不容易找到娜美，想不到她居然跟惡龍是一夥的，但是當索隆自己跳海自殺時娜美卻忍不住去救他，惡龍的勢力逐漸威脅著娜美的故鄉可哥亞西村，原來娜美之所以為惡龍效命是因為她和惡龍之間協定好，讓她用一億元的代價將村子買下來
lesson_wordStory_48.vi: Zoro tìm được Nami không dễ dàng, không ngờ cô ta chung băng nhóm với Arlong, nhưng khi Zoro nhảy xuống biển tự sát Nami lại không đành lòng nên đi cứu hắn, thế lực của Arlong dần dần đe dọa Làng Cocoyashi quê hương của Nami, hóa ra Nami cứu mạng Arlong là vị hiệp ước giữa cô và Arlong, dùng 100 triệu Beri mua lại ngôi làng
lesson_wordStory_48.de: Zorro fand schließlich Nami, aber sie war mit Arlong in derselben Gruppe. Als Zorro ins Meer sprang und Selbstmord beging, konnte Nami nicht anders, als ihn zu retten. Arlongs Streitkräfte bedrohten allmählich Namis Heimatstadt Cocoyasi. Es stellt sich heraus, dass Nami Arlong gedient hat, weil sie und Arlong vereinbart haben, das Dorf für 100 Millionen Bellys zu kaufen.
lesson_wordStory_48.pt: Zoro finalmente conseguiu encontrar Nami, mas não esperava que Nami estivesse realmente trabalhando com Arlong. Mas quando Zoro estava prestes a pular no mar para cometer suicídio, Nami não pôde deixar de salvá-lo. O poder de Arlong gradualmente colocou em perigo a cidade natal de Nami, Cocoyasi. Descobriu-se que Nami foi forçada a trabalhar para Arlong devido ao acordo que ela fez com Arlong antes. Ela concordou em comprar a aldeia dele pelo preço de cem milhões de Belly.

lesson_wordStory_52.cn: 路飞终于也抵达了阿龙乐园，但也同时听说了娜美杀死乌索普及她是阿龙海贼团一伙的事情，但是路飞仍坚信事实不是如此，果然乌索普的出现证明了这件事，当乌索普将娜美假装杀死他的事实说给大家听时，娜美的姐姐诺琪高出现希望他们能离开这里，原来娜美背负着一段沉重的过去。
lesson_wordStory_52.en: Luffy finally arrived at Arlong Park, but he also learned that Nami murdered Usopp and she was with Arlong Pirates, but Luffy still firmly believed that it was not truth. Indeed, Usopp's appearance proved his judDiamondent. When Usopp told everyone about the fact that Nami feigned to kill him, Nami's sister Nokio appeared and hoped they could leave here. It turned out that Nami was carrying a really dark and heavy history.
lesson_wordStory_52.th: ในที่สุดลูฟี่ก็มาถึงอารอนปาร์ค ขณะเดียวกันก็ได้ยินว่านามิฆ่าอุซปและเธอเป็นพวกเดียวกับกลุ่มโจรสลัดอารอน แต่ลูฟี่ยังเชื่อมั่นว่าเรื่องราวไม่ได้เป็นแบบนี้ การปรากฏตัวของอุซปได้พิสูจน์เรื่องนี้ เมื่ออุซปเล่าเรื่องที่นามิแกล้งฆ่าเขาให้ทุกคนฟัง โนจิโกะพี่สาวของนามิปรากฏตัวหวังว่าพวกเขาจะไปจากที่นี่ได้ ที่แท้นามิก็แบกอดีตอันหนักอึ้งไว้
lesson_wordStory_52.tw: 魯夫終於也抵達了惡龍樂園，但也同時聽說了娜美殺死騙人布及她是惡龍海賊團一夥的事情，但是魯夫仍堅信事實不是如此，果然騙人布的出現證明了這件事，當騙人布將娜美假裝殺死他的事實說給大家聽時，娜美的姐姐諾琪高出現希望他們能離開這裡，原來娜美背負著一段沉重的過去。
lesson_wordStory_52.vi: Luffy cuối cùng cũng đến được khu vui chơi Arlong, nhưng đồng thời nghe được Nami giết Usopp và cô ấy là người của Băng Hải Tặc Arlong, nhưng Luffy vẫn quyết tin sự thật không phải vậy, quả nhiên sự xuất hiện của Usopp đã làm sáng tỏ sự việc, khi Usopp nói với mọi người việc Nami giả vờ giết mình, chị của Nami là Nojiko xuất hiện mà muốn họ rời khỏi, hóa ra Nami đang mang trong người một quá khứ bi thương.
lesson_wordStory_52.de: Ruffy kam schließlich im Arlong-Paradies an, aber hörte gleichzeitig, dass Nami Lysop getötet hatte und sie ein Mitglied von Arlong-Piratenbande war. Aber Ruffy glaubt immer noch fest daran, dass dies nicht die Tatsache ist. Als Lysop allen von der Tatsache erzählte, dass Nami vorgab, ihn zu töten, erschien Namis ältere Schwester Nojiko und hoffte, dass sie hier abreisen könnten. Es stellte sich heraus, dass Nami eine schwere Vergangenheit trug.
lesson_wordStory_52.pt: Luffy finalmente chegou ao Parque Arlong, mas também descobriu que Nami assassinou Usopp e ela estava com os Piratas Arlong, mas Luffy ainda acreditava firmemente que não era verdade. De fato, a aparência de Usopp provou isso. Quando Usopp contou a todos sobre o fato de que Nami fingiu matá-lo, a irmã de Nami, Nokio, apareceu e esperava que eles pudessem sair de lá. Descobriu-se que Nami carregava uma história muito sombria e pesada.

lesson_wordStory_56.cn: 路飞被阿龙丢到海里去生命垂危，索隆和山治在岸上拼命对付章鱼小八和克罗欧比，尤其是索隆身负对抗鹰眼时的重伤几乎快站不住了，然而为了路飞为了他的目标和梦想，他还是以三刀流迎战小八的六刀流。
lesson_wordStory_56.en: When Luffy was thrown into the sea by Arlong. Zoro and Sanji were fighting for their lives against Hatchan and Kuroobi. Especially Zoro, he could barely stand because of the severe wound he sustained from the fight against Hawkeye. However, for Luffy, and his goal and dream, he still charged against Hatchan.
lesson_wordStory_56.th: ลูฟี่ถูกอารอนโยนลงทะเลเกือบไม่รอด โซโรกับซันจิอยู่บนฝั่งรับมือกับปลาหมึกยักษ์ฮาจิและคุโรโอบิ โดยเฉพาะโซโรที่ได้รับบาดเจ็บตอนปะทะกับตาเหยี่ยว ใกล้จะยืนไม่ไหวแล้ว แต่เพื่อลูฟี่เพื่อเป้าหมายและความฝันของเขา จึงใช้3ดาบรับมือกับ6 ดาบของฮาจิ
lesson_wordStory_56.tw: 魯夫被惡龍丟到海裡去生命垂危，索隆和香起士在岸上拼命對付章魚小八和克羅歐比，尤其是索隆身負對抗鷹眼時的重傷幾乎快站不住了，然而為了魯夫為了他的目標和夢想，他還是以三刀流迎戰小八的六刀流。
lesson_wordStory_56.vi: Luffy bị Arlong ném xuống biển và đang hấp hối, trên bờ Zoro và Sanji đang liều mạng đối phó bạch tuột Hachi và Kuroobi, đặc biệt Zoro bị thương gần như không thể chống đỡ nổi MiHawk nữa, nhưng vì Luffy vì mục tiêu và ước mơ của anh ấy, hắn vẫn khua lưỡi đao nghênh chiến Hachi.
lesson_wordStory_56.de: Ruffy wurde von Arlong ins Meer geworfen und war in Lebensgefahr. Zorro und Sanji kämpften verzweifelt gegen Okta und Kuroobi am Ufer. Besonders Zorro war fast nicht aufzuhalten, als er schwer von Dracule Mihawk verletzt wurde. Aber für Ruffy und seine Ziele und Träume benutzte er immer noch Santoryu gegen Oktas Rokutoryu.
lesson_wordStory_56.pt: Quando Luffy foi jogado no mar por Arlong. Zoro e Sanji estavam lutando por suas vidas contra Hatchan e Kuroobi. Especialmente Zoro, ele mal conseguia ficar de pé por causa do ferimento grave que sofreu na luta contra Hawkeye. No entanto, por Luffy, e seu objetivo e sonho, ele ainda atacou Hatchan.

lesson_wordStory_60.cn: 阿龙企图永远控制娜美，还大言不惭地说娜美是他的伙伴,路飞听了他的话又看见娜美沾满血迹的笔，在愤怒的情况下使出了必杀技...
lesson_wordStory_60.en: Arlong attempted to control Nami forever, and he boldly claimed that Nami was his ally. After hearing his speech and seeing Nami's pen covered in blood, Luffy used an ultimate move, enraged.
lesson_wordStory_60.th: อารอนต้องการควบคุมนามิตลอดไป แถมยังบอกว่านามิเป็นพวกพ้องของเขา ลูฟี่ได้ยินและเห็นปากกาเปื้อนเลือดของนามิ ก็โมโหจนใช้ท่าไม้ตายออกมา...
lesson_wordStory_60.tw: 惡龍企圖永遠控制娜美，還大言不慚地說娜美是他的夥伴,魯夫聽了他的話又看見娜美沾滿血跡的筆，在憤怒的情況下使出了必殺技...
lesson_wordStory_60.vi: Arlong âm mưu khống chế Nami, còn dõng dạt nói Nami là đồng hành của hắn, Luffy nghe xong lại thấy cây bút đầy máu của Nami, phẫn nộ phóng chiêu cuối...
lesson_wordStory_60.de: Arlong versucht Nami für immer zu kontrollieren. Er redet offen darüber, dass Nami seine Partnerin wäre. Als Ruffy dies hörte und die mit Blut befleckte Schrift von Nami sah, wurde er wütend und benutzte seine ultimative Fähigkeit...
lesson_wordStory_60.pt: Arlong tentou controlar Nami para sempre, e ele corajosamente afirmou que Nami era sua aliada. Depois de ouvir seu discurso e ver a caneta de Nami coberta de HP, Luffy enfurecidamente usou um habilidade final...

lesson_wordStory_64.cn: 一张传单掀起来全世界的风暴，那就是海军通缉路飞的传单，许许多多路飞过去碰到的朋友，包括红发香克斯都为路飞已踏上海贼之路而欢欣鼓舞，但是有更多他的敌人跃跃欲试准备抓他， 而路飞一行人则还是一心朝伟大的航路前进。
lesson_wordStory_64.en: This is a storm brought by a flyer, which is the wanted flyer for Luffy issued by Marine. Many allies who encountered Luffy, including Shanks, all cheered for Luffy's success in the career of being a pirate. However, many other enemies also started attempting to capture him. However, Luffy and his friends will still set sail along the grand line.
lesson_wordStory_64.th: ใบปลิวแผ่นหนึ่งเริ่มพัดพาไปทั่วโลก นั่นคือใบปลิวกองทัพเรือนำจับลูฟี่ เพื่อนในอดีตของลูฟี่มากมายรวมทั้งแชงคูสผมแดงต่างชื่นชมยินดีที่ลูฟี่ก้าวสู่เส้นทางโจรสลัด แต่ศัตรูมากมายเตรียมพร้อมจับเขา ส่วนพวกลูฟี่ยังคงมุ่งมั่นตรงไปแกรนไลน์
lesson_wordStory_64.tw: 一張傳單掀起來全世界的風暴，那就是海軍通緝魯夫的傳單，許許多多魯夫過去碰到的朋友，包括紅發香克斯都為魯夫已踏上海賊之路而歡欣鼓舞，但是有更多他的敵人躍躍欲試準備抓他， 而魯夫一行人則還是一心朝偉大的航路前進。
lesson_wordStory_64.vi: Một tờ truyền đơn gây bão cả thế giới, đó chính là tờ truy nã Luffy của Hải Quân, rất nhiều người bạn của Luffy, bao gồm Shanks Tóc Đỏ đều vui mừng cổ vũ vì Luffy đã đi theo con đường Hải Tặc, nhưng cũng có nhiều kẻ thù muốn bắt Luffy, còn nhóm người Luffy thì lại một lòng hướng về Đại Hải Trình.
lesson_wordStory_64.de: Ein Flyer löste einen Sturm auf der ganzen Welt aus. Es war ein Steckbrief auf Ruffy von der Marine. Viele Freunde, die Ruffy in der Vergangenheit getroffen hatte, einschließlich der rothaarigen Shanks, freuten sich, dass Ruffy die Straße des Pirates eingeschlagen hatte. Aber es gibt mehr seiner Feinde, die versuchten, ihn zu fangen, und Ruffy und sein Team konzentrieren sich immer noch darauf, auf die große Route zu marschieren.
lesson_wordStory_64.pt: Esta é uma tempestade trazida por um panfleto, que é o panfleto procurado por Luffy emitido pela Marinha. Muitos aliados que encontraram Luffy, incluindo o ruivo Shanks, todos aplaudiram o sucesso de Luffy na carreira de pirata. No entanto, muitos outros inimigos também começaram a tentar capturá-lo. No entanto, Luffy e seus amigos ainda vão navegar ao longo da grande linha.

lesson_wordStory_68.cn: 索隆来到罗格镇之后立刻着手采购新刀，在途中他碰到海军上士，也就是长的很像古伊娜的达斯琪，因为她的缘故索隆找到了一把人称妖刀的三代鬼彻，而本来想坑他的老板发现索隆是真正的剑客时又将他的传家之宝雪走也送给他。
lesson_wordStory_68.en: Zoro immediately went to purchase a new sword after arriving in Loguetown. While he was shopping, he ran into a Petty Officer from Marine, which is Tashigi who looks like Kuina. Thanks to her, Zoro managed to find Sandai Kitetsu, the evil sword according to the legend. The shop owner, who originally wanted to scam him, also gave his heirloom sword, Yubashiri, after learning that Zoro was a true swordsman.
lesson_wordStory_68.th: หลังจากโซโรมาถึงโลคทาวน์ก็ซื้อดาบใหม่ทันที ระหว่างทางเขาพบกับเรือเอกกองทัพเรือ หรือก็คือทาชิงิที่มีหน้าตาเหมือนคุอินะมาก เธอเป็นเหตุให้โซโรค้นหาดาบอาถรรพ์ซังได คิเทซึจนพบ เจ้าของร้านเห็นว่าโซโรคือนักดาบที่แท้จริงจึงยกดาบยูบาชิริให้เขาด้วย
lesson_wordStory_68.tw: 索隆來到羅格鎮之後立刻著手採購新刀，在途中他碰到海軍上士，也就是長的很像古伊娜的達絲琪，因為她的緣故索隆找到了一把人稱妖刀的三代鬼徹，而本來想坑他的老闆發現索隆是真正的劍客時又將他的傳家之寶雪走也送給他。
lesson_wordStory_68.vi: Sau khui Zoro đến Logue Town lập tức mua một thanh đao, trên đường đi hắn gặp Trung Sĩ Hải Quân, cũng là Tashigi trông giống như Kuina, vì cô ấy mà Zoro đã tìm được một thanh Sandai Kitetsu, hơn nữa khi ông chủ phát hiện Zoro là một kiếm khách thật sự đã tặng cả báu vật gia truyền.
lesson_wordStory_68.de: Nachdem Zorro nach Logue-Stadt gekommen war, begann er sofort, ein neues Messer zu kaufen. Unterwegs traf er den Marine-Sergeant Daschi, die Guina ähnelt. Mit ihrer Hilfe fand Zorro Sandai Kitetsu, das Dämonenschwert genannt wurde. Der Chef, der ihn ausgraben wollte, fand heraus, dass Zorro ein echter Schwertkämpfer war, gab er ihm auch seinen Erbstückschatz Yubashiri.
lesson_wordStory_68.pt: Zoro imediatamente foi comprar uma nova espada depois de chegar em Loguetown. Enquanto fazia compras, ele encontrou um suboficial da Marinha, que é Tashigi, que se parece com Kuina. Graças a ela, Zoro conseguiu encontrar Sandai Kitetsu, a espada maligna segundo a lenda. O dono da loja, que originalmente queria enganá-lo, também deu sua espada de herança, Yubashiri, depois de saber que Zoro era um verdadeiro espadachim.

lesson_wordStory_72.cn: 路飞终于如愿爬上了死刑台，但就在此时吃了恶魔果实的亚尔丽塔和小丑巴基出现了，路飞被困在死刑台上就要被巴基处死了，而斯摩格上校也在一旁准备一网打尽，就在刀落下来那一瞬间突然降下闪电......
lesson_wordStory_72.en: Luffy finally managed to reach the execution site. But at this moment, Alvida and Buggy, who just had the devil fruits showed up. Luffy was trapped on the execution site and was about to be Slayd by Buggy. Meanwhile, Colonel Smoker is also ready to catch all of them, while lurking to the side. At the moment when the sword fell off, a lightning bolt suddenly struck down...
lesson_wordStory_72.th: สุดท้ายลูฟี่ก็ยอมปีนขึ้นลานประหาร แต่อารูบีดาที่กินผลไม้ปีศาจเข้าไปกับตัวตลกบากี้ปรากฏตัวขึ้น ลูฟี่บนลานประหารกำลังจะถูกบากี้ประหารแล้ว ส่วนนาวาเอกสโมคเกอร์ก็อยู่ข้างๆพร้อมจัดการทันที พริบตาที่ดาบกำลังฟันลงจู่ๆฟ้าก็ผ่าลงมา......
lesson_wordStory_72.tw: 魯夫終於如願爬上了死刑台，但就在此時吃了惡魔果實的亞爾麗塔和小丑巴基出現了，魯夫被困在死刑臺上就要被巴基處死了，而史莫卡上校也在一旁準備一網打盡，就在刀落下來那一瞬間突然降下閃電......
lesson_wordStory_72.vi: Luffy cuối cùng cũng đến bục tử hình, nhưng lúc này Alvida và chú hề Buggy đã ăn Trái Ác Quỷ lại xuất hiện, Luffy bị trói trên bục tử hình sắp bị Buggy xử tử, Đại Tá Smoker đứng một bên cũng đã sẵn sàng, chỉ là khi đao vung xuống lại có tia chớp xuất hiện...
lesson_wordStory_72.de: Ruffy kletterte schließlich auf die Plattform der Todesstrafe, aber in diesem Moment erschienen Alvida und Buggy, der die Teufelsfrucht gegessen hatte. Ruffy war auf der Plattform der Todesstrafe gefangen und sollte von Buggy hingerichtet werden, und Smoker war auch bereit, alles zu fangen. Aber der Blitz fiel plötzlich, sobald das Messer fiel...
lesson_wordStory_72.pt: Luffy finalmente conseguiu chegar ao local da execução. Mas neste momento, Alvida e Clown Buggy, que acabaram de comer as Akuma no Mi, apareceram. Luffy estava preso no local da execução e estava prestes a ser morto por Buggy. Enquanto isso, o Coronel Smoker também está pronto para pegar todos eles, enquanto espreita ao lado. No momento em que a espada caiu, um raio de repente caiu...

lesson_wordStory_76.cn: 路飞一行人希望趁暴风雨扩大前离开罗格镇却受到重重阻碍，路飞与斯摩格交手被完全压制，就在千钧一发的时刻，一个神秘人出现解救了他。最终，路飞他们在狂风暴雨中继续向伟大的航路出发
lesson_wordStory_76.en: Luffy and his friends hoped to leave Loguetown before the storm grew heavier, but they were blocked. Luffy tried fighting against Smoker but was completely suppressed. At this critical moment, a mysterious person showed up and saved him. In the end, Luffy and his friends continue to sail across the grand line in the storm
lesson_wordStory_76.th: พวกลูฟี่ฉวยโอกาสตอนฝนตกหนักออกจากโลคทาวน์แต่กลับถูกขัดขวาง ลูฟี่พ่ายแพ้สโมคเกอร์ราบคาบ ในยามวิกฤตนี้คนลึกลับปรากฏตัวช่วยเขาไว้ สุดท้ายพวกลูฟี่ก็ออกเดินทางสู่แกรนไลน์ท่ามกลางพายุฝนกระหน่ำต่อไป
lesson_wordStory_76.tw: 魯夫一行人希望趁暴風雨擴大前離開羅格鎮卻受到重重阻礙，魯夫與史莫卡交手被完全壓制，就在千鈞一髮的時刻，一個神秘人出現解救了他。最終，魯夫他們在狂風暴雨中繼續向偉大的航路出發
lesson_wordStory_76.vi: Nhóm người Luffy hy vọng có thể rời khỏi Thị trấn Logue trước khi cơn bão lớn hơn, nhưng bị chướng ngại vật cản trở, Luffy và Smoker hoàn toàn bị trấn áp. Đúng lúc đó, một người bí ẩn xuất hiện và giải cứu cậu. Tiếp tục  tiến về phía trước trong cơn bão.
lesson_wordStory_76.de: Ruffy und sein Team hoffen, Logue-Stadt zu verlassen, bevor sich der Sturm ausdehnt, werden jedoch behindert. Ruffy wurde von Smoker vollständig unterdrückt. Im kritischen Moment erschien eine mysteriöse Person und rettete ihn. Am Ende machten sich Ruffy und die anderen weiter auf den Weg zur Grandlinie im Sturm.
lesson_wordStory_76.pt: Luffy e seus amigos esperavam deixar Loguetown antes que a tempestade aumentasse, mas eles foram bloqueados. Luffy tentou lutar contra Smoker, mas foi completamente suprimido. Nesse momento crítico, uma pessoa misteriosa apareceu e o salvou.  No final, Luffy e seus amigos continuam a navegar pela grande linha na tempestade

lesson_wordStory_80.cn: 路飞等人历经艰险终于登上了红土大陆，朝伟大的航路而下。然而眼前突然出现一头大鲸鱼，黄金梅丽号毫无招架之力的被吞进鲸鱼肚子里，想不到里头的景象竟是如此奇特，还在里面遇到了一个奇怪的老头
lesson_wordStory_80.en: Luffy and his friends finally made it to the Red Line, while heading towards Grand Line. However, a huge whale suddenly appeared, Going Merry couldn't defend against it and was swallowed by the whale. To their surprises, there was actually quite a different sight inside the whale, and a strange old man was living in there.
lesson_wordStory_80.th: พวกลูฟี่ผ่านความยากลำบากขึ้นฝั่งที่เรดไลน์ ตรงไปยังแกรนไลน์ ทันใดนั้นปลาวาฬยักษ์ตัวหนึ่งก็โผล่มา เรือโกอิ้ง แมรี่ไม่อาจหลบพ้นถูกกลืนเข้าไปในท้องปลาวาฬทันที ไม่นึกว่าสภาพภายในจะมหัศจรรย์แบบนี้ แถมยังเจอกับผู้เฒ่าประหลาดคนหนึ่ง
lesson_wordStory_80.tw: 魯夫等人歷經艱險終於登上了紅土大陸，朝偉大的航路而下。然而眼前突然出現一頭大鯨魚，黃金梅麗號毫無招架之力的被吞進鯨魚肚子裡，想不到裡頭的景象竟是如此奇特，還在裡面遇到了一個奇怪的老頭
lesson_wordStory_80.vi: Trải qua bao gian khổ cuối cùng bọn người Luffy đã đến Red Line, và đi theo con đường lớn ấy. Bỗng nhiên trước mặt xuất hiện con cá voi lớn, Going Merry không thể chống lại và bị nuốt chửng vào bụng cá, thật không ngờ cảnh tượng bên trong đó lại kỳ lạ vậy, và còn gặp một ông lão kỳ lạ trong đó.
lesson_wordStory_80.de: Ruffy und die anderen bestiegen nach Schwierigkeiten endlich den Kontinent der Roten Erde und gingen die Grandlinie. Plötzlich tauchte jedoch ein großer Wal vor ihr auf, und der Goldene Meri wurde in den Bauch des Wals geschluckt, ohne sich verteidigen zu können. Unerwartet war die Szene im Inneren so eigenartig, und ein seltsamer alter Mann wurde auch im Inneren angetroffen.
lesson_wordStory_80.pt: Luffy e seus amigos finalmente chegaram à Red Line, enquanto se dirigiam para a Grande Navegação.  No entanto, uma enorme baleia apareceu de repente, Going Merry não conseguiu se defender contra ela e foi engolida pela baleia. Para sua surpresa, havia realmente uma visão bem diferente dentro da baleia, e um velho estranho morava lá.

lesson_wordStory_84.cn: 告别了拉布和可乐克斯，路飞等人终于要踏上伟大的航路。首先第一站是Miss.星期三和Mr.9指定的威士忌山峰，抵达目的地后海贼传迎来了全岛居民的热情招待，但是在这欢庆气氛的背后，隐藏着一个巨大的阴谋....
lesson_wordStory_84.en: After biding their farewell to Laboon and Crocus, Luffy and his friends finally set foot towards the grand line. So the first stop is the Whisky Peak assigned by Miss. Wednesday and Mr. 9. After reaching the destination, the pirates were greeted with warm welcome of the residence on the island. But behind this happy atmosphere, an even greater scheme is going on...
lesson_wordStory_84.th: หลังจากอำลาลาบูนกับคร็อกคัสแล้ว พวกลูฟี่ก็ออกเรือเดินทางไปแกรนไลน์ จุดแรกคือวิสกี้พีคที่มีมิสเวนส์เดย์กับมิสเตอร์ไนน์ดูแล เมื่อไปถึงจุดหมาย ชาวบ้านทั้งเกาะออกมาต้อนรับโจรสลัดอย่างอบอุ่น แต่เบื้องหลังบรรยากาศรื่นเริงนี้ ซ่อนแผนการใหญ่ไว้....
lesson_wordStory_84.tw: 告別了拉布和可樂克斯，魯夫等人終於要踏上偉大的航路。首先第一站是Miss.星期三和Mr.9指定的威士卡山峰，抵達目的地後海賊傳迎來了全島居民的熱情招待，但是在這歡慶氣氛的背後，隱藏著一個巨大的陰謀....
lesson_wordStory_84.vi: Chia tay Rabun và Crocus, nhóm người Luffy cuối cùng cũng bắt đầu Đại Hải Trình. Điểm dừng đầu tiên là Núi Whisky mà Miss.4 và Mr.9 chỉ định, sau khi đến nơi, cư dân nơi này chòn đón rất nồng hậu, nhưng phía sau ẩn chứa một âm mưu to lớn…
lesson_wordStory_84.de: Nachdem die Ruffy sich mit den anderen von La Boum und Crocus verabschiedeten, machten sie sich wieder auf den Weg zur Grand Line. Als erstes ist man beim Whiskey Peak, der von Miss Wednesday und Mr.9 bestimmt wurde. Nachdem die Piraten ankommen, wurden sie von den Bewohnern der Insel mit offenen Armen empfangen. Hinter dieser Freude versteckt sich aber eine große Verschwörung...
lesson_wordStory_84.pt: Depois de se despedir de Laboon e Crocus, Luffy e seus amigos finalmente puseram os pés em direção à Grande Navegação. Assim, a primeira parada é o Whiskey Peak designado pela Srta. Quarta-feira e Sr. 9. Após chegarem ao destino, os piratas foram recebidos com calorosas boas-vindas da residência na ilha. Mas por trás dessa atmosfera feliz, um esquema ainda maior está acontecendo...

lesson_wordStory_88.cn: 巴洛克工作社高级特务的出现，揭发了Miss.星期三原来是阿拉巴斯坦的公主薇薇，而卷毛伯是暗中保护她的护卫队长伊卡莱姆。在Mr.5和Miss.情人节的攻势下，伊卡莱姆请求索隆能保护公主平安返国。就在索隆与高级特务交手之时路飞突然气冲冲的跑来找索隆决斗....
lesson_wordStory_88.en: The appearance of the advanced agent of Baroque Workshop compromised the fact that Miss Wednesday was actually Princess Vivi of Alabasta. And Mr. 8 was actually her loyal bodyguard captain, Igaram. Under the attack of Mr. 5 and Miss Valentine, Igaram requested Zoro to protect and escort the princess back to the kingdom in one piece. While Zoro was fighting against the High Agent, the angry Luffy suddenly came for Zoro for a duel...
lesson_wordStory_88.th: การปรากฏตัวของสมาชิกระดับสูงกลุ่มบาร็อกเวิร์ค เปิดโปงมิสเวนส์เดย์ที่แท้คือเจ้าหญิงวีวี่แห่งอลาบัสต้า ส่วนอีการัมหัวหน้าองครักษ์ซ่อนปืนในม้วนผมคอยปกป้องเธอ จากการโจมตีของมิสเตอร์ไฟร์และมิสวาเลนไทน์ อีการัมขอร้องโซโรคุ้มครองเจ้าหญิงกลับอาณาจักร ขณะที่โซโรปะทะกับสมาชิกระดับสูง จู่ๆลูฟี่ก็ตรงมาสู้กับโซโรด้วยความโกรธ....
lesson_wordStory_88.tw: 巴羅克工作社高級特務的出現，揭發了Miss.星期三原來是阿拉巴斯坦的公主薇薇，而卷毛伯是暗中保護她的護衛隊長伊卡萊姆。在Mr.5和Miss 情人節的攻勢下，伊卡萊姆請求索隆能保護公主平安返國。就在索隆與高級特務交手之時魯夫突然氣衝衝的跑來找索隆決鬥....
lesson_wordStory_88.vi: Sự xuất hiện của đặc vụ cao cấp của Baroque Work, tố giác Miss.4 hóa ra là công chúa Vivi của Alabasta, Igaram tóc xoăn là đội trưởng đội cận vệ âm thầm bảo vệ cô. Dưới sự tấn công của Mr.5 và Miss.Valentine, Igaram cầu xin Zoro bảo vệ công chúa về nước. Ngay lúc Zoro đang giao đấu cùng đặc vụ cấp cao thì Luffy đột nhiên xông đến tìm Zoro quyết đấu...
lesson_wordStory_88.de: Die fortgeschrittenen Agenten der Baroque Firma sind erschienen. Es war Vivi, die Prinzessin von Alabasta, die Miss Wednesday verriet. Und es war Igaram, Hauptmann der Wache, der sie heimlich beschüzte Als man von Mr.5 und Miss Valentine angegriffen wurde, bittet Igaram Zorro, die Prinzessin sicher wieder zurück ins Land zu bringen. Gerade als Zorro sich mit den Agenten austauschte, kam Ruffy plötzlich wütend, um mit Zorro zu kämpfen...
lesson_wordStory_88.pt: A aparição do agente avançado da Oficina de Baroque comprometia o fato de que Srta. Quarta-feira era na verdade a princesa Vivi de Alabasta. E o Sr. 8 era na verdade seu leal capitão guarda-costas, Igaram.  Sob o ataque de Sr. 5 e Srta. Valentine, Igaram pediu a Zoro para proteger e escoltar a princesa de volta ao reino inteira.  Enquanto Zoro estava lutando contra o Agente Superior, o furioso Luffy de repente veio atrás de Zoro para um duelo...

lesson_wordStory_92.cn: 薇薇公主不小心将巴洛克工作社老板的秘密告诉了路飞一行人，让路飞他们竟然也成了追杀的目标。为了继承护卫队长伊卡莱姆的意志，在上千杀手的威胁下，路飞等人展开了朝阿拉巴斯坦王国的旅程。
lesson_wordStory_92.en: Princess Vivi accidentally told the secret of the boss of Baroque Workshop to Luffy, rendering Luffy and his friends to be the target of the hit as well. Carrying on the will of Igaram, the bodyguard captain, Luffy and his friends set sail towards Kingdom of Alabasta despite of the threat of many hitmen.
lesson_wordStory_92.th: เจ้าหญิงวีวี่ไม่ทันระวังบอกความลับของประธานบาร็อกเวิร์คกับพวกลูฟี่ ทำให้พวกลูฟี่พวกเขากลายเป็นเป้าหมายไล่ล่าด้วย เพื่อสานต่อความตั้งใจของหัวหน้าอีการัม ภายใต้การคุกคามของนักฆ่านับพัน พวกลูฟี่เริ่มออกเดินทางไปยังอาณาจักรอลาบัสต้า
lesson_wordStory_92.tw: 薇薇公主不小心將巴羅克工作社老闆的秘密告訴了魯夫一行人，讓魯夫他們竟然也成了追殺的目標。為了繼承護衛隊長伊卡萊姆的意志，在上千殺手的威脅下，魯夫等人展開了朝阿拉巴斯坦王國的旅程。
lesson_wordStory_92.vi: Công chúa Vivi vô tình nói với nhóm người Luffy bí mật về ông chủ của Baroque Work, để Nhóm người Luffy trở thành mục tiêu của cuộc săn lùng. Nhằm kế thừa ý chí của đội trưởng đội cận vệ Igaram, trước sự đe dọa của hàng ngàn kẻ giết người, Nhóm người Luffy bắt đầu cuộc hành trình đến vương quốc Alabasta.
lesson_wordStory_92.de: Prinzessin Vivi erzählte Ruffy und den anderen versehentlich das Geheimnis des Chefs von Baroque-Werkstatt und machte Ruffy und die anderen zu den Zielen der Jagd. Um den Willen des Hauptmanns der Wache Igaram zu erben, begaben sich Ruffy und andere unter der Drohung von Tausenden von Mördern auf eine Reise in das Königreich Alabasta.
lesson_wordStory_92.pt: A princesa Vivi acidentalmente contou o segredo do chefe da Oficina de Baroque para Luffy, tornando Luffy e seus amigos o alvo do golpe também. Seguindo a vontade de Igaram, o capitão dos guarda-costas, Luffy e seus amigos embarcaram em direção ao Reino de Alabasta, apesar da ameaça de muitos assassinos.

lesson_wordStory_96.cn: 路飞一行人终于抵达了小花园，然而跟它的名字不相称。这座岛既不小，而且也不像花园一样美丽，到处都是奇怪的生物，充满着诡异的气氛。天不怕地不怕的路飞决定到岛上冒险，山治和索隆也深入岛内狩猎，想不到出现在他们眼前的竟是史前时代的恐龙，原来这是一座时光停留在远古时代的太古之岛。
lesson_wordStory_96.en: Luffy and his friends finally arrived in Little Garden. However, the place doesn't match its name at all. This island is not a small place, but it's not as beautiful as a garden. There are strange creatures running around on the island, giving off a very weird vibe. Luffy decided to get on the island to explore. Sanji and Zoro also wanted to venture deep into the island to hunt. To their surprises, they ran into the dinosaurs from the ancient era. It turned out this was an ancient island whose time has remained in the past.
lesson_wordStory_96.th: ในที่สุดพวกลูฟี่ก็มาถึงลิตเติ้ลการ์เด้น แต่ทว่าไม่เหมือนกับชื่อของมัน เกาะนี้ไม่เล็กและไม่ได้สวยงามเหมือนสวนดอกไม้ มีสัตว์แปลกๆทั่วทุกที่ เต็มไปด้วยบรรยากาศประหลาด ลูฟี่ที่ไม่กลัวอะไรตัดสินใจผจญภัยบนเกาะ ซันจิกับโซโรไปล่าสัตว์บนเกาะด้วย ไม่นึกว่าสิ่งที่ปรากฏตรงหน้าพวกเขาคือไดโนเสาร์ ที่แท้นี่เป็นเกาะยุคโบราณ
lesson_wordStory_96.tw: 魯夫一行人終於抵達了小花園，然而跟它的名字不相稱。這座島既不小，而且也不像花園一樣美麗，到處都是奇怪的生物，充滿著詭異的氣氛。天不怕地不怕的魯夫決定到島上冒險，香起士和索隆也深入島內狩獵，想不到出現在他們眼前的竟是史前時代的恐龍，原來這是一座時光停留在遠古時代的太古之島。
lesson_wordStory_96.vi: Nhóm người Luffy cuối cùng cũng đến khu vườn hoa, nhưng không đúng với tên gọi của nó. Hòn đảo này tuy không nhỏ, cũng không đẹp như vườn hoa, khắp nơi đều là những sinh vật kỳ lạ. Luffy quyết định lên đảo thám hiểm, Sanji và Zoro cũng đi sâu vào đảo săn bắn. Bất ngờ những con khủng long thời tiền sử xuất hiện trước mặt họ, hóa ra đây là hòn đảo nơi thời gian ngưng đọng ở thời cổ đại.
lesson_wordStory_96.de: Ruffy und seine Gruppe kamen schließlich in dem kleinen Garten an, aber er passte nicht zu seinem Namen. Die Insel ist weder klein noch so schön wie ein Garten. Überall gibt es seltsame Kreaturen und eine seltsame Atmosphäre. Ruffy hatte keine Angst und beschloss, ein Abenteuer auf der Insel zu unternehmen. Sanji und Zorro gingen auch tief in die Insel hinein, um zu jagen. Unerwartet waren die Dinosaurier, die vor ihnen auftauchten. Es stellte sich heraus, dass dies eine alte Insel ist, auf der die Zeit in der Antike bleibt.
lesson_wordStory_96.pt: Luffy e seus amigos finalmente chegaram aao Pequeno Parque. No entanto, o lugar não corresponde ao seu nome.  Esta ilha não é um lugar pequeno, mas não é tão bonita quanto um jardim. Existem criaturas estranhas correndo pela ilha, emitindo uma vibração muito estranha.  Luffy decidiu entrar na ilha para explorar. Sanji e Zoro também queriam se aventurar nas profundezas da ilha para caçar. Para sua surpresa, eles encontraram os dinossauros da era antiga. Descobriu-se que esta era uma ilha antiga cujo tempo permaneceu no passado.

lesson_wordStory_100.cn: 面对巴洛克工作社高级特务的诡计，被石头压住的路飞感到十分愤怒但却无能为力，看着他们抓走薇薇以及Mr.3可怕的蜡烛能力让布洛基和索隆等人，一行人陷入即将被变成蜡制人偶的危机......
lesson_wordStory_100.en: Luffy was angered by the device of the high-ranking agents in the Baroque Works and the fact that they take away Vivi. However, the scary candle ability of Mr.3 has reduced them into the crisis of wax works.
lesson_wordStory_100.th: เผชิญกับแผนการของสมาชิกบาร็อกเวิร์ค ลูฟี่ที่ถูกก้อนหินทับรู้สึกโกรธมากแต่ก็ทำอะไรไม่ได้ มองดูพวกเขาจับวีวี่และมิสเตอร์ทรีที่มีความสามารถสร้างเทียนทำให้โบรกี้กับพวกโซโรตกอยู่ในสภาพกำลังจะกลายเป็นมนุษย์เทียน......
lesson_wordStory_100.tw: 面對巴羅克工作社高級特務的詭計，被石頭壓住的魯夫感到十分憤怒但卻無能為力，看著他們抓走薇薇以及Mr.3可怕的蠟燭能力讓布洛基和索隆等人，一行人陷入即將被變成蠟制人偶的危機......
lesson_wordStory_100.vi: Đối phó với những mánh khóe của các đặc vụ cấp cao Baroque Work, Luffy bị đá đè cảm thấy rất tức giận nhưng không làm gì được, nhìn thấy bắt Vivi và Mr.3 đi, năng lực nến đáng sợ khiến bọn người Brogy và Zoro có nguy cơ biến thành búp bê bằng nến......
lesson_wordStory_100.de: Angesichts der Tricks der leitenden Agenten der Baroque-Firma war Ruffy, der vom Stein gedrückt wurde, sehr wütend, konnte aber nichts tun. Er sah zu, wie sie Vivi wegnahmen.  Und Mr.3s schreckliche Kerzenfähigkeit brachte Brogy, Zorro und anderen die Gefahr, in Wachspuppen verwandelt zu werden...
lesson_wordStory_100.pt: Luffy ficou irritado com o dispositivo dos agentes de alto escalão da Oficina de Baroque e com o fato de terem levado Vivi. No entanto, Sr. 3 fez Brogy, Zoro e outros entrarem em uma crise de serem transformados em bonecos de cera...

lesson_wordStory_104.cn: 因为被Miss.黄金周调配颜色的魔法控制而身不由己的路飞只能眼睁睁看着索隆他们变成蜡烛人偶，所幸乌索普即时想到妙计，用火去融化所有的蜡，解救下了索隆、娜美、薇薇还有布洛基，草帽团一行人重整旗鼓开始了反击。
lesson_wordStory_104.en: Being controlled by the Color Trap magic from Miss Goldenweek, Luffy was forced to witness Zoro and the others being turned into candle dolls. Luckily, Usopp managed to come up with an idea, which is to melt down all of the wax with fire. He managed to save Zoro, Nami, Vivi, and Brogy. It's now the time for Strawhat Pirates to encounter attack.
lesson_wordStory_104.th: เพราะถูกมิส โกลเด้นวีคระบายสีควบคุมจนร่างกายไม่เป็นอิสระ ลูฟี่ได้แต่มองดูพวกโซโรกลายเป็นมนุษย์เทียน โชคดีที่อุซปคิดแผนได้ทันเวลา ใช้ไฟละลายเทียนทั้งหมด ช่วยโซโร、นามิ、วีวี่และโบรกี้ไว้ได้ พวกกลุ่มหมวกฟางตั้งหลักเริ่มโต้กลับ
lesson_wordStory_104.tw: 因為被Miss.黃金周調配顏色的魔法控制而身不由己的魯夫只能眼睜睜看著索隆他們變成蠟燭人偶，所幸騙人布即時想到妙計，用火去融化所有的蠟，解救下了索隆、娜美、薇薇還有布洛基，草帽團一行人重整旗鼓開始了反擊。
lesson_wordStory_104.vi: Luffy vì bị Miss.Golden Week dùng ma pháp khống chế màu sắc nên chỉ có thể trơ mắt nhìn Zoro biến thành rối người nến, may mà Usopp nghĩ ra diệu kế, dùng lửa nung chảy sáp, cứu thoát Zoro, Nami, Vivi còn có Brogy, Băng Mũ Rơm tập hợp lại và bắt đầu phản công.
lesson_wordStory_104.de: Ruffy, der unfreiwillig von der Magie der Farben von Miss Goldenweek kontrolliert wurde, konnte nur zusehen, wie Zorro und die anderen sich in Kerzenpuppen verwandelten. Glücklicherweise dachte Lysop an einen Trick und benutzte Feuer, um das gesamte Wachs zu schmelzen und Zorro, Nami, Vivi und Brogy zu retten. Die Stohhutbande begann einen Gegenangriff.
lesson_wordStory_104.pt: Sendo controlado pela magia da Armadilha Colorida da Srta. Semana Dourada, Luffy foi forçado a testemunhar Zoro e os outros sendo transformados em bonecos de vela. Por sorte, Usopp teve uma ideia, que é derreter toda a cera com fogo. Ele conseguiu salvar Zoro, Nami, Vivi e Brogy. Agora é a hora dos Piratas Chapéus de Palha enfrentarem o contra-ataque.

lesson_wordStory_108.cn: 路飞他们决定先带着病危的娜美找医生，没想到却遇上了瓦尔波的白铁王号。瓦尔波是吞吞果实能力者，传闻可以吞吃所有的东西，见到路飞一行人，二话不说就要将他们的船吃了。
lesson_wordStory_108.en: Luffy and his friends decided to look for a doctor for the sick Nami. But they accidentally ran into Wapol's Bliking. Wapol is the user of Munch-Munch Fruit. Some say that he can devour anything. When he encountered Luffy, he went ahead and devoured their boat without a word.
lesson_wordStory_108.th: พวกลูฟี่ตัดสินใจพานามิที่ป่วยหนักไปหาหมอก่อน ไม่นึกว่ากลับเจอเรือบลีคิงของวาโปลู วาโปลูเป็นผู้มีความสามารถผลบาคุบาคุ ว่ากันว่าสามารถกินได้ทุกสิ่ง พอเห็นพวกลูฟี่ก็กินเรือของพวกเขาทันที
lesson_wordStory_108.tw: 魯夫他們決定先帶著病危的娜美找醫生，沒想到卻遇上了瓦波爾的白鐵王號。瓦波爾是吞吞果實能力者，傳聞可以吞吃所有的東西，見到魯夫一行人，二話不說就要將他們的船吃了。
lesson_wordStory_108.vi: Nhóm người Luffy quyết định đưa Nami đi tìm bác sĩ, không ngờ gặp phải đội quân của Wapol. Wapol là người sở hữu năng lực Trái Munch Munch, nghe nói có thể nuốt tất cả mọi thứ, thấy nhóm người Luffy, không nói 2 lời hắn muốn ăn cả tàu của họ.
lesson_wordStory_108.de: Ruffy und die anderen beschlossen, die schwerkranke Nami zuerst zum Arzt zu bringen, aber sie hatten nicht erwartet, Wapols Weißstahlkönig zu begegnen. Wapol ist eine Person mit der Fähigkeit von Verschlingen-Frucht. Es wird gemunkelt, dass er alles schlucken kann. Wenn er Ruffy und seine Gruppe sieht, wird er ihr Boot essen, ohne ein Wort zu sagen.
lesson_wordStory_108.pt: Luffy e seus amigos resolveram procurar um médico para a doente Nami. Mas eles acidentalmente encontraram Baku Baku de Wapol. Wapol é o usuário da Fruta Baku Baku. Alguns dizem que ele pode devorar qualquer coisa. Quando ele encontrou Luffy, ele foi em frente e devorou o barco deles sem dizer uma palavra.

lesson_wordStory_112.cn: 路飞终于带着娜美及山治找到了库蕾哈医生，在库蕾哈医生高明的医术下，不但治好了路飞跟山治的伤，也医好了娜美的重病。不过让他们惊讶的是一只叫做乔巴的驯鹿，因为它不但会说人话，用两脚站立，还会突然变得很大。
lesson_wordStory_112.en: Luffy took Nami and Sanji to find Doctor Kureha. With the advanced medical technique of Dr. Kureha, they not only cured Luffy, but also the Sanji. Nami also recovered from her severe sickness. However, what surprised them most was a reindeer called Chopper. Because he could not only speak, but also able to stand with both of his feet. And he could turn into a huge monster.
lesson_wordStory_112.th: ในที่สุดลูฟี่ก็พานามิกับซันจิมาหาด๊อกเตอร์คุเรฮะ ด้วยวิชาแพทย์ที่ยอดเยี่ยมของด๊อกเตอร์คุเรฮะ ไม่เพียงรักษาอาการบาดเจ็บของลูฟี่กับซันจิได้ ยังรักษานามิที่ป่วยหนักจนหายดี แต่สิ่งที่ทำให้พวกเขาแปลกใจคือกวางเรนเดียร์ที่ชื่อว่าช็อปเปอร์ เพราะมันไม่เพียงพูดภาษาคนได้ ยืนสองขาได้ ยังขยายร่างได้อีกด้วย
lesson_wordStory_112.tw: 魯夫終於帶著娜美及香起士找到了庫蕾哈醫生，在庫蕾哈醫生高明的醫術下，不但治好了魯夫跟香起士的傷，也醫好了娜美的重病。不過讓他們驚訝的是一隻叫做喬巴的馴鹿，因為它不但會說人話，用兩腳站立，還會突然變得很大。
lesson_wordStory_112.vi: Luffy đưa Nami và Sanji tìm Dr. Kureha, với y học tài tình Dr. Kureha,không chỉ chữa khỏi vết thương cho Luffy và Sanji, mà còn chữa lành bệnh nghiêm trọng của Nami. Nhưng làm họ bất ngờ là một chú tuần lộc tên Chopper, không chỉ biết nói tiếng người, đứng bằng 2 chân, còn có thể biến rất lớn.
lesson_wordStory_112.de: Ruffy nahm schließlich Nami und Sanji mit, um Dr. Kuleiha zu finden. Unter Dr. Kuleihas hervorragenden medizinischen Fähigkeiten heilte er nicht nur die Verletzungen von Ruffy und Sanji, sondern heilte auch Namis schwere Krankheit. Was sie jedoch überraschte, war ein Rentier namens Chopper, weil es nicht nur menschliche Worte spricht, auf zwei Beinen steht, sondern auch plötzlich sehr groß wird.
lesson_wordStory_112.pt: Luffy levou Nami e Sanji para encontrar o Dr. Kureha. Com a avançada técnica médica do Dr. Kureha, eles não só curaram Luffy, mas também o Sanji. Nami também se recuperou de sua doença grave.  No entanto, o que mais os surpreendeu foi uma rena chamada Chopper. Porque ele não só podia falar, mas também era capaz de ficar de pé com os dois pés. E ele poderia se transformar em um monstro enorme.

lesson_wordStory_116.cn: 路飞发现了乔巴的秘密，觉得他很厉害也很有趣，非要乔巴加入他们不可。而就在这时候，库蕾哈医生对他们说出了乔巴的悲惨身世.....
lesson_wordStory_116.en: Luffy discovered the secret of Chopper and thought he was formidable and fun. Then he insisted to have Chopper on board. At this moment, Dr. Kureha told them about the sad story of Chopper...
lesson_wordStory_116.th: ลูฟี่รู้ความลับของช็อปเปอร์ รู้สึกว่าเขายอดเยี่ยมและน่าสนใจมาก อยากให้ช็อปเปอร์มาอยู่กับพวกเขาให้ได้ ในเวลานี้เอง ด๊อกเตอร์คุเรฮะบอกเล่าชีวิตที่น่าสงสารของช็อปเปอร์แก่พวกเขา.....
lesson_wordStory_116.tw: 魯夫發現了喬巴的秘密，覺得他很厲害也很有趣，非要喬巴加入他們不可。而就在這時候，庫蕾哈醫生對他們說出了喬巴的悲慘身世.....
lesson_wordStory_116.vi: Luffy phát hiện bí mật của Chopper, cảm thấy cậu vừa lợi hại vừa thú vị, Chopper nhất định phải gia nhập với họ. Cũng chính lúc này, Dr.Kureha đã nói cho họ viết về thân thế bi thảm của Chopper.....
lesson_wordStory_116.de: Ruffy entdeckte Choppers Geheimnis und fand ihn sehr mächtig und interessant, und er musste sich ihnen anschließen. In diesem Moment erzählte Dr. Kuleiha ihnen von Choppers tragischer Lebenserfahrung...
lesson_wordStory_116.pt: Luffy descobriu o segredo de Chopper e o achou formidável e divertido. Então ele insistiu em ter Chopper a bordo. Nesse momento, a Dr. Kureha contou a eles sobre a triste história de Chopper...

lesson_wordStory_120.cn: 就在路飞一行人被库蕾哈医生收治时，瓦尔波又追来了。原来瓦尔波与库蕾哈，乔巴都有难解的仇恨纠葛。于是，这群原本不相干的人结合起来与瓦尔波和他的爪牙打斗。瓦尔波使出吞吞工厂绝技，决心要把希鲁鲁克的海贼旗打下城堡....
lesson_wordStory_120.en: When Luffy and his friends were taken in by Dr. Kureha. Wapol came again. It turned out Wapol had a long feud against Kureha and Chopper Therefore, this group of motley crew teamed up together to fight against Wapol and his goons. Wapol used the special move Baku Baku Factory, deciding to knock the jolly roger of Hiriluk off from the castle...
lesson_wordStory_120.th: ขณะที่พวกลูฟี่ได้รับการรักษาจากด๊อกเตอร์คุเรฮะ วาโปลูก็ตามมาอีก ที่แท้วาโปลูกับคุเรฮะ ช็อปเปอร์ล้วนมีความแค้นต่อกัน ด้วยเหตุนี้กลุ่มคนที่ไม่เกี่ยวข้องกันนี้จึงรวมตัวกันต่อสู้กับสมุนของวาโปลู วาโปลูใช้บาคุบาคุแฟคทอรี่ ตัดสินใจทำลายธงโจรสลัดของด็อกเตอร์ฮิลลุค....
lesson_wordStory_120.tw: 就在魯夫一行人被庫蕾哈醫生收治時，瓦波爾又追來了。原來瓦波爾與庫蕾哈，喬巴都有難解的仇恨糾葛。於是，這群原本不相干的人結合起來與瓦波爾和他的爪牙打鬥。瓦波爾使出吞吞工廠絕技，決心要把希魯魯克的海賊旗打下城堡....
lesson_wordStory_120.vi: Khi nhóm người Luffy được Dr. Kureha chữa trị, Wapol lại đuổi đến. Hóa ra Wapol có mối thù với Dr. Kureha, Chopper. Thế là, nhóm người vốn chẳng liên quan gì đã tập hợp lại chiến đấu với thuộc hạ của Wapol. Wapol tuyệt chiêu Chomp Chomp Factory, quyết tâm đánh hạ cờ hải  tặc của Dr. Hiriluk...
lesson_wordStory_120.de: Als Ruffy mit seinen Leuten von Dr. Kureha behandelt wurde, hat Wapol wider aufgeholt. Es stelle sich heraus, dass Wapol, Dr. Kureha und Chopper alle viele Streitigkeiten haben. Deswegen haben sich die nicht verwandten Personen zusammengeschlossen, um Wapol und seine Anhänger zu besiegen. Wapol benutzt die ultimative Fähigkeit der Verschlingen-Fabrik und fest davon entschlossen, sich die Flagge von Shiluruk aus der Burg zu besorgen...
lesson_wordStory_120.pt: Quando Luffy e seus amigos foram levados pelo Dr. Kureha. Wapol veio novamente.  Na verdade Wapol teve uma longa rivalidade contra Kureha e Chopper.  Portanto, este grupo heterogêneo se uniu para lutar contra Wapol e seus capangas.  Wapol usou o movimento especial Fábrica Baku Baku, decidindo derrubar o jolly roger de Hiriluk do castelo...

lesson_wordStory_124.cn: 挥别希鲁鲁克的夜樱，草帽团继续启程前往阿拉巴斯坦。而他们因为食物匮乏而不得不开始钓鱼补充食物，却因此钓起了Mr.2冯·克雷，因其奇特的模仿能力迅速与路飞一行人建立了友谊，事后才知道他们其实是敌对的人
lesson_wordStory_124.en: After bidding farewell to Hiriluk, the Strawhat Pirates continue to sail to Alabasta. And they were forced to start finishing to replenish food due to food shortage. However, they managed to get Mr. 2, Bon Kurei, up. Because of his strange mimicking ability, he quickly became friends with Luffy and the others. After that, they finally learned that he was actually with the enemy.
lesson_wordStory_124.th: หลังจากอำลาด็อกเตอร์ฮิลลุคแห่งกลุ่มโจรสลัดซากุระ กลุ่มหมวกฟางมุ่งหน้าไปอลาบัสต้า พวกเขาขาดแคลนอาหารจึงต้องตกปลา และตกได้มิสเตอร์ทูเบนเฮม ใช้ความสามารถเลียนแบบเป็นมิตรกับพวกลูฟี่อย่างรวดเร็ว หลังจากนั้นถึงรู้ว่าความจริงพวกเขาเป็นศัตรูกัน
lesson_wordStory_124.tw: 揮別希魯魯克的夜櫻，草帽團繼續啟程前往阿拉巴斯坦。而他們因為食物匱乏而不得不開始釣魚補充食物，卻因此釣起了Mr.2彭·格列，因其奇特的模仿能力迅速與魯夫一行人建立了友誼，事後才知道他們其實是敵對的人
lesson_wordStory_124.vi: Sau khi tạm biệt Dr. Hiriluk, Băng Mũ Rơm tiếp tục đến Alabasta. Nhưng thiếu thốn lương thực nên họ đành câu cá bổ sung, nhưng lại câu trúng Mr.2 Bentham, do có Skill mô phỏng nên nhanh chóng kết bạn với nhóm Luffy, sau đó mới biết họ là kẻ địch của nhau
lesson_wordStory_124.de: Nachdem die Stohhutbande sich von Shiluruk verabschiedete, machte sie sich weiter auf den Weg nach Alabasta. Sie müssen fischen, weil sie keine Nahrung mehr zu Verfügung hatten, haben aber dafür Mr.2 Bentham mit dem Haken gefangen. Weil er seine spezielle Verwandlungsfähigkeit benutzt konnte, befreundete er sich schnell mit Ruffy und den anderen, er später fand man heraus, das er in Wirklichkeit zu den Feinden gehört
lesson_wordStory_124.pt: Depois de se despedir de Hiriluk, os Piratas Chapéus de Palha continuam a navegar para Alabasta.  E eles foram forçados a começar a terminar para repor os alimentos devido à escassez de alimentos. No entanto, eles conseguiram levantar o Sr. 2, Bon Kurei. Por causa de sua estranha habilidade de imitação, ele rapidamente se tornou amigo de Luffy e dos outros. Depois disso, eles finalmente descobriram que ele estava realmente com o inimigo.

lesson_wordStory_128.cn: 白胡子海贼团第二队队长火拳艾斯，居然出现在那罗哈拉的街上。在路飞与斯摩格上校激烈缠快招架不住时，艾斯使出烧烧果实的能力来对抗斯摩格的冒烟果实能力，让路飞得以逃跑，原来艾斯是路飞的哥哥
lesson_wordStory_128.en: Ace the fire fist, the team leader of the second team of Whitebeard Pirates actually showed up on the street of Alubarna. When Luffy couldn't hold any further in the battle against Smoker, Ace used the power of Flame-Flame Fruit to counter against Smoker's Smoke-smoke fruit, making Luffy manage to escape. It turned out that Ace was actually Luffy's brother.
lesson_wordStory_128.th: เอสหมัดเพลิงผู้นำหน่วยที่2ของกลุ่มโจรสลัดหนวดขาว ปรากฏตัวบนถนนในอาณาจักรอลาบาสต้า ขณะที่ลูฟี่ต่อสู้กับนาวาเอกสโมคเกอร์ เอสใช้พลังของผลเมระเมระต้านทานควันจากผลโมคุโมคุของสโมคเกอร์ ทำให้ลูฟี่หลบหนีไปได้ ที่แท้เอสคือพี่ชายของลูฟี่
lesson_wordStory_128.tw: 白鬍子海賊團第二隊隊長火拳艾斯，居然出現在那羅哈拉的街上。在魯夫與史莫卡上校激烈纏快招架不住時，艾斯使出燒燒果實的能力來對抗史莫卡的冒煙果實能力，讓魯夫得以逃跑，原來艾斯是魯夫的哥哥
lesson_wordStory_128.vi: Đội trưởng đội 2 Băng Hải Tặc Râu Trắng Hỏa Quyền Ace đã xuất hiện trên đường phố Sukhdeo Lohra. Khi Luffy và thượng tá Smoker không chống đỡ nổi, Ace đã điều khiển năng lực Trái Mera đối phó năng lực Trái Smoke của Smoker, giúp Luffy thoát được. Thì ra Ace là anh trai của Luffy
lesson_wordStory_128.de: Der Kapitän vom zweiten Team von Whitebeard, Feuerfaust Ace, ist in Nakrowa erschienen. Als der Kampf von Ruffy und Smoker aus dem Ruder zu laufen schient, benutzt Ace seine Brand-Frucht um gegen die Rauch-Frucht von Smoker anzutreten. Wobei Ruffy dann die Flucht nahm. Ace ist also der Bruder von Ruffy.
lesson_wordStory_128.pt: Com o punho de fogo Ace, o líder da segunda equipe dos Piratas do Barba Branca realmente apareceu na rua de Alubarna.  Quando Luffy não aguentou mais na batalha contra Smoker, Ace usou o poder da Fruta Flame-Flame para combater a Fruta Smoke-Smoke de Smoker, fazendo Luffy conseguir escapar. Descobriu-se que Ace era na verdade irmão de Luffy

lesson_wordStory_131.cn: 白胡子海贼团第二队队长火拳艾斯，居然出现在那罗哈拉的街上。在路飞与斯摩格上校激烈缠快招架不住时，艾斯使出烧烧果实的能力来对抗斯摩格的冒烟果实能力，让路飞得以逃跑。原来艾斯是路飞的哥哥
lesson_wordStory_131.en: Ace the fire fist, the team leader of the second team of Whitebeard Pirates actually showed up on the street of Alubarna. When Luffy couldn't hold any further in the battle against Smoker, Ace used the power of Flame-Flame Fruit to counter against Smoker's Smoke-smoke fruit, making Luffy manage to escape. It turns out Ace is the brother of Luffy
lesson_wordStory_131.th: เอสหมัดเพลิงผู้นำหน่วยที่2ของกลุ่มโจรสลัดหนวดขาว ปรากฏตัวบนถนนในอาณาจักรอลาบาสต้า ขณะที่ลูฟี่ต่อสู้กับนาวาเอกสโมคเกอร์ เอสใช้พลังของผลเมระเมระต้านทานควันจากผลโมคุโมคุของสโมคเกอร์ ทำให้ลูฟี่หลบหนีไปได้ ที่แท้เอสคือพี่ชายของลูฟี่
lesson_wordStory_131.tw: 白鬍子海賊團第二隊隊長火拳艾斯，居然出現在那羅哈拉的街上。在魯夫與史莫卡上校激烈纏快招架不住時，艾斯使出燒燒果實的能力來對抗史莫卡的冒煙果實能力，讓魯夫得以逃跑。原來艾斯是魯夫的哥哥
lesson_wordStory_131.vi: Đội trưởng đội 2 Băng Hải Tặc Râu Trắng Hỏa Quyền Ace đã xuất hiện trên đường phố Sukhdeo Lohra. Khi Luffy và thượng tá Smoker không chống đỡ nổi, Ace đã điều khiển năng lực Trái Mera đối phó năng lực Trái Smoke của Smoker, giúp Luffy thoát được. Thì ra Ace là anh trai của Luffy
lesson_wordStory_131.de: Der Kapitän vom zweiten Team von Whitebeard, Feuerfaust Ace, ist in Nakrowa erschienen. Als der Kampf von Ruffy und Smoker aus dem Ruder zu laufen schient, benutzt Ace seine Brand-Frucht um gegen die Rauch-Frucht von Smoker anzutreten. Wobei Ruffy dann die Flucht nahm. Ace ist also der Bruder von Ruffy
lesson_wordStory_131.pt: Com o punho de fogo Ace, o líder da segunda equipe dos Piratas do Barba Branca realmente apareceu na rua de Alubarna.  Quando Luffy não aguentou mais na batalha contra Smoker, Ace usou o poder da Fruta Flame-Flame para combater a Fruta Smoke-Smoke de Smoker, fazendo Luffy conseguir escapar. Descobriu-se na verdade que Ace era irmão de Luffy

lesson_wordStory_133.cn: 路飞一行人好不容易走到了雨地，不料在那里等着他们的却是斯摩格上校及达斯琪带领的海军。一场混乱的追逐之后，路飞一行人冲进了克洛克达尔所在的赌场“雨宴”……
lesson_wordStory_133.en: Luffy and his friends finally went to the rainy ground. What were waiting for them there were the Marines led by Colonel Smoker and Tashigi. After a chaotic pursue, Luffy and his friends rushed to Crocodile's casino “Rain Dinners”...
lesson_wordStory_133.th: พวกลูฟี่มาถึงเรนเบสอย่างยากเย็น ไม่นึกว่าสิ่งที่รอพวกเขาอยู่ที่นั่นคือกองทัพเรือที่นำโดยนาวาเอกสโมคเกอร์และทาชิงิ หลังจากการไล่ล่าที่วุ่นวาย พวกลูฟี่บุกเข้าหลังจากการไล่ล่าที่วุ่นวาย“เรนเบส”…… ที่ที่ครอคโคไดล์เดิมพัน
lesson_wordStory_133.tw: 魯夫一行人好不容易走到了雨地，不料在那裡等著他們的卻是史莫卡上校及達絲琪帶領的海軍。一場混亂的追逐之後，魯夫一行人沖進了克洛克達爾所在的賭場“雨宴”……
lesson_wordStory_133.vi: Nhóm người Luffy cuối cùng cũng đến được Đất Mưa, không ngờ ở đây đại tá Smoker và hải quân do Tashigi chỉ huy đang chờ họ. Sau một hồi truy đuổi hỗn loạn, nhóm người Luffy đã xông vào “Tiệc Mưa” của Sir Crocodile...
lesson_wordStory_133.de: Ruffy und seine Gruppe erreichten schließlich den regnerischen Boden, aber die Marine unter der Führung von Colonel Smoker und Daschi auf sie. Nach einer chaotischen Verfolgungsjagd stürmten Ruffy und sein Team in das "Regenbankett" des Casinos, in dem sich Crocodile befand...
lesson_wordStory_133.pt: Luffy e seus amigos finalmente foram para o solo chuvoso. O que os esperava eram os fuzileiros navais liderados pelo Coronel Smoker e Tashigi.  Após uma perseguição caótica, Luffy e seus amigos correram para o cassino de Crocodilo, “Banquete da Chuva”...

lesson_wordStory_137.cn: 草帽团一行人跟斯摩格进入了“雨宴”VIP室，却掉进了克洛克达尔的海楼石牢房陷阱里，而贝尔为了救薇薇公主被Miss.全周日打败，薇薇也被带到了克洛克达尔处。紧接着，理想乡作战即将开始……
lesson_wordStory_137.en: The people of Strawhat Pirates made it into the VIP room of “Rain Dinners”. But they accidentally fell into the trap of Seastone Jail set by Crocodile. And Pell was defeated by Miss. Allsunday, while attempting to save Princess Vivi. And Vivi was also taken to Crocodile. Later on, the battle of dream land will commence
lesson_wordStory_137.th: กลุ่มหมวกฟางตามสโมคเกอร์เข้าสู่ห้องVIP“เรนเบส” กลับตกลงในคุกหินไคโรของครอคโคไดล์ ส่วนเบลเพื่อช่วยเจ้าหญิงวีวี่แต่พ่ายแพ้แก่มิสออลซันเดย์ วีวี่ถูกพาไปหาครอคโคไดล์ อีกไม่นานยุทธการยูโทเปียก็จะเริ่มขึ้น……
lesson_wordStory_137.tw: 草帽團一行人跟史莫卡進入了“雨宴”VIP室，卻掉進了克洛克達爾的海樓石牢房陷阱裡，而貝爾為了救薇薇公主被Miss.全周日打敗，薇薇也被帶到了克洛克達爾處。緊接著，理想鄉作戰即將開始……
lesson_wordStory_137.vi: Bọn người Băng Mũ Rơm cùng Smoker vào phòng VIP của “Đại Tiệc Mưa”, nhưng lại rơi vào cạm bẫy hầm đá tháp biển của Sir Crocodile, còn Bell vì muốn cứu công chúa Vivi bị Miss All Sunday đánh bại, Vivi cũng bị dẫn đến chỗ Sir Crocodile. Sau đó, trận chiến sắp bắt đầu...
lesson_wordStory_137.de: Die Strohhutbande haben zusammen mit Smoker den Vip-Raum des "Regenbanketts" betreten und traten dann aber in eine Falle. Es war eine Zelle, die aus Seesteinen gemacht wurde. Pell wollte Prinzessin Vivi retten, wurde dann aber von Miss. All Sunday besiegt. Vivi wurde dann auch anschließend zu Crocodile gerbacht. Als nächstes, beginnt dann der Kampf des Illusionslandes...
lesson_wordStory_137.pt: O pessoal do Chapéus de Palha e Smoker conseguiram entrar na sala VIP do “Banquete da Chuva”. Mas eles acidentalmente caíram na armadilha Kairoseki armada por Crocodilo. E Pell foi derrotado por Srta. Sempre Domingo, enquanto tentava salvar a princesa Vivi. E Vivi também foi levada por Crocodilo.  Mais tarde, a batalha da terra dos sonhos começará...

lesson_wordStory_141.cn: 克洛克达尔的计划开始实现，伪装成假国王的冯·克雷出现在那罗哈拉，让叛乱军决心揭竿而起。而另一方面，被困在“雨宴”的草帽团面临香蕉鳄鱼的恐怖威胁，他们能顺利地度过这次的危机吗？
lesson_wordStory_141.en: Crocodile's scheme has finally worked. Bon Kurei disguised as the fake king and showed up at Alubarna court and instigated the rebels to rebel. And on the other hand, Luffy and the crew trapped in the Rain Dinners are faced with the threats from Bananawani. Can they pull through the crisis??
lesson_wordStory_141.th: แผนของครอคโคไดล์เริ่มเป็นจริง เบนเฮมที่ปลอมตัวเป็นราชาปลอมปรากฏตัวที่อลาบาสต้า ทำให้คณะปฏิวัติเริ่มเคลื่อนไหว อีกด้านหนึ่ง กลุ่มหมวกฟางที่ถูกขังใน“เรนเบส”เผชิญหน้ากับการคุกคามที่น่ากลัวจากจระเข้ยักษ์หัวกล้วย พวกเขาจะรอดจากวิกฤตนี้ไปได้หรือไม่？
lesson_wordStory_141.tw: 克洛克達爾的計畫開始實現，偽裝成假國王的彭·格列出現在那羅哈拉，讓叛亂軍決心揭竿而起。而另一方面，被困在“雨宴”的草帽團面臨香蕉鱷魚的恐怖威脅，他們能順利地度過這次的危機嗎？
lesson_wordStory_141.vi: Kế hoạch của Sir Crocodile bắt đầu thành hiện thực, Bentham cải trang thành vua giả xuất hiện tại Law Halla khiến phản quân quyết tâm trỗi dậy. Mặt khác, Băng Mũ Rơm, bị mắc kẹt trong "Đại tiệc Cầu Vồng", đối mặt với mối đe dọa của Banana Crocodile. Họ có thể sống sót qua lần khủng hoảng này một cách suôn sẻ không?
lesson_wordStory_141.de: Crocodiles Plan wurde verwirklicht, und Bentham, als falscher König verkleidet, erschien in Narohara und ließ die Rebellen entschlossen auferstehen. Andererseits ist die im "Regenbankett" gefangene Stohhutbande der terroristischen Bedrohung durch Bananenkrokodile ausgesetzt. Können sie diese Krise reibungslos überleben?
lesson_wordStory_141.pt: O esquema de Crocodilo finalmente funcionou. Bon Kurei se disfarçou como o falso rei e apareceu na corte de Alubarna e instigou os rebeldes a se rebelarem.  Por outro lado, os chapéus de palha e a tripulação presa no “Banquete da Chuva” enfrentam as ameaças de Bananawani. Eles podem superar a crise?

lesson_wordStory_145.cn: 山治的及时出现，误打误撞释放出香蕉鳄鱼肚子里的Mr.3，借助他「魔鬼蜡烛」的融化能力，让大家得以顺利逃出来。可是也被山治救出来的斯摩格上校会轻易放过路飞他们吗？
lesson_wordStory_145.en: Sanji appears just in time to release Mr. 3 from the belly of Bananawani. And with his ability of Devil Candle, everyone makes it to get out. But will Captain Smoker, also saved by Sanji, let them get away with it?
lesson_wordStory_145.th: ซันจิปรากฏตัวทันเวลา รีบปล่อย Mr.3 ออกมาจากท้องของจระเข้ยักษ์หัวกล้วย ยืมใช้ความสามารถหลอมละลาย「เทียนปีศาจ」ของเขา ทำให้ทุกคนหนีออกมาได้อย่างปลอดภัย แต่นาวาเอกสโมคเกอร์ที่ซันจิช่วยออกมาด้วยจะปล่อยพวกลูฟี่ไปได้ง่ายๆ เหรอ？
lesson_wordStory_145.tw: 香起士的及時出現，誤打誤撞釋放出香蕉鱷魚肚子裏的Mr.3，借助他「魔鬼蠟燭」的融化能力，讓大家得以順利逃出來。可是也被香起士救出來的史莫卡上校會輕易放過魯夫他們嗎？
lesson_wordStory_145.vi: Sự xuất hiện kịp thời của Sanji đã giải cứu được Mr.3 khỏi bụng cá sấu, nhờ năng lực tan chảy Nến Ma Quỷ của anh ta mà mọi người đã thoát được. Nhưng Thượng Tá Smokersẽ để họ thoát ra dễ dàng thế sao?
lesson_wordStory_145.de: Sanji kommt rechtzeitig vor, lässt versehentlich Mr. 3 im Bauch des Bananenkrokodils frei und mit Hilfe seiner "Teufelskerze"-Schmelzfähigkeit entkommen alle reibungslos. Aber würde Colonel Smoker, der ebenfalls von Sanji gerettet wurde, Ruffy und andere leicht vorbeiziehen lassen?
lesson_wordStory_145.pt: Sanji aparece bem a tempo de liberar Sr. 3 da barriga de Bananawani. E com sua habilidade de [Vela do Diabo], todos conseguem sair. Mas será que o Capitão Smoker, também salvo por Sanji, vai deixar Luffy e eles escaparem impunes?

lesson_wordStory_149.cn: 终于逃出“雨宴”的路飞一行人，立刻赶往阿尔巴那阻止叛乱军，没想到克洛克达尔早已等在前面阻挡他们的去路，路飞决定自己一个人留下来对付克洛克达尔，路飞即将面临前所未有的危机！
lesson_wordStory_149.en: Luffy and the crew who flee out of the Rain Dinners rush to Alubarna to stop the Rebel Army, only to be stopped halfway by Crocodile. Luffy decides to stay here alone to cope with Crocodile. He is experiencing the unprecedented crisis!
lesson_wordStory_149.th: สุดท้ายพวกลูฟี่หนีออกจาก“เรนเบส”ได้ก็รีบไปอัลบาน่าขัดขวางคณะปฏิวัติทันที ไม่นึกว่าครอคโคไดล์จะรอขวางทางพวกเขาอยู่ก่อนแล้ว ลูฟี่ตัดสินใจรับมือครอคโคไดล์คนเดียว ลูฟี่กำลังจะเผชิญกับอันตรายที่ไม่เคยเกิดขึ้นมาก่อน！
lesson_wordStory_149.tw: 終於逃出“雨宴”的魯夫一行人，立刻趕往阿爾巴那阻止叛亂軍，沒想到克洛克達爾早已等在前面阻擋他們的去路，魯夫決定自己一個人留下來對付克洛克達爾，魯夫即將面臨前所未有的危機！
lesson_wordStory_149.vi: Nhóm người Luffy, người cuối cùng đã thoát khỏi "Đại Tiệc Mưa", ngay lập tức chạy đến Albana để ngăn quân nổi dậy, không ngờ Sir Crocodile đã chặn đường đi họ, Luffy quyết định ở lại đối phó Sir Crocodile, Luffy đối mặt với nguy cơ lớn!
lesson_wordStory_149.de: Ruffy und seine Gruppe, die schließlich dem "Regenbankett" entkommen waren, eilten sofort nach Albana, um die Rebellen aufzuhalten. Unerwartet hat Crocodile bereits vor ihnen gewartet. Ruffy beschloss, allein zu bleiben, um gegen Crocodile zu kämpfen. Ruffy steht vor einer beispiellose Krise!
lesson_wordStory_149.pt: Luffy e a tripulação que fogem do “Banquete da Chuva” correm para Alubarna para parar o Exército Rebelde, apenas para serem parados no meio do caminho por Crocodilo. Luffy decide ficar aqui sozinho para lidar com Crocodilo. Ele está passando por uma crise sem precedentes!

lesson_wordStory_153.cn: 在草帽团与巴洛克工作室的对决中，冯·克雷看准了山治的好色心态，在对决之中使出「模仿模仿合成脸」将脸变成娜美，使得山治无法对他下手而陷入了危机之中……
lesson_wordStory_153.en: During the battle between Strawhat Pirates and Baroque Workshop, in response to Sanji's amorous nature, Mr.2 uses his imitation ability to impersonate Nami, rendering him into crisis because he cannot attack a female...
lesson_wordStory_153.th: ขณะที่กลุ่มหมวกฟางต่อสู้กับบาร็อกเวิร์ค เบนเฮมรู้นิสัยเจ้าชู้ของซันจิ จึงใช้「เลียนแบบใบหน้า」เปลี่ยนหน้าเป็นนามิ ทำให้ซันจิไม่อาจลงมือกับเขาได้และตกอยู่ในภาวะวิกฤต……
lesson_wordStory_153.tw: 在草帽團與巴羅克工作室的對決中，彭·格列看准了香起士的好色心態，在對決之中使出「模仿模仿合成臉」將臉變成娜美，使得香起士無法對他下手而陷入了危機之中……
lesson_wordStory_153.vi: Trong trận quyết đấu giữa Băng Mũ Rơm và Baroque Work, Bentham đã nhìn thấy tâm ý của Sanji, trong trận đấu anh đã dùng chiêu「Mô Phỏng Ghép Mặt」biến gương mặt thành Nami, khiến Sanji không thể tấn công hắn và rơi vào nguy hiểm…
lesson_wordStory_153.de: Im Duell zwischen Stohhutbande und Baroque Werkstatt erblickte Bentham Sanjis geile Mentalität. Im Duell verwendete er imitierendes synthetisches Gesicht, um sein Gesicht in Nami zu verwandeln, und ließ Sanji ihn nicht angreifen...
lesson_wordStory_153.pt: Durante a batalha entre Chapéus de Palha e Oficina de Baroque, Bon Kurei em resposta à natureza amorosa de Sanji, usa sua habilidade [Imitação Facial Sintética] para representar Nami, deixando-o em crise porque ele não pode atacar uma mulher...

lesson_wordStory_157.cn: 在混战中，娜美与Miss.双手指展开了死斗，但是始终被压制，最终娜美使用天候棒，向敌人发出了最后一击……
lesson_wordStory_157.en: In a chaotic battle, Nami and Miss Doublefinger carried out a deadly fight. But she was still suppressed and defeated. In the end, Nami used the Clima-Tact to deliver the final blow at her enemy...
lesson_wordStory_157.th: ในความโกลาหล นามิสู้ตายกับมิสดับเบิลฟิงเกอร์ แต่สุดท้ายก็ยังเสียเปรียบ นามิจึงใช้กระบองคุริมะ โจมตีครั้งสุดท้ายใส่ศัตรู……
lesson_wordStory_157.tw: 在混戰中，娜美與Miss 雙手指展開了死鬥，但是始終被壓制，最終娜美使用天候棒，向敵人發出了最後一擊……
lesson_wordStory_157.vi: Trong hỗn chiến, Nami và Miss Double Finger đều liều mạng chiến đấu, nhưng vẫn bị áp chế, cuối cùng Nami dùng Gậy Thời Tiết, đánh một đòn cuối về phía địch...
lesson_wordStory_157.de: Im Nahkampf begannen Nami und Zala einen Todeskampf, aber sie wurden immer unterdrückt. Am Ende benutzte Nami den Wetterstab, um dem Feind den letzten Schlag zu versetzen...
lesson_wordStory_157.pt: Em uma batalha caótica, Nami e Srta. Dois Dedos travaram uma luta mortal. Mas ela ainda foi reprimida e derrotada. No final, Nami usou o Clima-Tact para desferir o golpe final em seu inimigo...

lesson_wordStory_161.cn: 和索隆激斗的Mr.1由于拥有钢铁般毫无破绽的身体，使得索隆陷入前所未有的苦战。就在此时，索隆回忆起师父的教诲，进而领悟到真正「豪剑」的奥秘，彻底打败了Mr.1……
lesson_wordStory_161.en: Because Mr. 1 possesses the body that is as hard as steel, it renders Zoro to fall into an unprecedented disadvantageous fight! Right at this moment, Zoro recalled the tutelage from his master. He finally understood the true secret of [Strong Blade] and utterly destroyed Mr. 1...
lesson_wordStory_161.th: มิสเตอร์.1ที่ต่อสู้กับโซโร เนื่องจากมีร่างเป็นของมีคมแข็งดุจเหล็ก ทำให้โซโรตกอยู่ในสถานการณ์ลำบาก ในเวลานี้เองโซโรระลึกถึงคำสอนของอาจารย์ ตระหนักถึงความลึกลับของ「ดาบ」ที่แท้จริง ในที่สุดก็เอาชนะมิสเตอร์.1ได้……
lesson_wordStory_161.tw: 和索隆激鬥的Mr.1由於擁有鋼鐵般毫無破綻的身體，使得索隆陷入前所未有的苦戰。就在此時，索隆回憶起師父的教誨，進而領悟到真正「豪劍」的奧秘，徹底打敗了Mr.1……
lesson_wordStory_161.vi: Mr.1 chiến đấu với Zoro. Do cơ thể như thép, Zoro rơi vào cuộc chiến khó khăn nhất chưa từng có. Lúc này, Zoro nhớ lại lời dạy của sư phụ, và sau đó nhận ra bí ẩn thực sự của「Đại Kiếm」, đánh bại Mr.1 .
lesson_wordStory_161.de: Der mit Zorro kämpfende Mr.1 hat einen unbrechbaren Körper aus Stahl. Zorre musste sich somit einen sehr harten Kampf stellen. Zu diesen Zeitpunkt erinnerte sich Zorro wieder an die Wörter von Meister, somit erlangte er das echte Wissen des [großen Schwertes] und besiegte Mr.1...
lesson_wordStory_161.pt: Por possuir o corpo duro como aço, o Sr. 1 faz com que Zoro caia em uma luta desvantajosa sem precedentes. Neste momento, Zoro relembrou a tutela de seu mestre. Ele finalmente entendeu o verdadeiro segredo da [Lâmina Poderosa] e destruiu completamente o Sr. 1...

lesson_wordStory_165.cn: 路飞与克洛克达尔展开第二回合的决斗。路飞这次终于看破克洛克达尔的破绽，背着水桶上仗。而在克洛克达尔的攻势下，连地面都龟裂了。路飞要怎样才能赢下这场战斗呢？
lesson_wordStory_165.en: Luffy and Crocodile started the 2nd round of duel. This time, Luffy has seen through the flaw of Crocodile. He went to the battle with a water bucket. Under the attack of Crocodile, even the floor has cracked. How will Luffy do to win this battle?
lesson_wordStory_165.th: ลูฟี่กับครอคโคไดล์เริ่มการต่อสู้รอบสอง คราวนี้ลูฟี่มองเห็นจุดอ่อนของครอคโคไดล์ จึงแบกถังน้ำไปสู้ด้วย จากการโจมตีของครอคโคไดล์แม้แต่พื้นยังแตกเป็นเสี่ยงๆ ลูฟี่จะชนะการต่อสู้นี้ได้อย่างไร？
lesson_wordStory_165.tw: 魯夫與克洛克達爾展開第二回合的決鬥。魯夫這次終於看破克洛克達爾的破綻，背著水桶上仗。而在克洛克達爾的攻勢下，連地面都龜裂了。魯夫要怎樣才能贏下這場戰鬥呢？
lesson_wordStory_165.vi: Luffy và Sir Crocodile bắt đầu hiệp đấu thứ 2. Luffy lần này phát hiện ra sơ hở của Sir Crocodile, vác thùng trên lưng bước vào trận chiến. Dưới sự tấn công củaSir Crocodile, ngay cả mặt đất cũng bị nứt. Luffy phải chống đỡ thế nào đây?

No entanto, eles descobriram que Going Merry foi consertado de alguma forma por algumas pessoas no dia seguinte.  Por outro lado, o Deus Supremo, Enel finalmente revelou sua verdadeira face. Descobriu-se que ele era o usuário da Fruta Rumble-Rumble...

lesson_wordStory_201.cn: 韦伯带领的山迪亚战士们为了击倒艾尼路，一行人攻向了神之社。但是以心网看穿这一切的艾尼路，开放整座岛给神官作为试炼的地方，让神官及神兵们，与山迪亚人以及青海人也就是路飞一行人，展开了一场生死交战的生存游戏。
lesson_wordStory_201.en: The Shandian Warrior lead by Wyper went to attack Skypiea. However, Enel has already seen through all of these with heart web. He has opened up the whole island as the training ground for his priests. A survival game of life and death is about to get started between the priests, the divine troops, the Shandians, and Luffy and his friends.
lesson_wordStory_201.th: เหล่านักรบแชนเดียร์ที่นำโดยไวเปอร์ เพื่อโค่นล้มเอเนล พวกเขาโจมตีใส่วิหารเทพ แต่เอเนลที่อ่านใจมองออกทุกอย่าง เปิดทั้งเกาะเป็นสถานที่ทดสอบของเทพคุมกฎ ให้เทพคุมกฎ กองทัพเทพต่อสู้กับชาวแชนเดียร์และชาวทะเลสีฟ้าซึ่งก็คือพวกลูฟี่
lesson_wordStory_201.tw: 韋伯帶領的山迪亞戰士們為了擊倒艾尼路，一行人攻向了神之社。但是以心網看穿這一切的艾尼路，開放整座島給神官作為試煉的地方，讓神官及神兵們，與山迪亞人以及青海人也就是魯夫一行人，展開了一場生死交戰的生存遊戲。
lesson_wordStory_201.vi: Các chiến sĩ Shandia do Weber thống lĩnh, vì đánh bại Enel đã tấn công đền thần. Nhưng Enel đã dùng tâm võng nhìn thấy tất cả, mở tất cả đảo nhằm làm nơi thí luyện cho các Thần Quan, để các Thần Quan và Thần Binh quyết một trận chiến sinh tử với người Shandia  và nhóm người Luffy.
lesson_wordStory_201.de: Um Enel zu besiegen, griffen die von Wyper angeführten Shandia-Krieger das Heiligtum Gottes an. Aber Enel durchschaute alles mit Herznetz und öffnete die gesamte Insel für Priester als Ort für Prüfungen, sodass Priester und Soldaten ein Überlebensspiel mit Shandiaern und Ruffy und seiner Gruppe, beginnen konnten.
lesson_wordStory_201.pt: O Guerreiro Shandian liderado por Wyper foi atacar Skypiea. No entanto, a Enel já viu tudo isso com a teia do coração. Mas Enel, aquele que vê através de tudo isso com sua rede do coração, abriu toda a ilha como campo de treinamento para seus sacerdotes. Um jogo de sobrevivência de vida e morte está prestes a começar entre os sacerdotes, as tropas divinas, os Shandians e Luffy e seus amigos.

lesson_wordStory_205.cn: 在战场中，韦伯用藏在手中的排击贝成功击中艾尼路的心脏，使其心脏骤停，但自己也受到了重创。而艾尼路用电击能力电击自己的心脏，重新站了起来。众人都被艾尼路可怕的能力所震慑......
lesson_wordStory_205.en: On the battlefield, Wyper used the Impact Dial hidden in his hands to successfully hit the heart of Enel, rendering it to stop for a moment. But he also was severely wounded. And Enel used his electric shock ability to shock his own heart, allowing himself to stand up again. Everyone was terrified by the formidable power of Enel...
lesson_wordStory_205.th: ในขณะต่อสู้ไวเปอร์ใช้รีเจ็คไดอัลที่ซ่อนในมือโจมตีหัวใจของเอเนลได้สำเร็จ ทำให้หัวใจหยุดเต้น แต่ตัวเองก็ได้รับบาดเจ็บหนัก ส่วนเอเนลใช้พลังไฟฟ้ากระตุ้นหัวใจ ลุกขึ้นยืนใหม่ได้อีกครั้ง ทุกคนต่างตกใจกลัวในพลังของเอเนล......
lesson_wordStory_205.tw: 在戰場中，韋伯用藏在手中的排擊貝成功擊中艾尼路的心臟，使其心臟驟停，但自己也受到了重創。而艾尼路用電擊能力電擊自己的心臟，重新站了起來。眾人都被艾尼路可怕的能力所震懾......
lesson_wordStory_205.vi: Trong chiến trường, Weber đã đánh trúng tim Enel với Vỏ Công Kích được giấu trong tay, khiến tim hắn ngừng đập, nhưng anh ta cũng bị chấn thương nặng, Enel đã gây sốc bằng khả năng điện giật của mình và đứng dậy trở lại. Mọi người bị sốc bởi khả năng đáng sợ của Enel ...
lesson_wordStory_205.de: Auf dem Schlachtfeld schlug Wyper erfolgreich Enels Herz mit der in seinen Händen versteckten Schlagschale, was zu einem Herzstillstand führte, aber er wurde auch hart getroffen. Aber Enel nutzte die Fähigkeit des Elektroschocks, um sein eigenes Herz zu schockieren und stand wieder auf. Alle waren schockiert über die schreckliche Fähigkeit von Enel...
lesson_wordStory_205.pt: No campo de batalha, Wyper usou o ataque escondido em suas mãos para atingir com sucesso o coração de Enel, fazendo-o parar por um momento. Mas ele também foi gravemente ferido. E Enel usou sua habilidade de choque elétrico para chocar o próprio coração, permitindo-se levantar novamente. Todos ficaram apavorados com o formidável poder de Enel...

lesson_wordStory_209.cn: 在这场生存者游戏中，罗宾发现了黄金都市—山多拉，而乔巴在上层遗迹惨遭神官欧姆的毒手不知生死。就在这时候，巨大豆蔓的上层遗迹前存活下来的索隆、甘·福尔、韦柏、欧姆即将爆发出新的战斗火花……
lesson_wordStory_209.en: In this game of survivors, Robin discovered the Golden city - Shandora. And Chopper was attacked by Ohm the Priest at the upper ruins. Right at this moment, Zoro, Gan Fall, Wyper, and Ohm managed to survive at the upper ruins in on top of the Giant Jack. A new battle will commence soon...
lesson_wordStory_209.th: ผู้รอดชีวิตในเกมนี้ โรบินค้นพบเมืองขุมทอง—แชนโดรา ส่วนช็อปเปอร์ถูกเทพคุมกฎโอมทำร้ายไม่รู้ว่าเป็นหรือตาย ในเวลานี้เองโซโร、กัน·โฟล、ไวเปอร์、โอมผู้รอดชีวิตในซากบนต้นถั่วยักษ์กำลังจะระเบิดการต่อสู้ครั้งใหม่……
lesson_wordStory_209.tw: 在這場生存者遊戲中，羅賓發現了黃金都市—山朵拉，而喬巴在上層遺跡慘遭神官歐姆的毒手不知生死。就在這時候，巨大豆蔓的上層遺跡前存活下來的索隆、甘·福爾、韋柏、歐姆即將爆發出新的戰鬥火花……
lesson_wordStory_209.vi: Trong trò chơi sinh tồn này, Robin đã khám phá ra thành phố vàng Sandorah, còn Chopper bị độc thủ linh mục Ohm di tích sát hại không biết sống chết thế nào. Lúc này, Zoro, F-Faure, Weber, Ohm còn sống sót ở di tích ấy sắp lại phát động trận chiến mới...
