lesson_wordStory_561.tw: 漢哥古在麥哲倫的帶領下,終於到了第五層,並見到了艾斯,漢哥古告訴艾斯魯夫來救他的事,艾斯感到震驚。在第三層甩開追兵的魯夫,繼續努力尋找通往第四層的樓梯，就在他遭遇新的危險時,出現了意想不到的人……
lesson_wordStory_561.vi: Dưới sự lãnh đạo của Magellan, Hancock cuối cùng cũng đến được tầng 5 và nhìn thấy Ace, Hancock báo Ace biết tin Luffy đến cứu anh ta, Ace bị sốc. Luffy đang cắt đuôi truy binh ở tầng 3, tiếp tục tìm kiếm cầu thang đến tầng 4, lúc đối mặt với nguy hiểm mới, bất ngờ 1 người xuất hiện...
lesson_wordStory_561.de: Unter Magellans Führung erreichte Hancock schließlich den fünften Stock und sah Ace. Hancock sagte Ace, dass Ruffy ihn retten wollte, und Ace war schockiert. Im dritten Stock warf Ruffy die Jagenden weg und fand die Treppe zum vierten Stock. Als er auf neue Gefahren stieß, tauchte unerwarteter Mensch auf...
lesson_wordStory_561.pt: Sob a orientação de Magellan, Hancock finalmente chegou ao nível 5 e conheceu Ace. Hancock disse a Ace que Luffy estava a caminho para salvá-lo, o que abalou Ace.  Luffy finalmente se livrou dos perseguidores no nível 3 e continuou a procurar as escadas que levam ao nível 4. Quando ele estava prestes a correr para um novo perigo, ele conheceu uma pessoa inesperada...

lesson_wordStory_565.cn: 冯·克雷决定跟着路飞一起到第五层,因为他也有想见的人。此时,在他们面前突然出现一头力量速度都很惊人的狱卒兽,两人陷入苦战，送走汉库克之后,麦哲伦终于知道路飞潜入监狱并正在大闹的事,他决定在第四层部署兵力,等待路飞自投罗网！
lesson_wordStory_565.en: Bon Kurei decided to go to Level 5 with Luffy. Because he also has someone he intended to meet. At this time, a Jail Beast with surprising strength and speed appeared in front of them. The two of them fell into a stalemate. After sending Hancock away, Magellan finally found out that Luffy has broken into the prison and made a ruckus. He decided to deploy units in Level 4 and wait for Luffy to fall into the trap!
lesson_wordStory_565.th: เบนเฮมตัดสินใจไปชั้นที่5พร้อมกับลูฟี่ เพราะเขาเองก็มีคนที่อยากจะพบ ทันใดนั้นสัตว์ผู้คุมที่มีพลังและความเร็วปรากฏตัวต่อหน้าพวกเขา ทั้งคู่เข้าสู่การต่อสู้ที่ยากลำบาก หลังจากกส่งแฮนค็อก แมกเจลแลนได้ทราบเรื่องที่ลูฟี่บุกเข้ามาสร้างความวุ่นสาย เขาตัดสินใจที่จะนำทหารไปยังชั้น4 เพื่อรอลูฟี่!
lesson_wordStory_565.tw: 彭·格列決定跟著魯夫一起到第五層,因為他也有想見的人。此時,在他們面前突然出現一頭力量速度都很驚人的獄卒獸,兩人陷入苦戰，送走漢哥古之後,麥哲倫終於知道魯夫潛入監獄並正在大鬧的事,他決定在第四層部署兵力,等待魯夫自投羅網！
lesson_wordStory_565.vi: Bentham quyết định cùng Luffy đến tầng 5, vì anh ta cũng muốn tìm người. Lúc này, một quái thú giữ ngục với sức mạnh và tốc độ kinh ngạc bất ngờ xuất hiện trước mặt, hai bên lao vào đánh nhau kịch liệt, sau khi đuổi Hancock đi, Magellan cuối cùng cũng biết Luffy đã lẻn vào nhà ngục và đang làm ầm ĩ lên. Hắn quyết định dàn quân ở tầng 4 và chờ Luffy sa bẫy!
lesson_wordStory_565.de: Bentham beschloss, Ruffy in den fünften Stock zu folgen, weil er auch jemanden hatte, den er treffen wollte. In diesem Moment tauchte plötzlich ein Gefängniswärter-Biest mit erstaunlicher Kraft und Geschwindigkeit vor ihnen auf. Die beiden gerieten in einen harten Kampf. Nachdem Magellan Hancock weggeschickt hatte, wusste er schließlich, dass Ruffy sich ins Gefängnis geschlichen hatte und viel Aufhebens machte. Er beschlossen, im vierten Stock Truppen einzusetzen und wartete, bis Ruffy sich ins Netz ging!
lesson_wordStory_565.pt: Bon Kurei decidiu ir para o nível 5 com Luffy. Porque ele também tem alguém que pretendia conhecer.  Neste momento, uma besta da prisão com força e velocidade surpreendentes apareceu na frente deles. Os dois caíram em um impasse. Depois de mandar Hancock embora, Magellan finalmente descobriu que Luffy invadiu a prisão e fez um tumulto. Ele decidiu implantar unidades no nível 4 e esperar que Luffy caísse na armadilha!

lesson_wordStory_569.cn: 路飞等人虽然打败可怕的狱卒兽,却因为地板崩塌,通通掉到了第四层，受不了焦热地狱热气的路飞,决定先去填饱肚子,Mr.3却拉着巴基躲到高处去，路飞行踪暴露后,遭到众多狱卒的追捕,正当狱卒们束手无策时,所长麦哲伦出动了，路飞与麦哲伦展开决斗……
lesson_wordStory_569.en: Although Luffy and the others defeated the terrifying jail beast, they all fell into Level 4 due to the collapsing floor. Unable to stand the hot steam of the blazing hell, Luffy decided to get some food first. Mr. 3 then dragged Buggy along with him to hide somewhere higher. After Luffy is compromised, he was pursued by many jailers. When the jailers had no idea how to apprehend him, Magellan, the warden has finally come out. A showdown between Luffy and Magellan is about to take place...
lesson_wordStory_569.th: ลูฟี่และคนอื่นๆ แม้จะเอาชนะสัตว์ผู้คุมมาได้ แต่พื้นได้แตกออก ตกลงมาชั้นที่4 ลูฟี่ที่ทนไม่ไหวกับความหิว จึงได้ตัดสินใจที่จะกินก่อน Mr.3 พาบากี้ไปหลบไปที่สูง หลังลูฟี่เปิดเผยเบาะแส ได้ถูกไล่ล่า ขณะที่เหล่าผู้คุมอ่อนกำลังลง ทำให้แมกเจลแลนต้องออกโรงเอง การตัดสินของลูฟี่และแมกเจลแลนได้เปิดฉากขึ้น……
lesson_wordStory_569.tw: 魯夫等人雖然打敗可怕的獄卒獸,卻因為地板崩塌,通通掉到了第四層，受不了焦熱地獄熱氣的魯夫,決定先去填飽肚子,Mr.3卻拉著巴基躲到高處去，魯夫行蹤暴露後,遭到眾多獄卒的追捕,正當獄卒們束手無策時,所長麥哲倫出動了，魯夫與麥哲倫展開決鬥……
lesson_wordStory_569.vi: Dù nhóm Luffy đã đánh bại quái thú giữ ngục nhưng tất cả đã rơi xuống tầng 4 vì sàn bị sập, Luffy vì không thể chịu được sức nóng thiêu đốt nên quyết định ăn no bụng trước, Mr.3 kéo Buggy đi đến nơi cao ráo hơn để trốn, sau khi Luffy bị lộ, cậu bị nhiều cai ngục truy lùng, lúc cai ngục đang thất thế thì Magellan xuất hiện. Luffy và Magellan bắt đầu quyết đấu...
lesson_wordStory_569.de: Obwohl Ruffy und die anderen das schreckliche Gefängniswärter-Biest besiegten, fielen sie alle wegen des Zusammenbruchs des Bodens in den vierten Stock. Ruffy, der die Hitze der sengenden Hölle nicht ertragen konnte, beschloss, zuerst seinen Magen zu füllen, aber Mr.3 schleppte Buggy, um sich zu verstecken. Nachdem Ruffy seine Spur verriet, wurde er von vielen Gefängniswärtern gejagt. Gerade als die Gefängniswärter ratlos waren, wurde Magellan, der Direktor, auftauchen. Ruffy und Magellan begannen ein Duell...
lesson_wordStory_569.pt: Embora Luffy e os outros tenham derrotado a terrível besta da prisão, todos eles caíram no nível 4 devido ao colapso do chão. Incapaz de suportar o vapor quente do inferno em chamas, Luffy decidiu pegar um pouco de comida primeiro. Sr. 3 então arrastou Buggy junto com ele para se esconder em algum lugar mais alto. Depois que Luffy foi comprometido, ele foi perseguido por muitos carcereiros. Quando os carcereiros não tinham ideia de como prendê-lo, Magellan, o diretor finalmente apareceu. Um confronto entre Luffy e Magellan está prestes a acontecer...

lesson_wordStory_573.cn: 冯·克雷虽然很想帮忙,可是自知打不过麦哲伦,一番心理斗争后,决定逃跑，另寻机会去救路飞。巴基和Mr.3趁大家注意力都放在路飞身上时,决定从汉尼拔镇守的楼梯逃走，却被汉尼拔一下放倒，此时冯·克雷赶到……
lesson_wordStory_573.en: Although Bon Kurei really wanted to help, he understands that he is no match with Magellan. After a struggle in his mind, he decided to run for his life and seek another chance to save Luffy. Buggy and Mr. 3 decided to flee from the stairs defended by Hannyabal when everyone was paying attention to Luffy. However, they were easily defeated by Hannyabal. At this moment, Bon Kurei came through...
lesson_wordStory_573.th: แม้ว่าเบนเฮมจะอย่างช่วย แต่เค้ารู้ตัว่าไม่สามารถเอาชนะแมกเจลแลนได้ จึงตัดสินใจหนีออกมาและหาโอกาสช่วยลูฟี่ บากี้และ Mr.3 ฉวยโอกาสที่ทุกคนกำลังสนใจลูฟี่ ได้หนีออกมาจากนั้นที่ฮันนิบาลดูแแลอยู่ แต่ถูกฮันนิบาลดึงลงมา ขณะนั้นเบนเฮมก็มาถึง……
lesson_wordStory_573.tw: 彭·格列雖然很想幫忙,可是自知打不過麥哲倫,一番心理鬥爭後,決定逃跑，另尋機會去救魯夫。巴基和Mr.3趁大家注意力都放在魯夫身上時,決定從般若拔鎮守的樓梯逃走，卻被般若拔一下放倒，此時彭·格列趕到……
lesson_wordStory_573.vi: Dù Bentham muốn giúp đỡ nhưng biết sức mình không thể đánh bại Magellan, sau một hồi đấu tranh tâm lý, anh quyết định bỏ trốn và tìm cơ hội khác để cứu Luffy. Buggy và Mr.3 nhân lúc mọi người tập trung tấn công Luffy, quyết định thoát ra từ lối cầu thang do Hannibal trấn giữ nhưng đã bị Hannibal hạ gục. Lúc này, Bentham lao đến...
lesson_wordStory_573.de: Obwohl Bentham helfen wollte, wusste er, dass er Magellan nicht schlagen konnte. Nach einem psychologischen Kampf beschloss er, wegzulaufen und eine weitere Chance zu finden, Ruffy zu retten. Buggy und Mr.3 beschlossen, von der von Hannyabal bewachten Treppe zu fliehen, während alle auf Ruffy aufmerksam wurden, wurden aber von Hannyabal gestürzt. Zu diesem Zeitpunkt eilte Bentham zu...
lesson_wordStory_573.pt: Embora Bon Kurei realmente quisesse ajudar, ele entende que não é páreo para Magellan. Depois de uma luta em sua mente, ele decidiu correr para salvar sua vida e buscar outra chance de salvar Luffy.  Buggy e Sr. 3 decidiram fugir das escadas defendidas por Hannyabal quando todos prestavam atenção em Luffy. No entanto, eles foram facilmente derrotados por Hannyabal. Neste momento, Bon Kurei passou...

lesson_wordStory_577.cn: 出奇不意打败汉尼拔的冯·克雷,变身成汉尼拔的模样,救出巴基和Mr.3,并且得知路飞受到麦哲伦的毒之刑罚,并且被丢进了第五层。基于好朋友的道义,冯·克雷决定前往第五层救出路飞,并且带他去找能起死回生的奇迹之人伊万小姐。
lesson_wordStory_577.en: Surprisingly, Bon Kurei managed to take down Hannyabal. He disguised himself as Hannyabal and saved Buggy and Mr. 3. He also learned that Luffy was taking the poison torture from Magellan and was thrown into Level 5. Thanks to the good friend's loyalty, Bon Kurei decided to go to Level 5 to save Luffy and take him to find Miss Ivan, who could bring a person back to life.
lesson_wordStory_577.th: เอาชนะเบนเฮมได้อย่างคาดไม่ถึง แปลงร่างเป็นฮันนิบาล ช่วยบากี้และ Mr.3 รู้ว่าลูฟี่ถูกพิษของแมกเจลแลนลงโทษ และถูกทิ้งไว้ที่ชั้น5 ในการเป็นเพื่อนที่ดี เบนเฮมได้ไปชั้นที่5เพื่อช่วยลูฟี่ และพาเขาไปหามิสอีวานที่สามารถช่วยให้คนตายกลับมามีชีวิตได้
lesson_wordStory_577.tw: 出奇不意打敗般若拔的彭·格列,變身成般若拔的模樣,救出巴基和Mr.3,並且得知魯夫受到麥哲倫的毒之刑罰,並且被丟進了第五層。基於好朋友的道義,彭·格列決定前往第五層救出魯夫,並且帶他去找能起死回生的奇跡之人伊萬小姐。
lesson_wordStory_577.vi: Thật bất ngờ, Bentham đánh thua Hannibal, đã biến thành hình dạng của Hannibal, giải cứu Buggy và Mr.3, biết rằng Luffy bị hành hạ bởi chất độc của Magellan và bị đưa vào tầng năm. Bentham quyết định lên tầng 5 để giải cứu người bạn Luffy và đưa cậu đi tìm Người của kỳ tích có thể cải tử hoàn sinh - Ivankov
lesson_wordStory_577.de: Überraschenderweise besiegte Bentham Hannyabal, verwandelte sich in ihn, rettete Buggy und Mr.3 und erfuhr, dass Ruffy mit Magellans Gift bestraft und in den fünften Stock geworfen worden war. Aufgrund der Moral eines Freundes beschloss Bentham, in den fünften Stock zu gehen, um Ruffy zu retten und ihn zu Fräulein Ivan zu bringen, ein wundersamer Mensch, der ihn wieder zum Leben erwecken kann.
lesson_wordStory_577.pt: Surpreendentemente, Bon Kurei conseguiu derrubar Hannyabal. Ele se disfarçou de Hannyabal e salvou Buggy e Sr. 3. Ele também soube que Luffy estava tomando a tortura venenosa de Magellan e foi jogado no nível 5.  Graças à lealdade do bom amigo, Bon Kurei decidiu ir para o nível 5 para salvar Luffy e leve-o para encontrar a Srta. Ivan, que poderia trazer uma pessoa de volta à vida.

lesson_wordStory_581.cn: 冯·克雷、巴基和Mr.3来到第五层酷寒地狱寻找路飞,巴基和Mr.3却丢下冯·克雷逃走,历经千辛万苦,冯·克雷终于找到路飞。因囚犯错误的指路，冯·克雷误入了狼穴，面对凶恶的军狼群的攻击,冯·克雷终于不支倒下……
lesson_wordStory_581.en: Bon Kurei, Buggy, and Mr. 3 finally made it to Level 5, the Freezing Hell, to find Luffy. Buggy and Mr. 3 ditched Bon Kurei to flee. After many hardships, Bon Kurei finally found Luffy. Because of the incorrect guidance of the prisoner, Bon Kurei ran into the wolf's den. In the face of the military wolves, Bon Kurei finally collapsed...
lesson_wordStory_581.th: เบนเฮม บากี้และ Mr.3 มาถึงชั้นที่5 นรกเยือกเย็นเพื่อหาลูฟี่ บากี้และMr.3 ปล่อยให้เบนเฮมหนีไป หลังจากผ่านความทุกข์มามาก ในที่สุดเบนเฮมก็หาลูฟี่พบ เนื่องจากนักโทษบอกทางผิด เบนเฮมได้เข้าไปถ้ำหมาป่า เต็มไปด้วยการโจมตีของฝูงหมาป่าที่ดุีร้าย จนในที่สุดเบนเฮมก็ล้มลง……
lesson_wordStory_581.tw: 彭·格列、巴基和Mr.3來到第五層酷寒地獄尋找魯夫,巴基和Mr.3卻丟下彭·格列逃走,歷經千辛萬苦,彭·格列終於找到魯夫。因囚犯錯誤的指路，彭·格列誤入了狼穴，面對兇惡的軍狼群的攻擊,彭·格列終於不支倒下……
lesson_wordStory_581.vi: Bentham, Buggy và Mr.3 đến tầng 5 của địa ngục lạnh giá tìm Luffy, nhưng Buggy và Mr.3 đã bỏ lại Bentham và trốn thoát. Trải qua bao khó khăn, Bentham đã tìm được Luffy. Do tù nhân chỉ đường sai, Bentham đã vào nhầm hang sói, đối mặt với sự tấn công của đội quân hung ác, Bentham cuối cùng đã ngã xuống...
lesson_wordStory_581.de: Bentham, Buggy und Mr.3 kamen in den fünften Stock der kalten Hölle, um Ruffy zu finden, aber Buggy und Mr.3 verließen Ruffy und flohen. Nach vielen Schwierigkeiten fand Bentham endlich Ruffy. Aufgrund der falschen Anweisungen der Gefangenen verirrte sich Bentham in die Wolfshöhle. Angesichts des Angriffs der bösartigen Armeewölfe fiel Bentham schließlich hin...
lesson_wordStory_581.pt: Bon Kurei, Buggy e Sr. 3 finalmente chegaram ao Nível 5, o Inferno Congelante, para encontrar Luffy. Buggy e Sr. 3 abandonaram Bon Kurei para fugir. Depois de muitas dificuldades, Bon Kurei finalmente encontrou Luffy.  Por causa da orientação incorreta do prisioneiro, Bon Kurei correu para a toca do lobo. Diante dos lobos militares, Bon Kurei finalmente desmoronou...

Diante dos lobos militares, Bon Kurei finalmente desmoronou...

lesson_wordStory_586.cn: 冯·克雷醒来之后,发现自己置身在一个宛如乐园的奇妙地方。此时舞台灯光亮起，一个身影出现，冯·克雷终于见到了传说中的奇迹之人——人妖王伊万科夫。
lesson_wordStory_586.en: After Bon Kurei woke up, he found out that he was in a place that seems like a paradise. At this moment, the lights of the stage were turned on. A figure came out. Bon Kurei finally met the legendary man of wonder - Ivankov the Okama King.
lesson_wordStory_586.th: หลังเบนเฮมตื่นขึ้นมา พบว่าตัวเองอยู่ในสวนที่น่าประหลาดใจ ขณะนั้นไฟบนเวลาสว่างขั้น มีเงาหนึ่งปรากฏออกมา ในที่สุดเบนเฮมก็ได้พบกับคนแห่งปาฏิหาริย์ในตำนาน——อิวานคอฟ
lesson_wordStory_586.tw: 彭·格列醒來之後,發現自己置身在一個宛如樂園的奇妙地方。此時舞臺燈光亮起，一個身影出現，彭·格列終於見到了傳說中的奇跡之人——人妖王伊萬科夫。
lesson_wordStory_586.vi: Sau khi Bentham tỉnh lại, thấy mình đang ở một nơi tuyệt vời như một thiên đường. Lúc này, đèn sân khấu bật sáng và một bóng người xuất hiện, Bentham cuối cùng đã nhìn thấy Con người kỳ tích - Ivankov.
lesson_wordStory_586.de: Nachdem Bentham aufgewacht war, befand er sich an einem wunderbaren Ort wie einem Paradies. Zu dieser Zeit waren die Bühnenlichter an und eine Gestalt erschien, und Bentham sah schließlich das legendäre Wunder - Emporio Ivankov.
lesson_wordStory_586.pt: Depois que Bon Kurei acordou, ele descobriu que estava em um lugar que parecia um paraíso. Nesse momento, as luzes do palco foram acesas. Uma figura saiu. Bon Kurei finalmente conheceu o lendário homem das maravilhas - Ivankov, o Rei Okama.

lesson_wordStory_590.cn: 伊万科夫告诉冯·克雷,他感动于路飞临死都还要求拯救朋友的无私,决定帮他疗伤。但是,没想到成功的概率只有2%到3%……
lesson_wordStory_590.en: Ivankov told Bon Kurei that he was moved by Luffy's selfless sacrifice, so he decided to treat him. However, the chance to succeed was only 2 to 3%...
lesson_wordStory_590.th: อิวานคอฟบอกกับเบนเฮม เขารู้สึกได้ว่าตอนที่ลูฟี่กำลังจะตายก็ยังต้องการช่วยเพื่อน ตัดสินใจรักษาให้เขา แต่ว่า โอกาสสำเร็จมีเพียง2%-3%……
lesson_wordStory_590.tw: 伊萬科夫告訴彭·格列,他感動於魯夫臨死都還要求拯救朋友的無私,決定幫他療傷。但是,沒想到成功的概率只有2%到3%……
lesson_wordStory_590.vi: Ivankov nói Bentham biết, ông ta cảm động vì Luffy đến khi sắp chết vẫn cầu xin cứu bạn, nên quyết định trị thương cho cậu. Nhưng không ngờ tỷ lệ thành công chỉ 2% đến 3%......
lesson_wordStory_590.de: Ivankov erzählte Bentham, dass er von Ruffys Selbstlosigkeit berührt war, als er vor seinem Tod bat, seinen Freund zu retten. Er beschloss, seine Verletzungen zu heilen. Die Erfolgswahrscheinlichkeit beträgt jedoch nur 2% bis 3%...
lesson_wordStory_590.pt: Ivankov disse a Bon Kurei que ficou comovido com o sacrifício altruísta de Luffy, então decidiu tratá-lo.  No entanto, a chance de sucesso era de apenas 2 a 3%...

lesson_wordStory_594.cn: 不忍路飞继续受折磨的冯·克雷，本想叫伊万科夫不要救治路飞了，却被伊万科夫一巴掌打醒，“不要小看奇迹啊！”。为了挚友，冯·克雷不顾众人的劝告，执意在路飞的病房外，声嘶力竭的为他加油打气，两人的友情终于引发了奇迹……
lesson_wordStory_594.en: Unable to see Luffy suffering, Bon Kurei wanted to tell Ivankov to give up on saving Luffy. But Ivankov slapped him and told him “not to underestimate the miracle! ”. For his best friend, Bon Kurei didn't listen to everyone's advise and insisted on waiting outside Luffy's room, exhausting himself in cheering him. The friendship of the two finally started a miracle...
lesson_wordStory_594.th: เบนเฮมไม่สามารถทนเห็นลูฟี่ทรมานต่อไปได้ ไม่ต้องการให้อิวานคอฟรักษาลูฟี่แล้ว แต่ถูกอีวานคอฟตบจนรู่สึกตีว“อย่าดูถูกปาฏิหาริย์!” เพื่อเพื่อน เบนเฮมไม่สนใจคำแนะนำของคนอื่น ยืนยันจะอยู่นอกห้องของลูฟี่ ในที่สุดมิตราภาพของทั้งคู่ก็ก่อให้เกิดปาฏิหาริย์……
lesson_wordStory_594.tw: 不忍魯夫繼續受折磨的彭·格列，本想叫伊萬科夫不要救治魯夫了，卻被伊萬科夫一巴掌打醒，“不要小看奇跡啊！”。為了摯友，彭·格列不顧眾人的勸告，執意在魯夫的病房外，聲嘶力竭的為他加油打氣，兩人的友情終於引發了奇跡……
lesson_wordStory_594.vi: Bentham không thể nhìn Luffy bị giày vò, muốn nói với Ivankov rằng đừng cứu Luffy, nhưng bị Ivankov tát một cái, “đừng xem thường kỳ tích!” Vì bạn thân, Bentham bất chấp mọi lời khuyên của mọi người, đứng ngoài phòng bệnh cổ vũ Luffy đến khản cổ. Tình bạn này cuối cùng đã tạo nên một điều kỳ diệu...
lesson_wordStory_594.de: Bentham, der Ruffys anhaltende Qual weiter erleiden lassen konnte, wollte Ivankov sagen, Ruffy nicht zu behandeln, wurde aber von Ivankov wachgeschlagen: "Unterschätze das Wunder nicht!" Für seinen besten Freunden ignorierte Bentham allen Rat und bestand darauf, ihn vor Ruffys Gemeinde heiser anzufeuern. Die Freundschaft zwischen den beiden löste schließlich ein Wunder aus...
lesson_wordStory_594.pt: Incapaz de ver o sofrimento de Luffy, Bon Kurei queria dizer a Ivankov para desistir de salvar Luffy. Mas Ivankov deu-lhe um tapa e disse-lhe “não subestime o milagre!”. Para seu melhor amigo, Bon Kurei não ouviu os conselhos de todos e insistiu em esperar do lado de fora do quarto de Luffy, esgotando-se em torcê-lo. A amizade dos dois finalmente começou um milagre...

lesson_wordStory_598.cn: 奇迹般复活的路飞，在一阵狂吃猛吃之后，竟然奇迹似的恢复体力了！本来不打算帮助路飞救出艾斯的伊万科夫，在得知路飞是反抗军龙的儿子之后，决定率领新人类乐园的所有人帮助路飞，可惜已经到了要移送艾斯的时刻……
lesson_wordStory_598.en: Miraculously survived this ordeal, Luffy actually regained his strength after devouring a lot of food! Ivankov didn't really want to help Luffy to rescue Ace originally. However, after finding out that Luffy was the son of Monkey D. Dragon, he decided to lead everyone from the Nakama to help Luffy. Unfortunately, it's already time to transfer Ace to execution...
lesson_wordStory_598.th: ลูฟี่ได้คืนชีพ หลังจากกินอย่างดุเดือด พลังก็ฟื้นฟูกลับมา! เดิมทีอิวานคอฟไม่ได้ต้องการจะช่วยลูฟี่ หลังจากรู้ว่าลูฟี่เป็นลูกของทัพมังกรบกฏ ตัดสินใจนำทุกคนไปยังสวนเพื่อช่วยลูฟี่ น่าเสียดายที่ถึงเวลาที่ต้องส่งตัวเอส……
lesson_wordStory_598.tw: 奇跡般復活的魯夫，在一陣狂吃猛吃之後，竟然奇跡似的恢復體力了！本來不打算幫助魯夫救出艾斯的伊萬科夫，在得知魯夫是反抗軍龍的兒子之後，決定率領新人類樂園的所有人幫助魯夫，可惜已經到了要移送艾斯的時刻……
lesson_wordStory_598.vi: Luffy hồi sinh một cách thần kỳ, sau khi ăn uống điên cuồng, không ngờ đã lấy lại sức mạnh! Ivankov không có ý định giúp Luffy giải cứu Ace. Sau khi biết Luffy là con trai của Dragon - Quân Cách Mạng, hắn quyết định dẫn tất cả những ai giúp Luffy đến thiên đường loài người mới. Thật không may, đã đến lúc đưa tiễn Ace...
lesson_wordStory_598.de: Ruffy, der auf wundersame Weise auferstanden war, gewann auf wundersame Weise seine Kraft zurück, nachdem er wild gegessen hatte! Ivankov, der nicht vorhatte, Ruffy bei der Rettung von Ace zu helfen, beschloss, alle im neuen menschlichen Paradies zu führen, um Ruffy zu helfen, nachdem er erfahren hatte, dass Ruffy der Sohn des Drachen der Rebellen war. Leider ist es Zeit, Ace zu transferieren...
lesson_wordStory_598.pt: Sobreviveu milagrosamente a essa provação, Luffy realmente recuperou sua força depois de devorar muita comida!  Ivankov realmente não queria ajudar Luffy a resgatar Ace originalmente. No entanto, após descobrir que Luffy era filho de Monkey D. Dragon, ele decidiu liderar todos os Nakama para ajudar Luffy. Infelizmente, já é hora de transferir o Ace para a execução...

lesson_wordStory_602.cn: 历经重重困难，路飞终于到达关着艾斯的第六层，可惜晚了一步，艾斯已经被海军接收，准备押往海军本部，路飞不顾众人反对，执意要前往海军本部救人。而另一边，担心着路飞的艾斯奋起反抗却被麦哲伦镇压……
lesson_wordStory_602.en: After going through many hardships, Luffy finally arrived at Level 6, where Ace is held at. However, he was too late. Ace was already taken away by the Marine, preparing to be sent off to Naval Headquarters. Disregarding everyone's challenge, Luffy insisted on going to the Marine Headquarter to save him. On the other hand, worrying about Luffy, Ace rose to fight back but was suppressed by Magellan...
lesson_wordStory_602.th: ความลำบากที่ผ่านมา ในที่สุดลูฟี่มาถึงชั้น6ที่เอสอยู่ แต่ช้าไปก้าวเดียว เอสถูกทหารเรือจับแล้ว เตรียมส่งตัวไปยังส่วนกลาง ลูฟี่ไม่สนใจการต่อต้านของทุกคน ยืนยันจะไปยังส่วนกลางของทหารเรือ แต่อีกด้านหนึ่ง เอสที่เป็นห่วงลูฟี่ได้ลุกขึ้นมาต่อต้านแต่ถูกแมกเจลแลนขัดขวาง……
lesson_wordStory_602.tw: 歷經重重困難，魯夫終於到達關著艾斯的第六層，可惜晚了一步，艾斯已經被海軍接收，準備押往海軍本部，魯夫不顧眾人反對，執意要前往海軍本部救人。而另一邊，擔心著魯夫的艾斯奮起反抗卻被麥哲倫鎮壓……
lesson_wordStory_602.vi: Sau bao nhiêu khó khăn, cuối cùng Luffy cũng đến được tầng 6 nơi Ace bị giam giữ, không may Ace đã bị hải quân tiếp quản và áp giải tới trụ sở hải quân, bất chấp sự phản đối của mọi người, Luffy nhất quyết đến trụ sở cứu người. Trong diễn biến khác, Ace vì lo lắng cho Luffy, đã vùng lên chống cự nhưng bị Magellan trấn áp...
lesson_wordStory_602.de: Nach vielen Schwierigkeiten erreichte Ruffy schließlich den sechsten Stock, in dem Ace geschlossen war. Leider war Ace von der Marine übernommen worden und ging zum Marinehauptquartier. Trotz des Widerstandes von allen bestand Ruffy darauf, zum Marinehauptquartier zu gehen. Auf der anderen Seite erhob sich Ace, der sich Sorgen um Ruffy machte, wurde aber von Magellan unterdrückt...
lesson_wordStory_602.pt: Depois de passar por muitas dificuldades, Luffy finalmente chegou ao nível 6, onde Ace é mantido. No entanto, ele era tarde demais. Ace já foi levado pela Marinha, preparando-se para ser enviado para o Quartel General da Marinha. Ignorando o desafio de todos, Luffy insistiu em ir ao Quartel General da Marinha para salvá-lo. Por outro lado, preocupado com Luffy, Ace se levantou para revidar, mas foi suprimido por Magellan...

lesson_wordStory_606.cn: 路飞打算从电梯追上去，而电梯已经被狱卒斩断，楼梯也被铁栅栏封住，从上方飘下催眠瓦斯，虽然闪电将楼梯封住隔开了瓦斯，但是现在的情况进退两难，而此时的汉尼拔已经开始在监控室庆祝了。
lesson_wordStory_606.en: Luffy planned to chase up there from the elevator. But the elevator was already cut off by the jailers. The iron fences also block the stairs. The gas came down from the top, although the lightning blocked off the gas with the stairs. However, at this critical moment, Hannyabal has already started to celebrate in the monitoring room.
lesson_wordStory_606.th: ลูฟี่ตั้งใจจะตามลิฟท์ให้ทัน แต่ลิฟท์ได้ถูกทำลาย บันไดก็ถูกกั้นด้วยเหล็ด ก๊าสนอนหลับที่ถูกปล่อยออกมาจากข้างบน แม้ว่าฟ้าผ่ามาให้บันไดและแก๊สแยกจากกัน แต่สถานะการณ์ตอนนี้ยังยากลำบาก ขณะนี้ฮันนิบาลได้อยู่ที่ห้องควบคุมแล้ว
lesson_wordStory_606.tw: 魯夫打算從電梯追上去，而電梯已經被獄卒斬斷，樓梯也被鐵柵欄封住，從上方飄下催眠瓦斯，雖然閃電將樓梯封住隔開了瓦斯，但是現在的情況進退兩難，而此時的般若拔已經開始在監控室慶祝了。
lesson_wordStory_606.vi: Luffy sắp đuổi kịp thang máy thì thang máy đã bị quản giáo chặn đứt, cầu thang cũng bị rào lại, khí gây mê từ trên cao thổi xuống. Mặc dù Inazuma đã chặn cầu thang và ngăn cách khí, nhưng tình hình hiện tại tiến thoái lưỡng nan, Hannibal đã bắt đầu ăn mừng trong phòng giám sát.
lesson_wordStory_606.de: Ruffy wollte vom Aufzug aufholen, aber der Aufzug wurde vom Gefängniswärter abgeschnitten, und die Treppen sind ebenfalls durch Eisenzäune blockiert. Hypnotisches Gas schwimmt von oben herab. Obwohl die Treppen von Blitz abgedichtet sind, ist die aktuelle Situation in einem Dilemma. Hannyabal feierte bereits im Überwachungsraum.
lesson_wordStory_606.pt: Luffy planejou perseguir lá do elevador. Mas o elevador já foi cortado pelos carcereiros. As cercas de ferro também bloqueiam as escadas. O gás desceu do topo, embora o raio bloqueasse o gás com as escadas. Porém, neste momento crítico, Hannyabal já começou a comemorar na sala de monitoramento.

lesson_wordStory_610.cn: 一筹莫展之时，一旁的监狱传来熟悉的声音：“想离开这里就放了我吧”，这个人正是之前将薇薇的国家弄得一塌糊涂的人——克洛克达尔，路飞坚决拒绝，而伊万科夫却说可以将其放了，因为伊万科夫手中有克洛克达尔的把柄。
lesson_wordStory_610.en: When he was at a loss, a familiar voice came from the prison on the side: "If you want to leave here, let me go." The voice was from no one else but the one who brought havoc to Vivi's kingdom before - Crocodile. Luffy firmly refused the offer. But Ivankov suggested that he could be set free because Ivankov has gotten an edge over Crocodile.
lesson_wordStory_610.th: เมื่อทำอะไรไม่ได้ เสียงที่คุ้นเคยดังมาจากคุกข้างๆ:“อยากไปจากที่นี่ก็ปล่อยข้าสิ” คนๆ นี้เคยเป็นคนที่ให้ประเทศวุ่นวาย——ครอคโคไดล์ ลูฟี่ปฏิเสธ แต่อิวานคอฟกลับบอกว่าสามารถปล่อยได้ เพราะว่าในมือของอิวานคอฟมีตะขอของครอคโคไดล์
lesson_wordStory_610.tw: 一籌莫展之時，一旁的監獄傳來熟悉的聲音：“想離開這裡就放了我吧”，這個人正是之前將薇薇的國家弄得一塌糊塗的人——克洛克達爾，魯夫堅決拒絕，而伊萬科夫卻說可以將其放了，因為伊萬科夫手中有克洛克達爾的把柄。
lesson_wordStory_610.vi: Trong lúc đang cùng đường, bỗng phòng giam bên cạnh vang lên giọng nói quen thuộc: “Muốn rời khỏi nơi này thì hãy thả ta ra”, đây chính là kẻ đã hủy hoại đất nước của Vivi: Sir Crocodile, Luffy kiên quyết từ chối, nhưng Ivankov lại nói có thể thả hắn ra, vì Ivankov đang nắm thóp Crocodile.
lesson_wordStory_610.de: Als sie ratlos waren, kam eine vertraute Stimme aus dem Gefängnis nebenbei: „Wenn ihr hier abreisen wollen, lasst mich gehen.“ Diese Person hat Vivis Land zuvor durcheinander gebracht - Crocodile, Ruffy lehnte ab. Aber Ivankov sagte, er könnte losgelassen werden, weil Ivankov Crocodiles Griff hatte.
lesson_wordStory_610.pt: Quando ele estava perdido, uma voz familiar veio da prisão ao lado: “Se você quiser sair daqui, deixe-me ir.” A voz não era de ninguém além daquele que trouxe destruição ao reino de Vivi antes - Crocodilo. Luffy recusou firmemente a oferta. Mas Ivankov sugeriu que ele poderia ser libertado porque Ivankov conseguiu uma vantagem sobre Crocodilo.

lesson_wordStory_614.cn: 而这时另一边监狱里的人也请求路飞将他放了，“我想要救艾斯先生，拜托了请让我死得其所”，这人正是七武海海侠甚平，甚平在艾斯加入白胡子海贼团之前便与他相识了，随着两位前任七武海的加入路飞的越狱队伍更加壮大了……
lesson_wordStory_614.en: At the same time, another person in prison on the other side also asked Luffy to set him free, "I want to save sir Ace as well, please grand my death wish." This person is the “knight of the sea”, Jinbe. Jinbe already befriended Ace before joining the White Beard Pirates, and with the addition of the two former Shichibukai, Luffy's prison break team grew stronger...
lesson_wordStory_614.th: ขณะนี้คนจากคุกอีกด้านหนึ่งขอให้ลูฟี่ปล่อยเขา“ฉันต้องการช่วยเอส ขอให้ฉันได้ตายอย่างมีประโยชน์เถอะ” คนนี้คือ7เทพโจรสลัดจินเบ จินเบเคยพบกับเอสก่อนเข้าร่วมกลุ่มโจรสลัดหนวดขาว ด้วยภารกิจของทั้งคู่ได้เข้าร่วมทีมของลูฟี่……
lesson_wordStory_614.tw: 而這時另一邊監獄裡的人也請求魯夫將他放了，“我想要救艾斯先生，拜託了請讓我死得其所”，這人正是七武海海俠吉貝爾，吉貝爾在艾斯加入白鬍子海賊團之前便與他相識了，隨著兩位前任七武海的加入魯夫的越獄隊伍更加壯大了……
lesson_wordStory_614.vi: Lúc này, người trong nhà tù bên kia cũng xin Luffy thả anh ta ra, “Tôi muốn cứu ngài Ace, xin hãy để tôi chết có ý nghĩa” Người này là Jinbe của Thất Vũ Hải. Trước khi Ace gia nhập băng Râu Trắng đã quen biết Jinbe, nhờ có 2 người của Thất Vũ Hải gia nhập, đội vượt ngục của Luffy ngày càng lớn mạnh...
lesson_wordStory_614.de: Zu diesem Zeitpunkt baten der Mensch im Gefängnis auf der anderen Seite auch Ruffy, ihn freizulassen: „Ich möchte Ace retten, bitte lass mich richtig sterben.“ Diese Person ist Sieben Samurai Jinbe. Bevor Jinbe sich Ace an Whitebeard Piratenbande schließt, hatte er ihn schon einmal getroffen. Mit dem Zusammenschluss der beiden ehemaligen Sieben Samurai wurde Ruffys Team stärker...
lesson_wordStory_614.pt: Ao mesmo tempo, outra pessoa na prisão do outro lado também pediu a Luffy para libertá-lo, “Eu também quero salvar o senhor Ace, por favor, conceda meu desejo de morte.” Essa pessoa é o “cavaleiro do mar”, Jinbe. Jinbe já era amigo de Ace antes de se juntar aos Piratas do Barba Branca, e com a adição dos dois ex-Shichibukai, a equipe de fuga da prisão de Luffy ficou mais forte...

lesson_wordStory_618.cn: 路飞一行人到达了第四层，与众多狱卒产生了冲突，为了给越狱创造更多的机会，伊万科夫将四层的囚犯都放了出来，而另一边，巴基和Mr.3也将第二层的所有囚犯放了出来，监狱陷入一片混乱……
lesson_wordStory_618.en: Luffy and the others made it to Level 4 and started fighting against many jailers. To create more opportunities for the prison break, Ivankov set every prisoner of Level 4 free. On the other hand, Buggy and Mr. 3 also set every prisoner of Level 2 free, causing chaos in prison...
lesson_wordStory_618.th: ลูฟี่ได้มาถึงชั้น4 เกิดการต่อสู้กับผู้คุม เพื่อสร้างโอกาสที่จะทะลวงไปในคุก อิวานคอฟได้ปล่อยนักโทษชั้นที่4ออกมา อีกด้านหนึ่ง บากี้และMr.3ก็ได้ปล่อยนักโทษชั้นที่3ออกมาเช่นเดียวกัน คุกได้เกิดความโกลาหลขึ้น……
lesson_wordStory_618.tw: 魯夫一行人到達了第四層，與眾多獄卒產生了衝突，為了給越獄創造更多的機會，伊萬科夫將四層的囚犯都放了出來，而另一邊，巴基和Mr.3也將第二層的所有囚犯放了出來，監獄陷入一片混亂……
lesson_wordStory_618.vi: Luffy và đồng bọn lên đến tầng 4 và đụng độ với nhiều cai ngục, để tạo thêm cơ hội vượt ngục, Ivankov đã thả tất cả tù nhân ở tầng 4. Trong khi đó, Buggy và Mr.3. cũng thả tất cả tù nhân tầng 2, nhà tù rơi vào hỗn loạn ...
lesson_wordStory_618.de: Ruffy und sein Team erreichten den vierten Stock und stießen mit vielen Gefängniswärtern zusammen. Um mehr Fluchtmöglichkeiten zu schaffen, ließ Ivankov alle Gefangenen im vierten Stock frei. Auf der anderen Seite ließen Buggy und Mr.3. auch alle Gefangenen im zweiten Stock frei, und das Gefängnis fiel ins Chaos...
lesson_wordStory_618.pt: Luffy e os outros chegaram ao nível 4 e começaram a lutar contra muitos carcereiros. Para criar mais oportunidades para a fuga da prisão, Ivankov libertou todos os prisioneiros do Nível 4. Por outro lado, Buggy e Sr. 3 também libertaram todos os prisioneiros do Nível 2, causando o caos na prisão...

lesson_wordStory_622.cn: 第二层与第四层同时发生暴动，汉尼拔夹在中间不知道去支援哪里，绝望之际汉尼拔接到了来自麦哲伦的通话，此时的麦哲伦已经将二楼的暴动镇压，并且做出一项令人震惊的决定——释放雨之希留……
lesson_wordStory_622.en: A revolt started at the same time in Level 2 and Level 4. Hannyabal didn't know where to go, being stuck in the middle. In a moment of desperation, Hannyabal received a call from Magellan. It turned out that Magellan has already suppressed the uprising in Level 2, and he made a surprising decision - set Shiryu of Rain free...
lesson_wordStory_622.th: ชั้นที่2และชั้นที่4เกิดการระเบิด ฮันนิบาลที่อยู่ตรงกลางไม่รู้ว่าจะต้องไปช่วยชั้นไหน ฮันนิบาลที่กำลังสิ้นหวังได้รับสายจากแมกเจลแลน ขณะนั้นแมกเจลแลนได้จัดการการจลาจลที่ชั้น2แล้ว และได้ตัดสินใจทำในสิ่งที่น่าตกใจ——ปล่อยฝนชิริว……
lesson_wordStory_622.tw: 第二層與第四層同時發生暴動，般若拔夾在中間不知道去支援哪裡，絕望之際般若拔接到了來自麥哲倫的通話，此時的麥哲倫已經將二樓的暴動鎮壓，並且做出一項令人震驚的決定——釋放雨之矢龍……
lesson_wordStory_622.vi: Ở tầng 2 và tầng 4 cùng lúc xảy ra bạo loạn, Hannibal bị kẹt ở giữa không biết dựa vào đâu, trong tuyệt vọng, Hannibal nhận được cuộc gọi từ Magellan, lúc này Magellan đã dập tắt cuộc bạo loạn trên tầng 2 và có quyết định gây sốc: thả Shiliew...
lesson_wordStory_622.de: Es gab gleichzeitig Unruhen im zweiten und vierten Stock. Hannyabal wusste nicht, wo er unterstützen sollte. In seiner Verzweiflung erhielt Hannyabal einen Anruf von Magellan. Zu diesem Zeitpunkt hatte Magellan den Aufstand im zweiten Stock unterdrückt. Eine schockierende Entscheidung wird getroffen, Shiryu freizulassen...
lesson_wordStory_622.pt: Uma revolta começou ao mesmo tempo no Nível 2 e no Nível 4. Hannyabal não sabia para onde ir, ficando preso no meio. Em um momento de desespero, Hannyabal recebeu uma ligação de Magellan. Descobriu-se que Magellan já suprimiu a revolta no Nível 2 e tomou uma decisão surpreendente - libertou Shiryu da Chuva...

lesson_wordStory_626.cn: 被释放的希留来到了推进城一层，遇到了黑胡子一行人，出人意料的是一层断开了通讯，似乎事情并没有麦哲伦想的那么简单……
lesson_wordStory_626.en: The free Shiryu has come to Level 1 of Impel Down and ran into Blackbeard and the other people. Surprisingly, Level 1 has broken the communication. It seems like things aren't as simple as what Magellan has thought...
lesson_wordStory_626.th: ชิริวที่ถูกปล่อยออกมา มาถึงคุกนรกอิมเพลดาวน์ชั้นที่1แล้ว ได้พบกับหมวดดำ ชั้น1ได้ถูกตัดสัญญาณไป เหมือนกับว่าเรื่องจะไม่ง่ายเหมือนกับที่แมกเจลแลนคิด……
lesson_wordStory_626.tw: 被釋放的矢龍來到了推進城一層，遇到了黑鬍子一行人，出人意料的是一層斷開了通訊，似乎事情並沒有麥哲倫想的那麼簡單……
lesson_wordStory_626.vi: Shiliew được thả vào tầng 1 của Impel Down và gặp nhóm Râu Đen, thật bất ngờ khi tầng 1 bị ngắt liên lạc, có vẻ như mọi chuyện không đơn giản như Magellan nghĩ...
lesson_wordStory_626.de: Der freigelassene Shiryu kam in den ersten Stock und traf Blackbeard und seine Gruppe. Unerwartet war der erste Stock von der Kommunikation getrennt. Es schien, dass die Dinge nicht so einfach waren, wie Magellan dachte...
lesson_wordStory_626.pt: O recém liberto Shiryu chegou ao Nível 1 de Impel Down e encontrou Barba Negra e as outras pessoas. Surpreendentemente, o Nível 1 quebrou a comunicação. Parece que as coisas não são tão simples como Magellan pensou...

lesson_wordStory_630.cn: 眼看路飞等人即将突破第四层，没想到却在通往第三层的楼梯口遭遇汉尼拔的阻挠！即使被打倒在地，汉尼拔凭着意志力就是不让路飞过去！
lesson_wordStory_630.en: Luffy and the other were about to break through Level 4, but they were surprised to find themselves intercepted by Hannyabal at the stairs towards Level 3! About to be knocked on the floor, Hannyabal managed to stop Luffy and the others with his sheer will power!
lesson_wordStory_630.th: ดูเหมือนลูฟี่และคนอื่นๆ กำลังจะทะลวงชั้นที่4 ไม่คิดว่าบันไดที่จะไปยังชั้นที่3มีฮันนิบาลขัดขวางอยู่! แม้ว่าจะทำให้ล้มกับพื้น ยังไงฮันนิบาลก็ไม่ยอมให้ลูฟี่ผ่านไปได้!
lesson_wordStory_630.tw: 眼看魯夫等人即將突破第四層，沒想到卻在通往第三層的樓梯口遭遇般若拔的阻撓！即使被打倒在地，般若拔憑著意志力就是不讓魯夫過去！
lesson_wordStory_630.vi: Đám người Luffy chuẩn bị đột phá tầng 4, không ngờ lại gặp phải sự cản trở của Hannibal ở cầu thang tầng 3! Ngay cả khi bị hạ gục, Hannibal vẫn kiên quyết không buông tha Luffy!
lesson_wordStory_630.de: Als Ruffy und andere den vierten Stock durchbrechen wollten, hatten sie nicht erwartet, Hannyabals Hindernis oben auf der Treppe zum dritten Stock zu begegnen! Auch wenn er zu Boden geworfen wurde, weigerte sich Hannyabal, Ruffy vorbeizulassen!
lesson_wordStory_630.pt: Luffy e os outros estavam prestes a romper o Nível 4, mas ficaram surpresos ao serem interceptados por Hannyabal nas escadas em direção ao Nível 3!  Prestes a ser derrubado no chão, Hannyabal conseguiu parar Luffy e os outros com sua força de vontade!

lesson_wordStory_634.cn: 就在打倒汉尼拔的时候，神秘的黑胡子海贼团出现在路飞等人面前。得知黑胡子就是害艾斯被抓的罪魁祸首，路飞气得想击倒黑胡子，但是却被甚平挡下！为了救出艾斯，甚平告诉路飞不能感情用事，在这里浪费时间跟体力。而这个时候，在后头追赶的麦哲伦也赶到了……
lesson_wordStory_634.en: When Hannyabal is about to be defeated, the mysterious Black Beard Pirates has appeared in front of Luffy. Learning that Blackbeard was the culprit who caused Ace to be captured, Luffy was angered and tried to defeat Blackbeard. But he was defeated by Jinbe! In order to save Ace, Jinbe told Luffy that he couldn't be so reckless and let his emotion take over him, instead of wasting time and stamina. At this moment, the pursuing Magellan has arrived as well...
lesson_wordStory_634.th: ขณะที่ฮันนิบาลล้มลง กลุ่มโจมสลัดหนวดดำได้ปรากฏขึ้นต่อหน้าลูฟี่และคนอื่นๆ หนวดดำเป็นคนที่ทำให้เอสถูกจับ ลูฟี่ต้องการต่อสูกับหนวดดำ แต่ถูกจินเบขวางไว้! เพื่อช่วยเอส จินเบบอกกับลูฟี่ว่าห้ามใช้ความรู้สึกส่วนตัว อยู่ที่นี่เสียทั้งเวลาและกำลัง แต่ในตอนนั้น ฮันนิบาลที่ตามมาด้านหลัง……
lesson_wordStory_634.tw: 就在打倒般若拔的時候，神秘的黑鬍子海賊團出現在魯夫等人面前。得知黑鬍子就是害艾斯被抓的罪魁禍首，魯夫氣得想擊倒黑鬍子，但是卻被吉貝爾擋下！為了救出艾斯，吉貝爾告訴魯夫不能感情用事，在這裡浪費時間跟體力。而這個時候，在後頭追趕的麥哲倫也趕到了……
lesson_wordStory_634.vi: Khi đánh bại Hannibal, băng hải tặc Râu Đen thần bí xuất hiện trước mặt nhóm người Luffy. Biết Râu Đen là tên đầu sỏ hại Ace bị bắt, Luffy nổi giận muốn đánh bại Râu Đen nhưng Jinbe đã cản lại! Để cứu Ace, Jinbe bảo Luffy không thể hành động bốc đồng, đừng ở đây lãng phí thời gian và sức lực. Lúc này, Magellan đã đuổi đến nơi...
lesson_wordStory_634.de: Gerade als Hannyabal besiegt wurde, erschienen die mysteriösen Blackbeard Piratenbande vor Ruffy und den anderen. Als Ruffy wusste, dass Blackbeard der Schuldige für Aces Verhaftung war, war er so wütend, dass er Blackbeard niederschlagen wollte, aber von Jinbe gestoppt wurde!  Um Ace zu retten, sagte Jinbe zu Ruffy, er sollte nicht emotional sein und hier Zeit und Energie verschwenden. Zu dieser Zeit kam auch Magellan, der hinterher jagte...
lesson_wordStory_634.pt: Quando Hannyabal está prestes a ser derrotado, os misteriosos Piratas do Barba Negra aparecem na frente de Luffy.  Ao saber que Barba Negra foi o culpado que causou a captura de Ace, Luffy ficou furioso e tentou derrotar Barba Negra. Mas ele foi derrotado por Jinbe! A fim de salvar Ace, Jinbe disse a Luffy que ele não poderia ser tão imprudente e deixou sua emoção tomar conta dele, em vez de perder tempo e resistência.  Neste momento, o perseguidor Magellan também chegou...

lesson_wordStory_638.cn: 最强的地狱老大麦哲伦来了！就在路飞跟黑胡子对峙的时候，麦哲伦从后头追击而至。为了让路飞能顺利逃脱，伊万科夫和闪电自愿留下挡住麦哲伦的脚步。路飞率领众人终于来到第一层，并且和巴基等人会合！
lesson_wordStory_638.en: The strongest boss from hell, Magellan, is here! When Luffy is confronting Blackbeard, Magellan caught up with him. To let Luffy get away safely, Ivankov and Inazuma volunteered to stay to stop Magellan. Finally, Luffy led everyone to come to Level 1 and reunited with Buggy and the others!
lesson_wordStory_638.th: ท่านแมกเจลแลนที่แข็งแกร่งมาแล้ว! ขณะที่ลูฟี่เผชิญหน้ากับหนวดดำ แมกเจลแลนไล่มาจากด้านหลังจนถึง เพื่อให้ลูฟี่ตามไปได้ อิวานคิฟและสายฟ้าได้ทิ้งลอยเท้าของแมกเจลแลนไว้ ในที่สุดลูฟี่ก็มาถึงชั้นที่1 รวมตัวกับบากี้และคนอื่นๆ
lesson_wordStory_638.tw: 最強的地獄老大麥哲倫來了！就在魯夫跟黑鬍子對峙的時候，麥哲倫從後頭追擊而至。為了讓魯夫能順利逃脫，伊萬科夫和閃電自願留下擋住麥哲倫的腳步。魯夫率領眾人終於來到第一層，並且和巴基等人會合！
lesson_wordStory_638.vi: Trùm địa ngục mạnh nhất Magellan đang ở đây! Khi Luffy đối đầu với Râu Đen, Magellan đã đuổi đến. Để giúp Luffy trốn thoát, Ivankov và Inazuma đã tự nguyện ở lại chặn Magellan. Luffy cuối cùng đã dẫn đầu đám đông lên tầng 1, gặp Buggy và những người khác!
lesson_wordStory_638.de: Der stärkste Höllenboss Magellan ist da! Als Ruffy Blackbeard konfrontierte, verfolgte Magellan ihn von hinten. Um Ruffy reibungslos entkommen zu lassen, blieben Ivankov und Blitz freiwillig zurück, um Magellans Schritte zu blockieren. Ruffy führte die Menge schließlich in den ersten Stock und schloss sich Buggy und anderen an!
lesson_wordStory_638.pt: O chefe mais forte do inferno, Magellan, está aqui!  Quando Luffy está confrontando Barba Negra, Magellan o alcança.  Para deixar Luffy fugir com segurança, Ivankov e Inazuma se ofereceram para ficar para parar Magellan. Finalmente, Luffy levou todos para o Nível 1 e se reuniu com Buggy e os outros!

lesson_wordStory_642.cn: 路飞率领的新人类军团跟巴基带领的囚犯们在第一层会合了！为了把这群人困在推进城,麦哲伦下令要所有的军舰远离,不过克洛克达尔以及Mr.1、巴基依然靠着甚平的帮忙,成功跳上一艘军舰！另一方面,为了替甚平争取抢夺军舰的时间,路飞守在第一层牵制着麦哲伦！
lesson_wordStory_642.en: The Nakama army led by Luffy and the inmates led by Buggy finally reunited at Level 1! To trap these people in Impel Down, Magellan ordered every marine ship to stay away. However, Crocodile, Mr. 1, and Buggy still manage to hop on a ship with the help of Jinbe! On the other hand, in order to buy more time for Jinbe to capture a marine ship, Luffy held off against Magellan at Level 1!
lesson_wordStory_642.th: กองทัพที่นำโดยลูฟี่และนักโทษที่นำโดยบากี่ได้นัดเจอกันชั้นที่1 เพื่อให้คนกลุ่มนี้ได้ทรมานในคุกนรกอิมเพลดาวน์ แมกเจลแลนสั่งให้เรือรบทั้งหมดออกห่าง เพียงแต่ด้วยการช่วยของจินเบ ครอคโคไดล์และMr.1 บากี้ยังได้กระโดดมายังเรือรบสำเร็จ! อีกด้านหนึ่ง เพื่อถ่วงเวลาให้จินเบชิงเรือรบมา ลูฟี่จะต้องจับแมกเจลแลนที่ชั้น1
lesson_wordStory_642.tw: 魯夫率領的新人類軍團跟巴基帶領的囚犯們在第一層會合了！為了把這群人困在推進城,麥哲倫下令要所有的軍艦遠離,不過克洛克達爾以及Mr.1、巴基依然靠著吉貝爾的幫忙,成功跳上一艘軍艦！另一方面,為了替吉貝爾爭取搶奪軍艦的時間,魯夫守在第一層牽制著麥哲倫！
lesson_wordStory_642.vi: Đội quân con người mới do Luffy dẫn đầu và các tù nhân do Buggy dẫn đầu gặp nhau ở tầng một! Để nhốt họ ở Impel Down, Magellan đã ra lệnh cho tất cả tàu chiến tránh xa, nhưng Sir Crocodile và Mr.1, Buggy nhờ sự trợ giúp của Jinbe đã nhảy lên tàu chiến thành công! Mặt khác, để câu giờ cho Jinbe cướp tàu chiến, Luffy ở tầng 1 giữ chân Magellan!
lesson_wordStory_642.de: Ruffy führte die neue menschliche Armee und schloss sich die von Buggy geführten Gefangenen im ersten Stock an! Um diese Gruppe von Menschen in Impel Down zu fangen, befahl Magellan allen Kriegsschiffen, sich fernzuhalten, aber Crocodile und Mr.1, Buggy verlassen sich immer noch auf Jinbes Hilfe, um erfolgreich auf ein Kriegsschiff zu springen! Um die Zeit für Jinbe zu gewinnen, das Kriegsschiff zu schnappen, kämpfte Ruffy Magellan im ersten Stock!
lesson_wordStory_642.pt: O exército Nakama liderado por Luffy e os presos liderados por Buggy finalmente se reuniram no Nível 1! Para prender essas pessoas em Impel Down, Magellan ordenou que todos os navios da marinha ficassem longe. No entanto, Crocodilo, Sr. 1 e Buggy ainda conseguem embarcar em um navio com a ajuda de Jinbe! Por outro lado, a fim de ganhar mais tempo para Jinbe capturar um navio da marinha, Luffy resistiu contra Magellan no nível 1!

lesson_wordStory_646.cn: 受到路飞攻击而节节败退的麦哲伦,终于决定施展最后的禁忌绝招毒之巨兵！这是连推进城都能毁灭的绝招,路飞等人被困在出口前动弹不得。所幸,伊万科夫带着闪电赶来,利用地狱WINK帮助所有人逃离推进城。坠入大海的路飞等人又该如何得救呢？
lesson_wordStory_646.en: Under the fierce attack from Luffy and gradually losing his ground, Magellan finally decided to unleash the final forbidden move, the Venom Demon! This is a move that can even bring down Impel Down, Luffy and the others were pinned down at the exit. Luckily, Ivankov came with Inazuma, aiding everyone to flee from Impel Down with the help of Hell WNK. How should Luffy and the others get saved after falling into the ocean?
lesson_wordStory_646.th: แมกเจลแลนที่ถูกลูฟี่โจมตีค่อยๆ ถอย จนในที่สุดต้องใช้ท่าไม้ตายต้องห้าม! นี่เป็นท่าไม้ตายที่สามารถทำลายคุกนรกอิมเพลดาวน์ได้ ลูฟี่และคนอื่นๆ ติดอยู่ที่หน้าทางออก โชคดีที่อิวานคอฟมาพร้อมกับสายฟ้า ใช้นัก WINK ช่วยทุกคนหนีออกมาจากคุกนรกอิมเพลดาวน์ ลูฟี่และคนอื่นๆ ที่ตกลงไปในทะเลจะรอดได้อย่างไร?
lesson_wordStory_646.tw: 受到魯夫攻擊而節節敗退的麥哲倫,終於決定施展最後的禁忌絕招毒之巨兵！這是連推進城都能毀滅的絕招,魯夫等人被困在出口前動彈不得。所幸,伊萬科夫帶著閃電趕來,利用地獄WINK幫助所有人逃離推進城。墜入大海的魯夫等人又該如何得救呢？
lesson_wordStory_646.vi: Magellan bị Luffy đánh bại, đã quyết định sử dụng tuyệt chiêu cuối cùng Venom Demon! Tuyệt chiêu này có thể hủy diệt cả Impel Down, Luffy và những người khác bị mắc kẹt trước lối ra. May mắn thay, Ivankov đã dẫn Inazuma đến và sử dụng Hell WINK giúp mọi người thoát khỏi đó. Đám người Luffy đã rơi xuống biển, làm thế nào cứu đây?
lesson_wordStory_646.de: Magellan, der von Ruffys Angriff besiegt wurde, entschied sich schließlich für den letzten verbotenen Trick - Giftriese!  Es ist ein Trick, der sogar die Stadt zerstören kann. Ruffy und andere sind vor dem Ausgang gefangen und können sich nicht bewegen. Glücklicherweise kam Ivankov mit Blitz und benutzte die Hölle WINK, um allen zu helfen, aus der Stadt zu fliehen. Wie werden Ruffy und andere gerettet, die ins Meer gefallen sind?
lesson_wordStory_646.pt: Sob o ataque feroz de Luffy e gradualmente perdendo seu terreno, Magellan finalmente decidiu liberar o último movimento proibido, o Venneno Demônio!  Este é um movimento que pode até derrubar Impel Down, Luffy e os outros foram presos na saída. Felizmente, Ivankov veio com Inazuma, ajudando todos a fugir de Impel Down com a ajuda de Inferno WINK. Como Luffy e os outros devem ser salvos depois de cair no oceano?

rewardList_description_2.cn: 揭穿克洛的阴谋，保护无辜的人
rewardList_description_2.en: Expose Kuro's scheme and protect the innocent people
rewardList_description_2.th: รู้แผนชั่วของคุโระ ปกป้องผู้บริสุทธิ์
rewardList_description_2.tw: 揭穿克洛的陰謀，保護無辜的人
rewardList_description_2.vi: Vạch trần âm mưu của Kuro, bảo vệ người vô tội
rewardList_description_2.de: Durchschaue die Verschwörung von Kuro, und beschütze die Unschuldigen
rewardList_description_2.pt: Expor o esquema de Kuro e proteger os inocentes

rewardList_description_4.cn: 帮助小八实现开设章鱼烧店的愿望
rewardList_description_4.en: Help Hatchan complete his wish to start Takoyaki store
rewardList_description_4.th: ใครช่วยฮาจิทำความฝันร้านทาโกะยากิ
rewardList_description_4.tw: 幫助小八實現開設章魚燒店的願望
rewardList_description_4.vi: Giúp Hachi thực hiện nguyện vọng mở tiệm bán Takoyaki
rewardList_description_4.de: Erfülle für Okta den Wunsch, einen Takoyaki-Laden zu eröffnen
rewardList_description_4.pt: Ajude Hatchan a realizar seu desejo de abrir a loja Takoyaki

rewardList_description_6.cn: 击败称霸东海的阿龙，解救可可西亚村的村民
rewardList_description_6.en: Defeat Arlong who is ravaging in East Sea and liberate the villagers of Cocoyasi Village
rewardList_description_6.th: เอาชนะอารอนที่เป็นใหญ่ในอีสต์บลู ช่วยชาวบ้านในหมู่บ้านโกซา
rewardList_description_6.tw: 擊敗稱霸東海的惡龍，解救可哥西亞村的村民
rewardList_description_6.vi: Đánh bại Arlong xưng bá Đông Hải, giải cứu dân làng trên Đảo Conomi
rewardList_description_6.de: Besiege Arlong des Ostmeers, rette die Dorfbewohner von Nojiko
rewardList_description_6.pt: Derrote Arlong que está destruindo o Mar do Leste e liberte os aldeões da Vila Cocoyasi

rewardList_description_8.cn: 帮助海上餐厅，抵御克利克的攻击
rewardList_description_8.en: Help Floating Restaurant to defend against Krieg's attack
rewardList_description_8.th: ช่วยเหลือภัตตาคารลอยทะเล ต้านการโจมตีของครีก
rewardList_description_8.tw: 幫助海上餐廳，抵禦克利克的攻擊
rewardList_description_8.vi: Giúp Nhà Hàng Trên Biển, chống lại sự tấn công của Krieg
rewardList_description_8.de: Hilfe dem See-Restaurant und widerstehe den Angriff von Creek
rewardList_description_8.pt: Ajude o Restaurante Flutuante a se defender do ataque de Krieg

rewardList_description_10.cn: 瓦尔波在冬岛实行非人的统治，推翻他给东岛人民自由
rewardList_description_10.en: Wapol started his cruel ruling on Drum Island, overthrow him to give the freedom back to the people of Drum Island
rewardList_description_10.th: วาโปลูปกครองเกาะน้ำแข็ง โค่นล้มเขาคืนอิสระแก่ชาวอีสต์บลู
rewardList_description_10.tw: 瓦波爾在冬島實行非人的統治，推翻他給東島人民自由
rewardList_description_10.vi: Wapol cai trị Đảo Đông một cách vô nhân đạo, hãy lật đổ ông ta trả lại tự do cho người dân đảo
rewardList_description_10.de: Wapol übte auf Winterinsel eine unmenschliche Herrschaft aus. Stürze ihn, um den Menschen auf Ostinsel Freiheit zu geben.
rewardList_description_10.pt: Wapol começou sua decisão cruel na Ilha Drum, acabe com ele para devolver a liberdade ao povo da Ilha Drum

rewardList_description_12.cn: 击败达斯琪，逃离海军的追捕
rewardList_description_12.en: Defeat Tashigi and escape from Marine‘s chasing
rewardList_description_12.th: เอาชนะทาชิงิ หนีการไล่ล่าของกองทัพเรือ
rewardList_description_12.tw: 擊敗達絲琪，逃離海軍的追捕
rewardList_description_12.vi: Đánh bại Tashigi, thoát khỏi sự truy đuổi của Hải Quân
rewardList_description_12.de: Besiege Daschi, hänge die Marine ab
rewardList_description_12.pt: Derrote Tashigi e escape da perseguição da Marinha

rewardList_description_14.cn: 帮助乌索普修理黄金梅丽号
rewardList_description_14.en: Help Usopp fix the Going Merry
rewardList_description_14.th: ช่วยเหลืออุซปในการซ่อมแซมโกอิ้ง แมรี่
rewardList_description_14.tw: 幫助騙人布修理黃金梅麗號
rewardList_description_14.vi: Giúp Usopp sửa chữa Going Merry
rewardList_description_14.de: Hilf Lysop bei der Reparatur von Goldene Meri
rewardList_description_14.pt: Ajude o Usopp a consertar o Going Merry

rewardList_description_16.cn: 小丑巴基在东海持续骚扰附近岛屿的居民，打败他可以获得丰厚的奖励
rewardList_description_16.en: Buggy the Star Clown has been harassing the residence of the nearby islands in the east sea. Defeat him to gain ample rewards
rewardList_description_16.th: โจ๊กเกอร์บากี้ยังคงก่อกวนผู้อาศัยในเกาะใกล้เคียงอีสต์บลู เอาชนะเขาจะได้รับรางวัลมากมาย
rewardList_description_16.tw: 小丑巴基在東海持續騷擾附近島嶼的居民，打敗他可以獲得豐厚的獎勵
rewardList_description_16.vi: Chú hề Buggy liên tục quấy rối cư dân các đảo lân cận ở Đông Hải, đánh bại hắn sẽ nhận thưởng phong phú
rewardList_description_16.de: Buggy der Clown belästigt weiterhin die Bewohner der nahe gelegenen Inseln im Ostmeer. Wenn er besiegt wird, kann man reichhaltige Belohnungen erhalten.
rewardList_description_16.pt: Buggy, o Clown, tem assediado a residência das ilhas próximas no mar do leste. Derrote-o para ganhar recompensas

rewardList_description_18.cn: 和冯·克雷建立深厚的友谊
rewardList_description_18.en: Build deep friendship with Bon Kurei
rewardList_description_18.th: สร้างมิตรภาพกับเบนเฮม
rewardList_description_18.tw: 和彭·格列建立深厚的友誼
rewardList_description_18.vi: Xây dựng tình bạn khắng khít với Bentham
rewardList_description_18.de: Erstelle mit Bentham eine tiefe Freundschaft
rewardList_description_18.pt: Construa uma amizade profunda com Bon Kurei

rewardList_description_20.cn: 帮助路飞逃脱斯摩格的追捕
rewardList_description_20.en: Help Luffy evade from Smoker's pursuit
rewardList_description_20.th: ช่วยลูฟี่หนีจากการไล่ล่าของสโมคเกอร์
rewardList_description_20.tw: 幫助魯夫逃脫史莫卡的追捕
rewardList_description_20.vi: Giúp Luffy thoát khỏi sự truy đuổi của Smoker
rewardList_description_20.de: Hilf Ruffy, die Verfolgung von Smoker abzuhängen
rewardList_description_20.pt: Ajude Luffy a fugir da perseguição de Smoker

rewardList_description_22.cn: 帮助薇薇搜集巴洛克工作室的情报
rewardList_description_22.en: Help Vivi collect intelligence of Baroque Workshop
rewardList_description_22.th: ช่วยเหลือวีวี่ค้นหาข่าวจากบาร็อกเวิร์ค
rewardList_description_22.tw: 幫助薇薇搜集巴羅克工作室的情報
rewardList_description_22.vi: Giúp Vivi thu thập tình báo của Baroque Work
rewardList_description_22.de: Hilf Vivi bei der Suche nach den Informationen der Baroque Firma
rewardList_description_22.pt: Ajude Vivi a coletar informações da Baroque Workshop

rewardList_description_24.cn: 躲避巴洛克工作室的追杀
rewardList_description_24.th: ซ่อนจากการล่าสังหารของบาร็อกเวิร์ค
rewardList_description_24.tw: 躲避巴羅克工作室的追殺
rewardList_description_24.vi: Tránh đòn truy sát của Baroque Works
rewardList_description_24.de: Entkomme der Verfolgung der Baroque Firma
rewardList_description_24.pt: Evite a perseguição a Oficina Baroque

rewardList_description_26.cn: 鳄鱼秘密谋划夺取阿拉巴斯坦王国，揭穿他的阴谋
rewardList_description_26.en: Crocodile plotted to seize the kingdom of Alabasta. Expose his scheme
rewardList_description_26.th: ครอคโคไดล์มีแผนลับยึดอาณาจักรอลาบัสต้า เปิดโปงแผนชั่วของเขา
rewardList_description_26.tw: 鱷魚秘密謀劃奪取阿拉巴斯坦王國，揭穿他的陰謀
rewardList_description_26.vi: Crocodile bí mật chiếm lấy Vương Quốc Alabasta, hãy vạch trần âm mưu của hắn
rewardList_description_26.de: Sir Crocodile plant eine Verschwörung, um das Königreich Alabasta zu erobern. Decke seine wahren Absichten auf
rewardList_description_26.pt: Crocodilo conspirou para tomar o reino de Alabasta. Exponha seu esquema

rewardList_description_28.cn: 帮助罗完成他的复仇计划
rewardList_description_28.en: Help Law complete his revenge plan
rewardList_description_28.th: ช่วยลอว์ทำแผนการแก้แค้นได้สำเร็จ
rewardList_description_28.tw: 幫助羅完成他的復仇計畫
rewardList_description_28.vi: Giúp Law hoàn thành kế hoạch phục thù của hắn
rewardList_description_28.pt: Ajude Law a completar seu plano de vingança

rewardList_description_30.cn: 阻止CP9意图夺取古代兵器图纸的阴谋
rewardList_description_30.en: Stop CP9's scheme to seize the blueprint of the ancient weapon
rewardList_description_30.th: ขัดขวางแผนของCP9ในการชิงแบบแปลนอาวุธโบราณ
rewardList_description_30.tw: 阻止CP9意圖奪取古代兵器圖紙的陰謀
rewardList_description_30.vi: Ngăn cản âm mưu đoạt bản vẽ binh khí cổ của CP9
rewardList_description_30.de: Verhindere die Intrige von CP9, Zeichnungen der alten Waffen wegzunehmen
rewardList_description_30.pt: Pare o esquema do CP9 para ganhar o projeto da arma antiga

rewardList_description_32.cn: 寻找并击败莫利亚，解救被他剪掉影子的人
rewardList_description_32.en: Search and defeat Moria to liberate the people whose shadows were cut by him
rewardList_description_32.th: ค้นหาและเอาชนะโมเรีย ช่วยคนที่ถูกเขาตัดเงา
rewardList_description_32.tw: 尋找並擊敗摩利亞，解救被他剪掉影子的人
rewardList_description_32.vi: Tìm và đánh bại Moriah, giải cứu người bị hắn cắt mất bóng
rewardList_description_32.de: Finde und besiege Moria, um die Personen zu retten, deren Schatten von ihm abgeschnitten wurde
rewardList_description_32.pt: Procure e derrote Moria para libertar as pessoas cujas sombras foram cortadas por ele

rewardList_description_34.cn: 协助天空骑士击退艾尼路的手下
rewardList_description_34.en: Help Knight of the Sky repel Enel's followers
rewardList_description_34.th: ช่วยอัศวินนภาจัดการให้สมุนของเอเนลล่าถอย
rewardList_description_34.tw: 協助空之騎士擊退艾尼路的手下
rewardList_description_34.vi: Hỗ trợ Gan Fall đánh bại tay sai của Enel
rewardList_description_34.de: Hilf Gon Forr, Enels Männer abzuwehren
rewardList_description_34.pt: Ajude o Cavaleiro Celeste a repelir os seguidores de Enel

rewardList_description_36.cn: 帮助空岛原住民夺回故土
rewardList_description_36.th: ช่วยเหลือชาวเกาะท้องฟ้าให้ได้กลับบ้านเกิด
rewardList_description_36.tw: 幫助空島原住民奪回故土
rewardList_description_36.vi: Giúp cư dân ở Đảo Trời quay về cố hương
rewardList_description_36.de: Hilf den Ureinwohnern von Skypiea, ihr Land wieder zurückzuerobern
rewardList_description_36.pt: Ajude os nativos de Skypiea a reconquistar sua terra natal

rewardList_description_38.cn: 协助罗宾破译历史正文
rewardList_description_38.th: ช่วยโรบินตีความเอกสารประวัติศาสตร์
rewardList_description_38.tw: 協助羅賓破譯歷史正文
rewardList_description_38.vi: Hỗ trợ Robin phiên dịch văn bản lịch sửa
rewardList_description_38.de: Hilf Robin bei der Entschlüsselung des historischen Textes

rewardList_description_40.cn: 在空岛打败艾尼路，赢得空岛人民的尊敬
rewardList_description_40.en: Defeat Enel in Skypiea to earn the respect of the people of Skypiea
rewardList_description_40.th: เอาชนะเอเนลที่เกาะท้องฟ้า ได้รับความเคารพจากชาวเกาะท้องฟ้า
rewardList_description_40.tw: 在空島打敗艾尼路，贏得空島人民的尊敬
rewardList_description_40.vi: Ở Đảo Trời đánh bại Enel, nhận được sự tôn kính của cư dân Đảo Trời
rewardList_description_40.de: Besiege Enel in Skypiea und gewinne den Respekt der Menschen auf Skypiea.
rewardList_description_40.pt: Derrote Enel em Skypiea para ganhar o respeito do povo de Skypiea

rewardList_description_42.cn: 摧毁多弗朗明哥的人造果实产业链
rewardList_description_42.en: Destroy Doflamingo's Artificial Fruits production line
rewardList_description_42.th: ทำลายห่วงโซ่อุปทานผลปีศาจเทียมของโดฟลามิงโก้
rewardList_description_42.tw: 摧毀杜夫拉明高的人造果實產業鏈
rewardList_description_42.vi: Phá hủy chuỗi công nghiệp trái nhân tạo của Doflamingo
rewardList_description_42.de: Vernichte die Industriekette für künstliche Früchte von Don Quichotte de Flamingo
rewardList_description_42.pt: Destrua a linha de produção de Fruta Rumble-Rumble de Doflamingo

rewardList_description_44.cn: 阻止黑胡子在新世界的势力扩张
rewardList_description_44.en: Stop Blackbeard from expanding his strength in the new world
rewardList_description_44.th: หยุดการขยายอำนาจของหนวดดำที่นิวเวิลด์
rewardList_description_44.tw: 阻止黑鬍子在新世界的勢力擴張
rewardList_description_44.vi: Ngăn cản Râu Đen khuếch trương thế lực N.W
rewardList_description_44.de: Verhindere die Ausweitung von Blackbeards Macht in der neuen Welt
rewardList_description_44.pt: Impeça que Barba Negra expanda sua força no novo mundo

rewardList_description_46.th: ท้าดวลนักดาบอันดับหนึ่งของโลก！
rewardList_description_46.vi: Khiêu chiến người đứng đầu Kiếm Hào!
rewardList_description_46.de: Fordere den besten Schwertmeister der Welt heraus!
rewardList_description_46.pt: Desafie o primeiro espadachim do mundo!

rewardList_description_48.cn: 熊受到了世界政府的控制，查明原因并恢复他的理智
rewardList_description_48.en: Kuma is under the control of the world government, find out the cause and restore his sanity
rewardList_description_48.th: คุมะถูกรัฐบาลโลกควบคุม ตรวจสอบสาเหตุและทำให้เขาได้สติ
rewardList_description_48.tw: 熊受到了世界政府的控制，查明原因並恢復他的理智
rewardList_description_48.vi: Kuma bị Chính Phủ Thế Giới khống chế, hãy điều tra nguyên nhân và khôi phục lý trí của hắn
rewardList_description_48.de: Bär steht unter der Kontrolle der Weltregierung. Finde die Ursache heraus und stelle seine geistige Gesundheit wieder her.
rewardList_description_48.pt: Kuma está sob o controle do governo mundial, descubra a causa e restaure sua sanidade

rewardList_description_50.cn: 艾斯被海军关入了推进城，前去解救他
rewardList_description_50.en: Ace has been imprisoned in Impel Down by Marine, come and rescue him
rewardList_description_50.th: เอสถูกกองทัพเรือขังเอาไว้ที่คุกนรกอิมเพลดาวน์ รีบไปช่วยเขา
rewardList_description_50.tw: 艾斯被海軍關入了推進城，前去解救他
rewardList_description_50.vi: Ace bị Hải Quân nhốt ở Impel Down, đến giải cứu hắn
rewardList_description_50.de: Ace wurde von der Marine in Impel Down eingesperrt. Gehe ihn retten
rewardList_description_50.pt: Ace foi preso em Guarda Impel Down pela Marinha, venha resgatá-lo

rewardList_description_52.cn: 抵挡青雉的攻击，逃离海军的追捕
rewardList_description_52.en: Resist Aokiji's attack and escape from Marine chasing

skill_pattern_2169.cn: 战斗中，速度增加{185978}；释放主动技能后，获得【超载】，持续3回合（每5回合触发一次）；【超载】状态下，每回合使后排随机一名友军进入【超载】状态，持续1回合

skill_pattern_2169.vi: Trong trận, tăng {185978} tốc độ; nhận [Quá Tải] sau khi thi triển kỹ năng chủ động, kéo dài 3 hiệp (mỗi 5 hiệp kích hoạt 1 lần); Trong trạng thái [Quá Tải], mỗi hiệp sẽ buff [Quá Tải] cho 1 đồng đội ngẫu nhiên ở hàng sau, kéo dài 1 hiệp.
skill_pattern_2169.de: Im Kampf wird das Tempo um {185978} erhöht. Nach Einsatz der aktiven Fähigkeit, Erhalt von [Überladung]. Dauert 3 Runden (alle 5 Runden einmal aktivierbar). Im [Überladung] Zustand gelangt in jeder Runde ein Verbündeter der hinteren Reihe in [Überladung] Zustand. Dauert 1 Runde
skill_pattern_2169.pt: Durante a batalha, a velocidade aumenta em {185978}; após liberar a habilidade ativa, ganha [Sobrecarga] por 3 rodadas (ativado uma vez a cada 5 rodadas). No estado [Sobrecarga], faz um aliado aleatório na linha de trás entrar no estado de [Sobrecarga] a cada rodada por 1 rodada

skill_pattern_2174.en: If he is in the front row, he is immune to petrification, stun, and freezing effects in the [Overload] state. If he is in the back row, the first stage of normal attack and active skill will deal continuous DMG of {185982%} ATK for 4 turns, up to 10 stacks.

skill_pattern_2174.de: Wenn man in vorderer Reihe ist, ist man in [Überladung] Zustand gegen Versteinerung, Schwindel und Einfrieren immun. Wenn man in hinterer Reihe ist, bewirkt normaler Angriff und erste Phase der aktiven Fähigkeit {185982%} ANG kontinuierlichen DMG. Dauert 4 Runden. Maximal 10 Schichten.
skill_pattern_2174.pt: Se ele estiver na primeira linha, ele fica imune a efeitos de petrificação, atordoamento e congelamento no estado de [Sobrecarga]. Se ele estiver na linha de trás, o primeiro estágio de ataque normal e habilidade ativa causará dano contínuo de {185982%} ataque por 4 rodadas, acumulando até 10 vezes;

skill_pattern_2177.cn: 每次行动后，提升己方单排{185983%}持续伤害，最高叠加5层，优先后排；若目标处于【超载】状态，额外叠加一层

skillEffectTips_effectInfo_21.vi: [Phá Khiên] loại bỏ lá chắn của mục tiêu

skillEffectTips_effectInfo_22.cn: 【随机控制】控制技，从现有的控制效果中随机施加一种
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_22.en: [Random Control] Controlling skill, it applies a random control effect among all of the existing controlling effect
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_22.th: 【สุ่มควบคุม】สกิลควบคุม สุ่มใช้หนึ่งอย่างในบรรดาเอฟเฟกต์ควบคุมตอนนี้
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_22.tw: 【隨機控制】控制技，從現有的控制效果中隨機施加一種
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_22.vi: [Khống Chế Ngẫu Nhiên] Skill khống chế, ngẫu nhiên gây thêm 1 loại trong hiệu quả khống chế đang có
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_22.de: [Zufällige Kontrolle] Kontrolle-Fähigkeit. Fügt einen zufälligen Kontrolle-Effekt zu.
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_22.pt: [Controle Aleatório] Habilidade de controle, aplica um efeito de controle aleatório entre todos os efeitos de controle existentes

skillEffectTips_effectInfo_23.en: [Lethal] Renders the target to be unable to perform reborn or unyielding
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_23.th: 【ถึงตาย】ทำให้เป้าหมายไม่สามารถรีบอร์น、 อดทน
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_23.vi: [Chí Mạng] khiến mục tiêu không thể trùng sinh.
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_23.de: [Fatal] Macht das Ziel unfähig, unnachgiebig zu werden oder sich wiederzubeleben
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_23.pt: [Letal] Torna o alvo incapaz de renascer ou ficar indomável

skillEffectTips_effectInfo_25.cn: 【束缚】控制技，使目标无法普攻
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_25.en: [Bound] Control skill that renders the target unable to perform Normal Attack
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_25.th: 【ผูกมัด】สกิลควบคุม ทำให้เป้าหมายไม่สามารถโจมตีทั่วไป
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_25.tw: 【束縛】控制技，使目標無法普攻
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_25.vi: [Trói Buộc] Skill khống chế, khiến mục tiêu không thể đánh thường
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_25.de: [Fesseln] lässt das Ziel keinen normalen Angriff auslösen.
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_25.pt: [Prender] Habilidade de controle que torna o alvo incapaz de realizar ataque normal

skillEffectTips_effectInfo_26.cn: 【冰冻】控制技，使目标无法行动
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_26.en: [Frozen] Controlling skill that renders the target unable to move
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_26.th: 【แช่แข็ง】สกิลควบคุม ทำให้เป้าหมายไม่สามารถเคลื่อนไหว
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_26.tw: 【冰凍】控制技，使目標無法行動
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_26.vi: [Đóng Băng] Skill khống chế, khiến mục tiêu không thể hành động
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_26.de: [Einfrieren] lässt das Ziel sich nicht bewegen können.
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_26.pt: [Congelamento] Habilidade de controle que torna o alvo incapaz de se mover

skillEffectTips_effectInfo_27.cn: 【重伤】效果结束时，额外造成持续时间内受到总伤害的百分比伤害
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_27.en: At the end of the [Serious Wound] effect, deal extra DMG as a percentage of the total DMG received for the duration
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_27.th: เมื่อผล【ดาเมจหนัก】สิ้นสุดลง จะสร้างอัตราดาเมจของดาเมจรวมในช่วงเวลาต่อเนื่อง
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_27.tw: 【重傷】效果結束時，額外造成持續時間內受到總傷害的百分比傷害
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_27.vi: Khi hiệu quả [Trọng Thương] kết thúc, gây thêm sát thương theo phần trăm tổng sát thương phải chịu trong thời gian duy trì
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_27.de: Nachdem [Schwere Verletzung] Effekt endet, wird zusätzlicher prozentualer Schaden gemäß des erlittenen Schadens bewirkt
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_27.pt: No final do efeito [Dano Pesado], causa dano extra como uma porcentagem do dano total recebido pela duração

skillEffectTips_effectInfo_28.cn: 【持续伤害】使目标行动后受到伤害（持续伤害导致的死亡不触发死亡后的技能效果）
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_28.en: [Damage Overtime] Causes the target to take DMG after an action (Dying due to Damage Overtime does not trigger skill effects after death)
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_28.th: 【ดาเมจต่อเนื่อง】ทำให้เมื่อเป้าหมายดำเนินการแล้วจะโดนดาเมจ(ดาเมจต่อเนื่องที่ทำให้ถึงตายจะไม่เกิดผลสกิลหลังจากตายแล้ว)
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_28.tw: 【持續傷害】使目標行動後受到傷害（持續傷害導致的死亡不觸發死亡後的技能效果）
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_28.vi: [Sát thương liên tục] sẽ khiến mục tiêu nhận sát thương liên tục sau khi hành động (nếu mục tiêu bị hạ bởi sát thương của sát thương liên tục sẽ không kích hoạt hiệu quả sau khi tử vong của kỹ năng)
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_28.de: [DoT] lässt das Ziel nach Aktion Schaden erleiden. (durch kontinuierlichen Schaden bewirkter Tod, aktiviert nach Tod keinen Fähigkeitseffekt)
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_28.pt: [Dano Contínuo] faz com que o alvo tome dano após uma ação (Morrer devido a Danos Contínuos não ativa efeitos de habilidade após a morte)

skillEffectTips_effectInfo_30.en: [Banned Healing] Prevents the target from receiving healing
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_30.th: [การฟื้นฟูที่ถูกห้าม] ป้องกันเป้าหมายไม่ให้ได้รับการฟื้นฟู
skillEffectTips_effectInfo_30.pt: [Banned Healing] Prevents the target from receiving healing

skillEffectTips_effectInfo_31.th: [การฟื้นฟู] การรักษาที่รับไปโดยตนเอง

skillOutBattle_potentialDes_10.cn: 与薇薇在巴洛克工作室中搭档，自称王子
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_10.en: He is the partner of Vivi in Baroque Workshop and refers to himself as the “Prince”
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_10.th: ร่วมมือกับวีวี่ที่กลุ่มบาร็อกเวิร์ค เรียกตัวเองว่าราชา
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_10.tw: 與薇薇在巴羅克工作室中搭檔，自稱王子
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_10.vi: Cùng Vivi hợp tác trong Baroque Works, tự xưng hoàng tử
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_10.de: Partner von Vivi im Baroque-Werkstatt und behauptete, ein Prinz zu sein
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_10.pt: Ele é o parceiro de Vivi na Oficina de Baroque e se refere a si mesmo como o “Príncipe”

skillOutBattle_potentialDes_12.cn: 因为袒护岛上的一家人，索隆被蒙卡绑在十字架上三天。最后被索隆打败，失去了海军上校的头衔
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_12.en: Zoro was tied on a cross by Morgan for three straight days because he stood up for a family on the island. He was defeated by Zoro in the end and lost his title as Marine Colonel
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_12.th: เนื่องจากจะปกป้องผู้คนบนเกาะ โซโรยอมถูกมอแกนมัดไว้3วัน สุดท้ายโซโลเอาชนะได้จึงถูกถอดยศจากกองทัพเรือ
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_12.tw: 因為袒護島上的一家人，索隆被蒙卡綁在十字架上三天。最後被索隆打敗，失去了海軍上校的頭銜
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_12.vi: Vì che chở cho người nhà trên đảo, Zoro bị Morgan trói lên giá ba ngày. Cuối cùng bị Zoro đánh bại, đánh mất tước vị Đại Tá Hải Quân
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_12.de: Zorro wurde drei Tage lang von Morgan ans Kreuz gebunden, weil er die Familie auf der Insel beschützte. Wurde schließlich von Zorro besiegt und verlor den Titel des Marine-Obersten
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_12.pt: Zoro foi amarrado em uma cruz por Morgan por três dias consecutivos porque defendeu uma família na ilha.  Ele foi derrotado por Zoro no final e perdeu o título de Coronel da Marinha.

skillOutBattle_potentialDes_14.cn: 在西罗布村打败了黑猫克洛后，乌索普受到了路飞的邀请，成为草帽海贼团的一员，在海贼团中担任狙击手的职位。
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_14.en: After defeating Kuro of Black Cat pirates, Usopp was invited by Luffy to be a member of Straw Hat Pirates. He took on the role of the sniper of the group.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_14.th: หลังจากที่เอาชนะคุโระที่หมู่บ้านไซรัป อุซปได้ถูกชวนให้ออกเรือไปด้วยกัน กลายเป็นสมาชิกของกลุ่มหมวกฟาง รับหน้าที่เป็นตำแหน่งซุ่มยิงของกลุ่ม
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_14.tw: 在西羅布村打敗了黑貓克洛後，騙人布受到了魯夫的邀請，成為草帽海賊團的一員，在海賊團中擔任狙擊手的職位。
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_14.vi: Sau khi đánh bại Mèo Đen Kuro ở Làng Syrup, Usopp nhận lời mời của Luffy, trở thành thành viên Băng Hải Tặc Mũ Rơm, đảm nhận vị trí xạ thủ.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_14.de: Nachdem er die schwarze Katze Käpt'n Black im Sirupdorf besiegt hatte, wurde Lysop von Ruffy eingeladen, Mitglied der Strohhut-Piraten zu werden und als Scharfschütze bei den Piraten zu dienen.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_14.pt: Depois de derrotar Kuro dos piratas Black Cat, Usopp foi convidado por Luffy para ser um membro dos Piratas do Chapéu de Palha. Ele assumiu o papel de atirador do grupo.

skillOutBattle_potentialDes_15.cn: 在可可西亚村打败阿龙后，路飞邀请娜美成为草帽海贼团的一员，担任船上的航海士。
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_15.en: After Arlong is defeated in Cocoyasi Village, Nami was invited by Luffy to be a member of Straw Hat Piratesis, assuming the position as the navigator on the ship.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_15.th: หลังจากเอาชนะอารอนที่หมู่บ้านโกซา ลูฟี่ได้เชิญให้นามิออกเรือไปด้วยกัน รับตำแหน่งเป็นต้นหนเรือ
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_15.tw: 在可哥西亞村打敗惡龍後，魯夫邀請娜美成為草帽海賊團的一員，擔任船上的航海士。
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_15.vi: Sau khi đánh bại Arlong ở Làng Kokoyashi, Luffy mời Nami gia nhập Băng Hải Tặc Mũ Rơm, đảm nhận vị trí hoa tiêu.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_15.de: Nachdem er Arlong in Nojiko besiegt hatte, lud Ruffy Nami ein, Mitglied der Strohhut-Piraten zu werden und als Navigator auf dem Schiff zu dienen.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_15.pt: Após Arlong ser derrotado na Vila Cocoyasi, Nami foi convidada por Luffy para ser membro do Chapéu de Palha Piratesis, assumindo a posição de navegadora do navio.

skillOutBattle_potentialDes_17.cn: 克洛表面上是可雅家中的管家，实际上是密谋夺取可雅财富的海盗。
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_17.en: Kuro appears to be the bulter of Kaya's household, but he is secretly a pirate coveting Kaya's wealth.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_17.th: ภาพลักษณ์ของคุโระเป็นพ่อบ้านของคายะ แต่จริงๆ แล้วเป็นโจรสลัดที่ต้องการจะชิงสมบัติของคายะ
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_17.tw: 克洛表面上是可雅家中的管家，實際上是密謀奪取可雅財富的海盜。
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_17.vi: Ngoài mặt Kuro là quản gia trong nhà Kaya, thực chất lại âm mưu chiếm đoạt tài sản của cô ấy.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_17.de: Äußerlich ist Kuro die Haushälterin von Keya, aber er ist tatsächlich ein Pirat, der sich verschworen hat, um Keyas Reichtum zu ergreifen.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_17.pt: Kuro parece ser o chefe da casa de Kaya, mas secretamente é um pirata que cobiça a riqueza de Kaya.

skillOutBattle_potentialDes_19.cn: 在西罗布村的海滩上，克洛最终被草帽海贼团打败
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_19.en: Kuro was eventually defeated by Straw Hat Pirates on the beach of Syrup village
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_19.th: ที่ชายฝั่งของหมู่บ้านไซรัป  ในที่สุดคุโระก็พ่ายแพ้ให้กับกลุ่มหมวกฟาง
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_19.tw: 在西羅布村的海灘上，克洛最終被草帽海賊團打敗
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_19.vi: Trên bãi biển Làng Silobu, Kuro cuối cùng đã bị Băng Hải Tặc Mũ Rơm đánh bại
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_19.de: Am Strand von Sirupdorf wurde Käpt'n Black schließlich von den Strohhut-Piraten besiegt.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_19.pt: Kuro acabou sendo derrotado pelos Piratas do Chapéu de Palha na praia da vila de Syrup.

skillOutBattle_potentialDes_20.cn: 鱼人阿龙在脱离太阳海贼团后，跑到东海建立了恶龙海贼团，袭击了东海的村庄，进行着高压统治
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_20.en: After Arlong left Sun Pirates, he started his own pirates called Arlong Pirates in East Blue. The villages of East Blue are raided by him and suffering from his harsh rule.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_20.th: หลังจากที่มนุษย์เงือกอารอนแยกกับกลุ่มโจรสลัดพระอาทิตย์ มายังอีสต์บลูเพื่อก่อตั้งกลุ่มโจรสลัดอารอน โจมตีหมู่บ้านในอีสต์บลูและปกครองอย่างบ้าคลั่ง
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_20.tw: 魚人惡龍在脫離太陽海賊團後，跑到東海建立了惡龍海賊團，襲擊了東海的村莊，進行著高壓統治
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_20.vi: Sau khi Arlong rời Băng Hải Tặc Mặt Trời, chạy đến Đông Hải lập Băng Hải Tặc Arlong, tập kích thôn làng ở Đông Hải, đặt ra ách thống trị tàn khốc
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_20.de: Nachdem er die Sonne-Piratenbande verlassen hatte, rannte der Fischmenschen Arlong zum Ostmeer, um die böse Drachen-Piratenbande zu gründen. Sie griffen Dörfer im Ostmeer an und führte eine Hochdruckregel durch.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_20.pt: Depois que Arlong deixou os Piratas do Sol, ele começou seus próprios piratas chamados piratas de Arlong em Mar do Leste. As aldeias de Mar do Leste são invadidas por ele e sofrem com seu governo severo.

skillOutBattle_potentialDes_22.cn: 恶龙在袭击可可西亚村时，看中娜美的绘制航海图能力，许诺娜美挣到1亿贝利就可以赎回村子的自由，同时又和老鼠上校一起谋夺这些钱。最后被愤怒的路飞击败。
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_22.en: Arlong took a favor in Nami's ability to draw navigation map when he was raiding Cocoyasi Village. He promised Nami that she can redeem the freedom of the village if she can make one hundred million belly but secretly plotted to seize the funds with Captain Nezumi. In the end, he was defeated by the enraged Luffy.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_22.th: ขณะที่อารอนโจมตีหมู่บ้านโกซา ด้วยความสามารถของนามิ ให้ได้คำสัญญาว่าจะหาเงินมาให้100ล้านเบรีและต้องปล่อยให้หมู่บ้านเป็นอิสระ ขณะเดียวกันก็ได้ก็ร่วมมือกับนาวาเอกเนซูมิ สุดท้ายก็ถูกลูฟี่ที่โกรธจัดจัดการจหมด
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_22.tw: 惡龍在襲擊可哥西亞村時，看中娜美的繪製航海圖能力，許諾娜美掙到1億貝利就可以贖回村子的自由，同時又和老鼠上校一起謀奪這些錢。最後被憤怒的魯夫擊敗。
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_22.vi: Khi Arlong tấn công Làng Cososia, nhìn trúng khả năng vẽ hải đồ của Nami, đồng ý cho Nami dùng 100 triệu Beri đổi lấy sự tự do của làng, đồng thời hắn và đại tá Mouse âm mưu đoạt số tiền này. Cuối cùng bị Luffy đánh bại .
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_22.de: Als die bösen Drachen das Nojiko Dorf angriffen, haben sie es auf die nautischen Kartenfähigkeiten Nami abgesehen. Man hat ihr versprochen, das Dorf in Ruhe zu lassen, nachdem sie 100M Berry dafür gezahlt hätte. Gleichzeitig  raubte man aber dieses Geld mit General Nezumi. Am Ende wurde man dann vom wütenden Ruffy besiegt.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_22.pt: Arlong favoreceu a habilidade de Nami de desenhar o mapa de navegação quando ele estava invadindo a Vila Cocoyasi. Ele prometeu a Nami que ela poderia resgatar a liberdade da aldeia se ela pudesse ganhar cem milhões de barriga, mas secretamente conspirou para confiscar os fundos com o Capitão Nezumi.  No final, ele foi derrotado pelo enfurecido Luffy.

skillOutBattle_potentialDes_24.cn: 克利克原为东海霸主，在向伟大航路进发时不幸遭遇鹰眼米霍克，被追杀至海上餐厅
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_24.en: Krieg used to be a powerful lord of East Blue. However, he unfortunately ran into Mihawk the Hawkeye when sailing towards Grand Line and was driven to Floating Restaurant
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_24.th: ครีกเดิมเคยเป็นจ้างแห่งอีสต์บลู ขณะที่มุ่งหน้าไปยังเส้นทางที่ยิ่งใหญ่ โชคร้ายพบกับตาเหยี่ยวมิฮอว์ค ถูกตามล่าถึงห้องอาหารบนทะเล
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_24.tw: 克利克原為東海霸主，在向偉大航路進發時不幸遭遇鷹眼米霍克，被追殺至海上餐廳
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_24.vi: Krieg vốn là bá chủ Đông Hải, khi xuất phát đến Grand Line bất hạnh gặp Mihawk, bị truy sát đến Nhà Hàng Trên Biển
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_24.de: Creek war ursprünglich der Oberherr des Ostmeeres.Leider begegnete er Dracule Mihawk auf dem Weg zur Grandline und wurde zum See-Restaurant gejagt.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_24.pt: Krieg costumava ser um poderoso Rei do Mar do Leste. No entanto, ele infelizmente encontrou Mihawk, o Hawkeye, quando navegava em direção à Grande Navegação e foi levado ao Restaurante Flutuante.

skillOutBattle_potentialDes_26.cn: 克利克使用各种武器进行战斗，其标志性的大战枪超过1吨。在最终与路飞的战斗中对路飞造成了不小的困扰
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_26.en: Krieg fights with various types of weapon. His signature weapon, the great lance, weights more than 1 ton. He is proven to be a formidable opponent in the final showdown against Luffy.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_26.th: ครีกใช้อาวุธหลากหลายชนิดในการต่อสู้ อาวุธทั้งหมดรวมกันเกิน1ตัน ในตอนที่ต่อสู้กับลูฟี่ก็สร้างความก่อกวนได้ไม่น้อยเลยทีเดียว
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_26.tw: 克利克使用各種武器進行戰鬥，其標誌性的大戰槍超過1噸。在最終與魯夫的戰鬥中對魯夫造成了不小的困擾
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_26.vi: Krieg dùng đủ loại vũ khí chiến đấu. Trong trận chiến cuối với Luffy đã khiến Luffy khốn đốn không ít
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_26.de: Creek verwendet eine Vielzahl von Waffen, um zu kämpfen, und seine ikonische Kriegswaffe überschreitet 1 Tonne. Im letzten Kampf gegen Ruffy bereitete es Ruffy große Probleme.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_26.pt: Krieg luta com vários tipos de armas. Sua arma característica, a grande lança, pesa mais de 1 tonelada.  Ele provou ser um oponente formidável no confronto final contra Luffy.

skillOutBattle_potentialDes_28.cn: 瓦尔波原是磁鼓王国的国王，曾制定“狩猎医生”的法令，间接导致了乔巴的恩师希鲁鲁克的死亡。
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_28.en: Wapol used to be the king of Drum Kingdom. He has once pushed a law called “Doctor Hunt”, which directly caused the death of Chopper's master, Hiriluk.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_28.th: เดิมทีวาโปลูเป็นราชาแห่งดรัม ถูกตั้งให้เป็น“หมอนักล่า” นำไปสู่การตายของที่ด็อกเตอร์ฮิลลุคอาจารย์ของช็อปเปอร์
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_28.tw: 瓦波爾原是磁鼓王國的國王，曾制定“狩獵醫生”的法令，間接導致了喬巴的恩師希魯魯克的死亡。
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_28.vi: Wapol vốn là chủ Vương quốc Drum, từng đặt pháp lệnh “Doctor Hunt”, gián tiếp đưa ân sư Hiluluk của Chopper vào đường chết.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_28.de: Wapol war ursprünglich der König des Trommelreichs. Er erließ das Dekret des "Jagdarztes", was indirekt zum Tod von Choppers Mentor Shiluruk führte.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_28.pt: Wapol costumava ser o rei do Reino de Drum. Certa vez, ele impôs uma lei chamada “Médico de Caça”, que causou diretamente a morte do mestre de Chopper, Hiriluk.

skillOutBattle_potentialDes_30.cn: 瓦尔波的吞吞果实可以吃下所有的东西，在与路飞的战斗中，他将杰斯和克罗马利蒙吃下肚中。最后，被路飞用橡胶火箭炮打飞。
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_30.en: Wapol's Munch-Munch Fruit ability allows him to devour anything. In the battle against Luffy, he devoured Chess and Kuromarimo. In the end, he was knocked out of the picture by Luffy with his Rubber Bazooka.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_30.th: ผลบาคุบาคุของวาโปลูสามารถกินได้ทุกสิ่งอย่าง ในการต่อสู้กับลูฟี่ เขาได้กินเชสและคุโรมาริโม สุดท้ายถูกลูฟี่ใช้จรวดยางยืดต่อยออกมา
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_30.tw: 瓦波爾的吞吞果實可以吃下所有的東西，在與魯夫的戰鬥中，他將傑斯和克羅馬利蒙吃下肚中。最後，被魯夫用橡膠火箭炮打飛。
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_30.vi: Trái Baku Baku của Wapol có thể nuốt mọi thứ, khi chiến đấu với Luffy, hắn nuốt Chess và Kuromarimo vào bụng. Cuối cùng bị Luffy dùng Gomu Gomu no Rocket đánh bay.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_30.de: Wapols Verschlingen-Frucht kann alles essen, und im Kampf mit Ruffy isst er Chess und Kuromarimo. Und wurde am Ende von Ruffy mit einem Gummi-Bazooka erschossen.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_30.pt: A habilidade da Fruta Baku Baku de Wapol permite que ele devore qualquer coisa. Na batalha contra Luffy, ele devorou Chess e Kuromarimo.  No final, ele foi eliminado de cena por Luffy com sua Bazuca de Borracha.

skillOutBattle_potentialDes_32.cn: Mr.5与Miss.情人节同为巴洛克工作室的高级特务
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_32.en: Mr. 5 and Miss Valentine are both senior agents working for Baroque Workshop.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_32.th: Mr.5และMiss.วาเลนไทน์เป็นสมาชิกระดับสูงกลุ่มบาร็อกเวิร์ค
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_32.tw: Mr.5與Miss 情人節同為巴羅克工作室的高級特務
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_32.vi: Mr.5 và Miss.Valentine cùng là đặc vụ cao cấp của Baroque Works
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_32.de: Mr.5 und Miss Valentine sind beide fortgeschrittene Agenten der Baroque Firma
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_32.pt: Sr. 5 e Srta. Valentine são ambos agentes seniores que trabalham para a Oficina Baroque.

skillOutBattle_potentialDes_34.cn: 在威士忌山峰，和搭档一起追杀薇薇，使用爆炸果实能力，击败了薇薇的护卫队长。最后在巨人岛小花园被索隆击败。
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_34.en: He pursued Vivi alongside his partner on Whisky Peak. He used the ability of Bomb-Bomb Fruit to defeat Vivi's guard captain. In the end, he was defeated by Zoro at the Little Garden of Giant's Island.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_34.th: ณ วิสกี้พีคได้รับมือกันตามล่าวีวี่ ใช้พลังผลระเบิดจัดการองครักษ์ของวีวี่ สุดท้ายได้พ่ายแพ้ให้กับโซโลที่เกาะคนยักษ์
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_34.tw: 在威士卡山峰，和搭檔一起追殺薇薇，使用爆炸果實能力，擊敗了薇薇的護衛隊長。最後在巨人島小花園被索隆擊敗。
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_34.vi: Ở Whiskey Peak, cùng hợp tác truy sát Vivi,  dùng Trái Bomu Bomu đánh bại hộ vệ của Vivi. Cuối cùng bị Zoro đánh bại ở Little Garden.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_34.de: Jagte und griff auf dem Whiskey Peak Vivi mit dem Partner und nutzte die Fähigkeit von Explosion-Frucht, um Vivis Hauptmann der Wache zu besiegen. Wurde endlich von Zorro im kleinen Garten der Rieseninsel besiegt.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_34.pt: Ele perseguiu Vivi ao lado de seu parceiro em Whiskey Peak. Ele usou a habilidade de Fruta Bomb-Bomb para derrotar o capitão da guarda de Vivi.  No final, ele foi derrotado por Zoro no Pequeno Jardim da Ilha dos Gigantes.

skillOutBattle_potentialDes_36.cn: Miss.情人节拥有的恶魔果实为轻飘飘果实，可以随意控制自己的重量，常用招式是先减轻自己的体重飞到空中，然后加重自己的体重向下压。在威士忌山和小花园被路飞打败两次。
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_36.en: Miss Valentine possesses the ability of Pound-Pound Fruit. She can control her own body weight at her own will. Her favorite move is to reduce her weight to fly in the mid-air then drop down while increasing her weight. She was defeated by Luffy twice in Whisky Peak and Little Garden.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_36.th: Miss.วาเลนไทน์มีพลังของผลกิโลกิโล สามารถควบคุมน้ำหนักได้ตามต้องการ มักจะทำให้น้ำหนักเบาเพื่อที่จะสามารถลอยได้ จากนั้นเพิ่มน้ำหนักตัวเพื่อทับลงมา ได้พ่ายแพ้ให้กับลูฟี่ถึงสองครั้งที่วิสกี้พีคและลิตเติ้ลการ์เด้น
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_36.tw: Miss 情人節擁有的惡魔果實為輕飄飄果實，可以隨意控制自己的重量，常用招式是先減輕自己的體重飛到空中，然後加重自己的體重向下壓。在威士卡山和小花園被魯夫打敗兩次。
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_36.vi: Trái Ác Quỷ của Miss.Valentine là Kilo Kilo, có thể thay đổi trọng lượng tùy ý, chiêu thường dùng là giảm trọng lượng để bay lên, sau đó tăng trọng lượng để hạ xuốn. Trong Đỉnh Whisky và Little Garden bị Luffy đánh bại 2 lần
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_36.de: Miss Valentine besitzt die Teufelsfrucht, die man Leichtigkeit-Frucht nennt. Damit kann man ganz leicht das eigene Gewicht kontrollieren. Sie springt meistens leicht hoch, um dann schwer zu landen. Wurde auf Whiskey Peak und im kleinen Garten zweimal von Ruffy besiegt.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_36.pt: Srta. Valentine Possui a capacidade da Akuma no Mi da Fruta Pound-Pound. Ela pode controlar seu próprio peso corporal por sua própria vontade. Seu movimento favorito é reduzir seu peso para voar no ar e depois cair enquanto aumenta seu peso.  Ela foi derrotada por Luffy duas vezes em Whiskey Peak e Pequeno Jardim

skillOutBattle_potentialDes_38.cn: Miss.双手指拥有棘刺果实的能力，可以将身体的各个部位变成尖刺；双手指的能力在对阵娜美时对娜美造成了相当大的困扰。最终娜美凭借天候棒将Miss.双手指打败。
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_38.en: Miss Doublefinger possesses the ability of Spike-Spike Fruit, which allows her to turn her body parts into spikes; Miss Doublefinger's ability poses a serious threat when Nami was fighting against her. In the end, Nami managed to defeat Miss Doublefinger with the help of Clima-Tact.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_38.th: มิสดับเบิลฟิงเกอร์มีพลังของผลโทเกะโทเกะ สามารถเปลี่ยนร่างกายให้กลายเป็นหนาม; ความสามารถของดับเบิลฟิงเกอร์สร้างความปั่นป่วนให้กับนามิอย่างมาก สุดท้ายนามิก็สามารถเอาชนะมิสดับเบิลฟิงเกอร์ได้
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_38.tw: Miss 雙手指擁有棘刺果實的能力，可以將身體的各個部位變成尖刺；雙手指的能力在對陣娜美時對娜美造成了相當大的困擾。最終娜美憑藉天候棒將Miss 雙手指打敗。
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_38.vi: Miss Double Finger có năng lực Trái Gai, có thể biến tất cả các bộ phận trên cơ thể thành gai; năng lực của Miss Double Finger khi chiến đấu đã gây ra khá nhiều rắc rối cho Nami. Cuối cùng Nami dựa vào cây gậy thời tiết đánh bại Miss Double Finger.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_38.de: Zala besitzt die Fähigkeiten der Dornen-Frucht. Sie kann jedes beliebige Körperteil in Dornen verwandeln. Zala mit ihren Fähigkeiten im Kampf mit Nami ihr große Probleme verursacht. Am Ende hat dann Nami mit dem Wetterstab Zala besiegt.
skillOutBattle_potentialDes_38.pt: Srta. Dois Dedos possui a habilidade Fruta Spike-Spike, que permite que ela transforme partes de seu corpo em pontas; A habilidade de Srta.
