task_describe1_2.cn: 路飞被海军包围了！和索隆、娜美一起，打败围堵的海军！
task_describe1_2.en: Luffy is surrounded by Marine! Defeat the surrounding marine with Zoro and Nami!
task_describe1_2.th: ลูฟี่ถูกกองทัพเรือล้อมแล้ว！ร่วมมือกับโซโร、นามิ เอาชนะกองทัพเรือที่โอบล้อม！
task_describe1_2.tw: 魯夫被海軍包圍了！和索隆、娜美一起，打敗圍堵的海軍！
task_describe1_2.vi: Luffy đã bị Hải Quân bao vây! Cùng với Zoro, Nam,  đánh bại Hải Quân!
task_describe1_2.de: Ruffy ist von der Marine umgeben! Besiege zusammen mit Zorro und Nami die belagerte Marine!
task_describe1_2.pt: Luffy está cercado por fuzileiros navais!  Derrote a marinha ao redor com Zoro e Nami!

task_describe1_4.cn: 海军上校蒙卡出现了！打败他并解救谢尔兹镇的人们。
task_describe1_4.en: Marine Colonel Morgan has shown up! Defeat him and rescue the people of Shells Town
task_describe1_4.th: มอร์แกนผู้พันแห่งกองทัพเรือปรากฏตัวแล้ว！เอาชนะเขาและช่วยชาวเมืองเชล
task_describe1_4.tw: 海軍上校蒙卡出現了！打敗他並解救謝爾茲鎮的人們。
task_describe1_4.vi: Thượng tá Hải Quân Morgan xuất hiện rồi! Đánh bại hắn và giải cứu người dân ở Shells Town.
task_describe1_4.de: Marine-Oberst Morgan ist erschienen! Besiege ihn, um die Leute der Muscheln-Stadt zu retten.
task_describe1_4.pt: O Coronel da Marinha Morgan apareceu!  Derrote-o e salve o povo de Shells Town.

task_describe1_6.cn: 经过多次战斗，草帽团一行人遇到的敌人愈发强大，急需提升自己的实力！
task_describe1_6.en: Through multiple battles, the Strawhat Pirates ran into more and more powerful enemy. They need to improve their own strength quickly!
task_describe1_6.th: จากการต่อสู้หลายครั้ง ศัตรูที่พวกกลุ่มหมวกฟางเจอแข็งแกร่งขึ้นเรื่อยๆ ต้องรีบเพิ่มความสามารถของตัวเองโดยด่วน！
task_describe1_6.tw: 經過多次戰鬥，草帽團一行人遇到的敵人愈發強大，急需提升自己的實力！
task_describe1_6.vi: Chiến đấu càng nhiều, địch của Băng Mũ Rơm ngày càng mạnh, cần nâng cao thực lực của bản thân gấp!
task_describe1_6.de: Nach vielen weiteren Kämpfen, ist die Stohhutbande jetzt auf noch viel mächtigere Feinde getroffen. Sie müssen ihre Stärke erhöhen!
task_describe1_6.pt: Através de múltiplas batalhas, os Chapéus de Palha encontraram inimigos cada vez mais poderosos. Eles precisam melhorar sua própria força rapidamente!

task_describe1_8.cn: 路飞一行人在东海遇到了巴基海贼团，巴基海贼团的实力相当强大，路飞急需新的帮手
task_describe1_8.en: Luffy and his friends ran into Buggy Pirates at the Eastern Sea. Buggy Pirates were very powerful and formidable. Luffy needed new helper
task_describe1_8.th: พวกลูฟี่เจอกลุ่มโจรสลัดบากี้ที่อีสต์บลู ความสามารถของกลุ่มโจรสลัดบากี้แข็งแกร่งมาก ลูฟี่ต้องรีบหาผู้ช่วยใหม่
task_describe1_8.tw: 魯夫一行人在東海遇到了巴基海賊團，巴基海賊團的實力相當強大，魯夫急需新的幫手
task_describe1_8.vi: Nhóm Luffy đến Đông Hải gặp phải Băng Hải Tặc Buggy, thực lực Băng Hải Tặc Buggy tương đối mạnh, Luffy cần được giúp đỡ
task_describe1_8.de: Ruffy und sein Team haben die Buggy Piratenbande im Ostmeer getroffen. Die Buggy Piratenbande sind ziemlich mächtig und Ruffy braucht dringend neue Helfer.
task_describe1_8.pt: Luffy e seus amigos encontraram Piratas Buggy no Mar Leste. Piratas Buggy eram muito poderosos e formidáveis. Luffy precisava de um novo ajudante

task_describe1_10.cn: 找到帮手的路飞前往挑战巴基，击败他的手下吧！
task_describe1_10.en: Having found good helper, Luffy has come to challenge Buggy. Defeat his goons now!
task_describe1_10.th: ลูฟี่เจอผู้ช่วยแล้ว ไปท้าดวลบากี้ เอาชนะสมุนของเขา！
task_describe1_10.tw: 找到幫手的魯夫前往挑戰巴基，擊敗他的手下吧！
task_describe1_10.vi: Luffy đã tìm được trợ thủ, đến khiêu chiến Buggy, đánh bại thuộc hạ của hắn nào!
task_describe1_10.de: Ruffy, der Hilfe gefunden hat, fordert Buggy heraus und besiegt seine Männer!
task_describe1_10.pt: Tendo encontrado um bom ajudante, Luffy veio desafiar Buggy. Derrote seus capangas agora!

task_describe1_12.cn: 完成短暂的休整之后，帮助路飞一行人整理好状态，齐整出发吧！
task_describe1_12.en: After a brief break, time to help Luffy and his friends get ready and set out!
task_describe1_12.th: หลังจากพักระยะสั้นแล้ว ช่วยพวกลูฟี่เตรียมพร้อมออกเดินทางเถอะ！
task_describe1_12.tw: 完成短暫的休整之後，幫助魯夫一行人整理好狀態，齊整出發吧！
task_describe1_12.vi: Sau khi nghỉ ngơi, hãy giúp nhóm người Luffy chuẩn bị sẵn sàng, xuất phát nào!
task_describe1_12.de: Hilf Ruffy und seinem Team nach einer kurzen Pause, sich in Ordnung zu bringen und sich auf den Weg zu machen!
task_describe1_12.pt: Após uma breve pausa, é hora de ajudar Luffy e seus amigos a se prepararem e partirem!

task_describe1_14.cn: 路飞一行人的实力还不够强大，快去升级路飞和索隆的联合技能，增强自身的实力吧！
task_describe1_14.en: Luffy and his friends are not strong enough. Go ahead and upgrade the combine skill of Luffy and Upgrade to enhance their strength!
task_describe1_14.th: ความสามารถของพวกลูฟี่ยังไม่แกร่งพอ รีบไปอัพเลเวลสกิลร่วมของลูฟี่กับโซโร เพิ่มความสามารถของตัวเอง！
task_describe1_14.tw: 魯夫一行人的實力還不夠強大，快去升級魯夫和索隆的聯合技能，增強自身的實力吧！
task_describe1_14.vi: Thực lực nhóm Luffy chưa đủ mạnh, mau tăng cấp Skill liên hợp của Luffy và Zoro, tăng mạnh thực lực bản thân!
task_describe1_14.de: Ruffys Team ist nicht stark genug. Verbessere die kombinierten Fähigkeiten von Ruffy und Zorro, um deine eigene Stärke zu verbessern!
task_describe1_14.pt: Luffy e seus amigos não são fortes o suficiente. Vá em frente e atualize a habilidade combinada de Luffy e Zoro e atualize para aumentar sua força!

task_describe1_16.cn: 继续前往巴基海贼团，前去挑战巴基和巴基的手下吧！
task_describe1_16.en: Go to Buggy Pirates and challenge Buggy and his goons!
task_describe1_16.th: ไปหากลุ่มโจรสลัดบากี้ ท้าดวลบากี้กับสมุนของบากี้！
task_describe1_16.tw: 繼續前往巴基海賊團，前去挑戰巴基和巴基的手下吧！
task_describe1_16.vi: Tiếp tục đến Băng Hải Tặc Buggy, đến khiêu chiến Buggy và thủ hạ của hắn!
task_describe1_16.de: Gehe weiter zur Buggy-Piratbande, um Buggy und seine Anhänger zu besiegen
task_describe1_16.pt: Vá para os Piratas Buggy e desafie Buggy e seus capangas!

task_describe1_18.cn: 为了打败海贼巴基，路飞一行人还需要继续提升自身的实力！
task_describe1_18.en: In order to defeat Buggy Pirates, Luffy and his friends still need to improve their own strength!
task_describe1_18.th: เพื่อเอาชนะโจรสลัดบากี้ พวกลูฟี่ต้องเพิ่มความสามารถของตัวเอง！
task_describe1_18.tw: 為了打敗海賊巴基，魯夫一行人還需要繼續提升自身的實力！
task_describe1_18.vi: Để đánh bại Hải Tặc Buggy, Luffy và đồng đội cần tiếp tục tăng sức mạnh bản thân!
task_describe1_18.de: Um den Piraten Buggy zu besiegen, müssen Ruffy und sein Team ihre eigene Stärke weiter verbessern!
task_describe1_18.pt: Para derrotar os Piratas Buggy, Luffy e seus amigos ainda precisam melhorar sua própria força!

task_describe1_20.cn: 我们的实力已经足够强大，快去打败海贼巴基吧！
task_describe1_20.en: Our strength has grown to be strong enough. Go and defeat Buggy Pirates now!
task_describe1_20.th: ความสามารถของเราแข็งแกร่งพอแล้ว รีบไปเอาชนะโจรสลัดบากี้เถอะ！
task_describe1_20.tw: 我們的實力已經足夠強大，快去打敗海賊巴基吧！
task_describe1_20.vi: Thực lực đã đủ mạnh, mau đi đánh bại hải tặc Buggy!
task_describe1_20.de: Unsere Stärke ist genug, besiege den Piraten Buggy!
task_describe1_20.pt: Nossa força cresceu para ser forte o suficiente. Vá e derrote Piratas Buggy agora!

task_describe1_22.cn: 为了继续进行旅程，我们需要继续提升海贼团成员的实力！
task_describe1_22.en: To continue the journey, we must continue improving the strength of Pirates Member!
task_describe1_22.th: เพื่อการเดินทางต่อ เราต้องเพิ่มความสามารถของสมาชิกกลุ่มโจรสลัด！
task_describe1_22.tw: 為了繼續進行旅程，我們需要繼續提升海賊團成員的實力！
task_describe1_22.vi: Để tiếp tục hành trình, chúng ta cần phải tăng thực lực cho thành viên Băng Hải Tặc!
task_describe1_22.de: Um die Reise fortzusetzen, müssen wir die Stärke der Mitglieder der Piratengruppe weiter verbessern!
task_describe1_22.pt: Para continuar a jornada, devemos continuar melhorando a força dos membros pirata!

task_describe1_24.cn: 草帽海贼团来到了西罗布村，在这里他们遇到了乌索普和他的海贼团！
task_describe1_24.en: Straw Hat Pirates made it to Syrup village. They ran into Usopp and his pirate group!
task_describe1_24.th: กลุ่มโจรสลัดหมวกฟางมาถึงหมู่บ้านไซรัป ที่นี่พวกเขาได้พบกับอุซปกับกลุ่มโจรสลัดของเขา！
task_describe1_24.tw: 草帽海賊團來到了西羅布村，在這裡他們遇到了騙人布和他的海賊團！
task_describe1_24.vi: Băng Hải Tặc Mũ Rơm đã đến Làng Syrup, gặp được Usopp và Băng Hải Tặc của hắn!
task_describe1_24.de: Die  Strohhut-Piratenbande ist in Sirupdorf angekommen, hier sind sie auf Lysop und seine Piratenbande gestoßen!
task_describe1_24.pt: Os Piratas do Chapéu de Palha chegaram à vila de Syrup. Eles encontraram Usopp e seu grupo de piratas!

task_describe1_26.cn: 深海大监狱中关押了大量实力强劲的对手，快去挑战他们，证明自己的实力吧！
task_describe1_26.en: A lot of powerful opponents are imprisoned in Impel Down. Go and challenge them to prove your strength!
task_describe1_26.th: คุกนรกอิมเพลดาวน์ขังคู่ต่อสู้แข็งแกร่งจำนวนมาก รีบไปท้าดวลพวกเขา พิสูจน์ความสามารถของตัวเอง！
task_describe1_26.tw: 深海大監獄中關押了大量實力強勁的對手，快去挑戰他們，證明自己的實力吧！
task_describe1_26.vi: Nhà Lao Biển Sâu giam giữ nhiều đối thủ mạnh, mau đến khiêu chiến, chứng minh thực lực bản thân!
task_describe1_26.de: Eine große Anzahl mächtiger Gegner ist im Großen Impel Down eingesperrt. Fordere sie heraus und beweise deine Stärke!
task_describe1_26.pt: Muitos oponentes poderosos estão presos em Impel Down. Vá e desafie-os a provar sua força!

task_describe1_28.cn: 克洛意图谋夺可雅的家产，前往打败他，粉碎黑猫海贼团的计划！
task_describe1_28.en: Kuro coveted the wealth of Kaya. Go and defeat him and crush the scheme of Black Cat Pirates!
task_describe1_28.th: คุโระวางแผนปล้นทรัพย์สินของคายะ ไปเอาชนะเขา ทำลายแผนของกลุ่มโจรสลัดแมวดำ！
task_describe1_28.tw: 克洛意圖謀奪可雅的家產，前往打敗他，粉碎黑貓海賊團的計畫！
task_describe1_28.vi: Kuro ý đồ chiếm đoạt gia tài của Keya, đánh bại hắn và đập tan kế hoạch của Băng Hải Tặc Mèo Đen!
task_describe1_28.de: Kuro beabsichtigt, Keyas Familienbesitz zu ergreifen. Besiege ihn und zerstöre den Plan der Schwarze Katze Piratenbande!
task_describe1_28.pt: Kuro cobiçava a riqueza de Kaya. Vá, derrote-o e esmague o esquema dos Piratas do Gato preto!

task_describe1_30.cn: 长环岛冒险开放了，在长环岛冒险中进行探险，可以获得角色觉醒必需的觉醒石
task_describe1_30.en: Long Ring Island Adventure has unlocked. You can now explore in Long Ring Island Adventure to acquire the Awaken Diamond, which is essential for character awakening
task_describe1_30.th: การผจญภัยเกาะลองไอส์แลนด์เปิดแล้ว ผจญภัยในเกาะลองไอส์แลนด์ จะได้รับหินปลุกพลังที่จำเป็นสำหรับปลุกพลังตัวละคร
task_describe1_30.tw: 長環島冒險開放了，在長環島冒險中進行探險，可以獲得角色覺醒必需的覺醒石
task_describe1_30.vi: Thám Hiểm Long Island đã mở, thám hiểm Thám Hiểm Long Island để nhận Đá Thức Tỉnh
task_describe1_30.de: Long Island ist geöffnet. Erkunde es, um die Erwachungssteine für das Erwachen des Charakters zu erhalten.
task_describe1_30.pt: Aventura das Ilhas dos Anéis foi desbloqueada. Agora você pode explorar a Aventura das Ilhas dos Anéis para adquirir o Diamante do Despertar, que é essencial para o despertar do personagem

task_describe1_32.cn: 路飞为了寻找厨师，来到了海上餐厅，在这里他们遇到了被称作黑足的厨师山治
task_describe1_32.en: Luffy was looking for a chef. He came to the Floating Restaurant and met Sanji, the black foot.
task_describe1_32.th: เพื่อค้นหาพ่อครัว ลูฟี่มาถึงภัตตาคารลอยทะเล ที่นี่พวกเขาได้พบกับเชฟขาดำซันจิ
task_describe1_32.tw: 魯夫為了尋找廚師，來到了海上餐廳，在這裡他們遇到了被稱作黑足的廚師香起士
task_describe1_32.vi: Luffy đến Nhà Hàng Trên Biển tìm đầu bếp, gặp được đầu bếp Sanji biệt danh Chân Đen
task_describe1_32.de: Um einen Koch zu finden, kam Ruffy ins See-Restaurant, wo sie den als schwarzen Fuß bekannten Koch Sanji trafen.
task_describe1_32.pt: Luffy estava procurando um chef. Ele veio ao Restaurante Flutuante e conheceu Sanji, o pé preto.

task_describe1_34.cn: 为了打败提督克利克，我们需要继续提升自己的实力！
task_describe1_34.en: In order to defeat Admiral Krieg, we must continue improving our strength!
task_describe1_34.th: เพื่อเอาชนะนายพลเรือครีก เราต้องเพิ่มความสามารถของตัวเองอย่างต่อเนื่อง！
task_describe1_34.tw: 為了打敗提督克利克，我們需要繼續提升自己的實力！
task_describe1_34.vi: Để đánh bại Đô Đốc Krieg, chúng ta cần phải tăng thêm thực lực!
task_describe1_34.de: Um Admiral Creek zu besiegen, müssen wir unsere Stärke weiter verbessern!
task_describe1_34.pt: Para derrotar o almirante Krieg, devemos continuar melhorando nossa força!

task_describe1_36.cn: 克利克吃了海上餐厅提供的食物恢复了元气，却反目要打劫海上餐厅。帮助哲普击败克利克！
task_describe1_36.en: Krieg ate the food from Floating Restaurant and regained the spirit, but now he wanted to rob the Floating Restaurant. Help Zeff defeat Krieg!
task_describe1_36.th: ครีกกินอาหารที่ภัตตาคารลอยทะเลฟื้นฟูพลัง แต่กลับต้องการปล้นภัตตาคารลอยทะเล ช่วยเซฟเอาชนะครีก！
task_describe1_36.tw: 克利克吃了海上餐廳提供的食物恢復了元氣，卻反目要打劫海上餐廳。幫助哲普擊敗克利克！
task_describe1_36.vi: Krieg ăn thức ăn của Nhà Hàng Trên Biển hồi phục Nguyên Khí, lại phản bội muốn cướp Nhà Hàng Trên Biển. Giúp Zeff đánh bại Krieg!
task_describe1_36.de: Creek gewann seine Vitalität zurück, nachdem er das Essen vom See-Restaurant gegessen hatte, aber er wollte stattdessen das See-Restaurant ausrauben. Hilf Zeff, Creek zu besiegen!
task_describe1_36.pt: Krieg comeu a comida do Restaurante Flutuante e recuperou o genki, mas agora ele queria roubar o Restaurante Flutuante.  Ajude Zeff a derrotar Krieg!

task_describe1_38.cn: 公会系统开放了，加入公会，可以参与大量公会玩法，与公会好友共同成长！
task_describe1_38.en: Guild System has unlocked. Join a guild and take part in many Guild modes. It's time to grow with your guild mates!
task_describe1_38.th: ระบบกิลด์เปิดแล้ว เข้าร่วมกิลด์ สามารถเล่นโหมดกิลด์จำนวนมาก เติบโตพร้อมกับเพื่อนร่วมกิลด์！
task_describe1_38.tw: 公會系統開放了，加入公會，可以參與大量公會玩法，與公會好友共同成長！
task_describe1_38.vi: Hệ thống Hạm Đội đã mở, gia nhập Hạm Đội để tham gia nhiều lối chơi hấp dẫn, cùng nhau trưởng tahn2h!
task_describe1_38.de: Das Gildensystem wurde eröffnet! Schließe dich einer Gilde an, um die Gameplays für die Gilde zu genießen und um zusammen mit den Verbündeten zu wachsen!
task_describe1_38.pt: O Sistema de Guilda foi desbloqueado. Junte-se a uma guilda e participe de vários modos de guilda. É hora de crescer com seus companheiros de guilda!

task_describe1_40.cn: 暂时不用的装备可以进行分解以获得精炼石，用于装备的升星。
task_describe1_40.en: The gear that you don't need at the moment can be dissolved to gain Refine Stone, which can be used for the gear star-up.
task_describe1_40.th: อุปกรณ์ที่ไม่ได้ใช้ สามารถแยกเพื่อรับหินสกัด ใช้สำหรับเพิ่มดาวอุปกรณ์ได้
task_describe1_40.tw: 暫時不用的裝備可以進行分解以獲得精煉石，用於裝備的升星。
task_describe1_40.vi: Trang bị không dùng có thể phân giải lấy Đá Tinh Luyện, dùng tăng Sao trang bị.
task_describe1_40.de: Die unbenutzten Rüstungen können zerlegt werden, damit Raffinierungssteine ​​für Sternerhöhung der Rüstung erhalten werden.
task_describe1_40.pt: O equipamento que você não precisa no momento pode ser dissolvido para ganhar pedra de refinamento, que pode ser usada para iniciar o equipamento.

task_describe1_43.cn: 海上餐厅中出现了传说中的七武海，草帽一伙难道将要倒在这强大的气场之下了吗？
task_describe1_43.en: The SHICHIBUKAI has appeared in the Floating Restaurant, will the Strawhat Pirates be pressed by this power?
task_describe1_43.th: 7เทพโจรสลัดในตำนานปรากฏตัวขึ้นในภัตตาคารลอยทะเล หรือว่าเหล่าพรรคพวกหมวกฟางจะต้องพ่ายแพ้ให้กับสถานการณ์นี้？
task_describe1_43.tw: 海上餐廳中出現了傳說中的七武海，草帽一夥難道將要倒在這強大的氣場之下了嗎？
task_describe1_43.vi: Nhà Hàng Trên Biển xuất hiện Thất Vũ Hải trong truyền thuyết, lẽ nào Băng Mũ Rơm phải dừng bước ở đây sao?

thingsID_description_655.cn: 可以在赏金事件中召唤新事件，完成通过电话虫召唤的事件一定获得SSR英雄生命卡。\n<font color=0xff3300>本生命卡事件为额外事件，不占用关卡本身的生命卡事件次数。</font>
thingsID_description_655.en: It can summon new events in Bounty Event. You can gain a Vivre card of SSR Hero through completing event summoned by Den Mushi. \n<font color=0xff3300>This Vivre Card event is an additional event. It doesn’t cost the level’s original Vivre card event attempts. </font>
thingsID_description_655.th: สามารถอัญเชิญเรื่องราวใหม่ในเรื่องราวค่าหัวได้ ผ่านด่านเรื่องราวอัญเชิญหนอนโทรศัพท์เสร็จสิ้น การันตีรับบัตรHPฮีโร่SSR \n<font color=0xff3300>เรื่องราวบัตรHPนี้เป็นเรื่องราวพิเศษ จะไม่ใช้จ่ายจำนวนครั้งเรื่องราวบัตรHPของด่าน</font>
thingsID_description_655.tw: 可以在賞金事件中召喚新事件，完成通過電話蟲召喚的事件一定獲得SSR英雄生命卡。\n<font color=0xff3300>本生命卡事件為額外事件，不佔用關卡本身的生命卡事件次數。</font>
thingsID_description_655.vi: Trong Sự kiện Treo Thưởng có thể triêu hồi sự kiện mới, hoàn thành thông qua sự kiện triệu hồi Den Den Mushi có thể nhận Thẻ Sinh Mệnh Tướng SSR.\n<font color=0xff3300>Sự kiện Thẻ Sinh Mệnh là sự kiện thêm vào, không tính chung số lần với sự kiện Thẻ Sinh Mệnh của ải</font>
thingsID_description_655.de: Kann in Kopfgeldhandlung neue Ereignisse beschwören, schließe die von Teleschnecke beschworenen Ereignisse ab, um SSR Held LP-Karte zu erhalten.\n<font color=0xff3300> Dieses LP-Karte-Ereignis ist ein zusätzliches Ereignis und kostet nicht die Anzahl der LP-Karte-Ereignisse vom Pass.</font>
thingsID_description_655.pt: Pode convocar novos eventos no Evento de Invocação. Você pode ganhar um Vivre Card de Herói SSR completando o evento convocado por Den Mushi.\n<font color=0xff3300>Este evento Vivre Card é um evento adicional. Não custa as tentativas originais do evento do Vivre Card do nível. </font>

tutorial_dialogText_2.cn: 为了找到<font color=0x932A09>ONE PIECE</font>，让我们踏上冒险的旅途吧！
tutorial_dialogText_2.en: To find <font color=0x932A09>ONE PIECE</font>, let's set sail for the adventure!
tutorial_dialogText_2.th: เพื่อตามหา<font color=0x932A09>ONE PIECE</font>ให้พบ เรามาก้าวไปสู่เส้นทางการผจญภัยกันเถอะ！
tutorial_dialogText_2.tw: 為了找到<font color=0x932A09>ONE PIECE</font>，讓我們踏上冒險的旅途吧！
tutorial_dialogText_2.vi: Tìm đến <font color=0x932A09>ONE PIECE</font>, cùng bước trên con đường mạo hiểm nào!
tutorial_dialogText_2.de: Um <font color=0x932A09>ONE PIECE</font> zu finden, begeben wir uns auf eine abenteuerliche Reise!
tutorial_dialogText_2.pt: Para encontrar <font color=0x932A09>ONE PIECE</font>, vamos navegar para a aventura!

tutorial_dialogText_3.cn: 冒险的途中需要伙伴！让我们去进行召唤吧！
tutorial_dialogText_3.en: You need allies for your adventure! Let's go summon them!
tutorial_dialogText_3.th: ระหว่างการผจญภัยจำเป็นต้องมีคู่หู！เรามาอัญเชิญคู่หูกันเถอะ！
tutorial_dialogText_3.tw: 冒險的途中需要夥伴！讓我們去進行召喚吧！
tutorial_dialogText_3.vi: Trên con đường thám hiểm cần có đồng hành! Hãy đi triệu hồi họ!
tutorial_dialogText_3.de: Partner ist notwendig für das Abenteuer! Gehen wir zu beschwören!
tutorial_dialogText_3.pt: Você precisa de aliados para sua aventura!  Vamos convocá-los!

tutorial_dialogText_4.cn: 让我们再进行一次 <font color=0x932A09>高级召唤</font>吧！
tutorial_dialogText_4.th: เรามา <font color=0x932A09>อัญเชิญระดับสูง</font>กันอีกครั้งเถอะ！
tutorial_dialogText_4.tw: 讓我們再進行一次 <font color=0x932A09>高級召喚</font>吧！
tutorial_dialogText_4.vi: Hãy <font color=0x932A09>Triệu Hồi-Cao</font> thêm 1 lần nữa nào!
tutorial_dialogText_4.de: Lass uns noch eine <font color=0x932A09>fortgeschrittene Beschwörung</font> machen!

tutorial_dialogText_5.cn: 有了伙伴的帮助，让我们继续冒险吧！
tutorial_dialogText_5.en: With the help of the partner, let's continue the adventure!
tutorial_dialogText_5.th: มีการช่วยเหลือจากคู่หูแล้ว เรามาผจญภัยกันต่อเถอะ！
tutorial_dialogText_5.tw: 有了夥伴的幫助，讓我們繼續冒險吧！
tutorial_dialogText_5.vi: Có đồng hành giúp đỡ rồi, chúng ta hãy tiếp tục thám hiểm nào!
tutorial_dialogText_5.de: Lass uns mit Hilfe unserer Partner Abenteuer fortsetzen!
tutorial_dialogText_5.pt: Com a ajuda do parceiro, vamos continuar a aventura!

tutorial_dialogText_6.cn: 每个伙伴擅长的 <font color=0xcb1e11>攻</font> <font color=0x932A09>防</font> <font color=0x006d08>辅</font> 定位不同，调整站位可以让战斗变得更有利！
tutorial_dialogText_6.en: Each ally has different roles and specialty, which are <font color=0xcb1e11>ATK</font> <font color=0x932A09>DEF</font> <font color=0x006d08>and Support</font>. Adjust their positioning to get the maximum advantage in battle!
tutorial_dialogText_6.th: แต่ละคู่หูจะเชี่ยวชาญ <font color=0xcb1e11>โจมตี</font> <font color=0x932A09>ป้องกัน</font> <font color=0x006d08>ช่วยเหลือ</font> ในตำแหน่งแตกต่างกัน การปรับตำแหน่งจะสามารถทำให้การต่อสู้บรรลุผลได้ดียิ่งขึ้น！
tutorial_dialogText_6.tw: 每個夥伴擅長的 <font color=0xcb1e11>攻</font> <font color=0x932A09>防</font> <font color=0x006d08>輔</font> 定位不同，調整站位可以讓戰鬥變得更有利！
tutorial_dialogText_6.vi: Mỗi đồng hành sở trường về <font color=0xcb1e11>Công</font> <font color=0x932A09>Thủ</font> <font color=0x006d08>Hỗ trợ</font> khác nhau, điều chỉnh vị trí có thể giành thắng lợi cao hơn!
tutorial_dialogText_6.de: Jeder Held ist gut in verschiedener Positionierung, <font color=0xcb1e11>Angriff</font>, <font color=0x932A09>Verteidigung</font>, <font color=0x006d08>Support</font>. Die richtige Position lässt den Kampf mehr vorteilhaft sein!
tutorial_dialogText_6.pt: Cada aliado tem papéis e especialidades diferentes, que são <font color=0xcb1e11>Ataque</font> <font color=0x932A09>Defesa</font> <font color=0x006d08>e Suporte</font>. Ajuste seu posicionamento para ganhar o máximo de vantagem na batalha!

tutorial_dialogText_7.cn: 战斗的间隙，冒险也在自动进行，来收取 <font color=0x932A09>挂机奖励</font>吧！
tutorial_dialogText_7.en: In between the battle, the adventure is still being carried out, come and claim <font color=0x932A09>Idling Rewards</font>!
tutorial_dialogText_7.th: ช่องว่างการต่อสู้ ผจญภัยจะดำเนินการอัตโนมัติ มาเก็บ <font color=0x932A09>รางวัลบอท</font>กันเถอะ！
tutorial_dialogText_7.tw: 戰鬥的間隙，冒險也在自動進行，來收取 <font color=0x932A09>掛機獎勵</font>吧！
tutorial_dialogText_7.vi: Nghỉ tay chiến đấu, Thám Hiểm cũng đang auto, đến thu thập <font color=0x932A09>thưởng treo máy</font>!
tutorial_dialogText_7.de: Während des Kampfes wird das Abenteuer auch automatisch fortgesetzt. Sammle jetzt <font color=0x932A09>AKF-Belohnungen</font>!
tutorial_dialogText_7.pt: Entre a batalha, a aventura ainda está sendo realizada, venha e colete <font color=0x932A09>recompensas do modo de suspensão </font>!

tutorial_dialogText_8.cn: 收获了资源，让我们前往 <font color=0x932A09>提升英雄</font>吧！
tutorial_dialogText_8.en: The resources have been harvested. Let's go and <font color=0x932A09>improve heroes</font>!
tutorial_dialogText_8.th: เมื่อรวบรวมทรัพยากรแล้ว เราไป <font color=0x932A09>อัพฮีโร่</font>กันเถอะ！
tutorial_dialogText_8.tw: 收穫了資源，讓我們前往 <font color=0x932A09>提升英雄</font>吧！
tutorial_dialogText_8.vi: Nhận tài nguyên rồi, hãy đến <font color=0x932A09>tăng Tướng</font>!
tutorial_dialogText_8.de: Ressourcen gesammelt. Gehen wir <font color=0x932A09>Helden upzugraden</font>!
tutorial_dialogText_8.pt: Os recursos foram coletados. Vamos <font color=0x932A09>melhorar os heróis</font>!

tutorial_dialogText_9.cn: 点击 <font color=0x932A09>一键升级</font>可以便利地操作。
tutorial_dialogText_9.en: Tap on <font color=0x932A09>Auto-upgrade</font> to complete the action.
tutorial_dialogText_9.th: กด <font color=0x932A09>อัพเวลทั้งหมด</font>จะสามารถดำเนินการโดยสะดวก
tutorial_dialogText_9.tw: 點擊 <font color=0x932A09>一鍵升級</font>可以便利地操作。
tutorial_dialogText_9.vi: Nhấp chọn <font color=0x932A09>Lên cấp ngay</font> để thao tác nhanh.
tutorial_dialogText_9.de: Tippe <font color=0x932A09>direktes Upgrade</font>, um leichter zu bedienen.
tutorial_dialogText_9.pt: Toque em <font color=0x932A09>Atualização com Um Toque</font> para concluir a ação.

tutorial_dialogText_10.cn: 点击这里能<font color=0x932A09>快速切换</font>到下一个英雄
tutorial_dialogText_10.en: Tap here to <font color=0x932A09>quickly switch</font> to the next hero
tutorial_dialogText_10.th: กดที่นี่สามารถ<font color=0x932A09>เปลี่ยนด่วน</font>ไปยังฮีโร่คนถัดไป
tutorial_dialogText_10.tw: 點擊這裡能<font color=0x932A09>快速切換</font>到下一個英雄
tutorial_dialogText_10.vi: Nhấp vào đây để <font color=0x932A09>đổi nhanh</font> đến Tướng sau
tutorial_dialogText_10.de: Tippe hier, um <font color=0x932A09>schnell</font> zum nächsten Held zu wechseln
tutorial_dialogText_10.pt: Toque aqui para <font color=0x932A09>mudar rapidamente</font> para o próximo herói

tutorial_dialogText_11.cn: 伙伴都升级了，可以去挑战更强大的敌人了！
tutorial_dialogText_11.en: Your allies have all upgraded. They can now challenge even stronger enemy!
tutorial_dialogText_11.th: คู่หูสามารถอัพเวลได้แล้ว ไปท้าดวลศัตรูที่แข็งแกร่งยิ่งกว่ากันเถอะ！
tutorial_dialogText_11.tw: 夥伴都升級了，可以去挑戰更強大的敵人了！
tutorial_dialogText_11.vi: Đồng Hành đã tăng cấp, có thể khiên chiến địch mạnh hơn!
tutorial_dialogText_11.de: Die Partner haben alle deren Level erhöht, du kannst jetzt noch mächtigere Feinde herausfordern!
tutorial_dialogText_11.pt: Todos os seus aliados foram atualizados. Eles agora podem desafiar inimigos ainda mais fortes!

tutorial_dialogText_12.cn: 我们获得了<font color=0x932A09>英雄碎片</font>，可以合成对应的英雄。
tutorial_dialogText_12.en: We have acquired <font color=0x932A09>Hero Shards</font>. You can use them to compose into the related heroes!
tutorial_dialogText_12.th: เราได้รับ<font color=0x932A09>ชิ้นส่วนฮีโร่</font>แล้ว สามารถรวมฮีโร่ที่เกี่ยวข้องได้แล้วล่ะ
tutorial_dialogText_12.tw: 我們獲得了<font color=0x932A09>英雄碎片</font>，可以合成對應的英雄。
tutorial_dialogText_12.vi: Nhận được <font color=0x932A09>Mảnh Tướng</font>,  có thể ghép thành Tướng tương ứng.
tutorial_dialogText_12.de: Wir haben <font color=0x932A09>Heldenfragment</font> erhalten, kann den entsprechenden Helden fusionieren.
tutorial_dialogText_12.pt: Ganhamos <font color=0x932A09>fragmentos de herói</font>. Você pode usá-los para compor os heróis relacionados!

tutorial_dialogText_13.cn: 刚获得了英雄，前往进行升级。
tutorial_dialogText_13.en: has just acquired heroes, go and perform upgrade.
tutorial_dialogText_13.th: ฮีโร่ที่เพิ่งได้รับมา เราไปอัพเวลกันเถอะ
tutorial_dialogText_13.tw: 剛獲得了英雄，前往進行升級。
tutorial_dialogText_13.vi: Mới nhận Tướng, mau nâng cấp.
tutorial_dialogText_13.de: Gerade einen Held erhalten, gehe ein Upgrade machen.
tutorial_dialogText_13.pt: Acabou de ganhar heróis, vá e faça a atualização.

tutorial_dialogText_14.cn: 我们获得了<font color=0x932A09>装备</font>，快进行穿戴吧！
tutorial_dialogText_14.en: We have acquired <font color=0x932A09>Gear</font>, go and equip them now!
tutorial_dialogText_14.th: เราได้รับ<font color=0x932A09>อุปกรณ์</font>แล้ว รีบไปสวมกันเถอะ！
tutorial_dialogText_14.tw: 我們獲得了<font color=0x932A09>裝備</font>，快進行穿戴吧！
tutorial_dialogText_14.vi: Nhận được <font color=0x932A09>Trang Bị</font>, mau mang vào!
tutorial_dialogText_14.de: Wir haben <font color=0x932A09>Rüstung</font> erhalten. Jetzt tragen!
tutorial_dialogText_14.pt: Ganhamos <font color=0x932A09>equipamentos</font>, vá e equipe-os agora!

tutorial_dialogText_15.cn: 穿戴的装备可以进行<font color=0x932A09>强化</font>，发挥更大的能力！
tutorial_dialogText_15.en: The equipped gear can be used for <font color=0x932A09>enhancement</font> to bring out greater power!
tutorial_dialogText_15.th: อุปกรณ์ที่สวมสามารถทำการ<font color=0x932A09>อัพเกรด</font> เพิ่มความสามารถมากยิ่งขึ้น！
tutorial_dialogText_15.tw: 穿戴的裝備可以進行<font color=0x932A09>強化</font>，發揮更大的能力！
tutorial_dialogText_15.vi: Trang bị đang mặc có thể <font color=0x932A09>cường hóa</font> để trở nên mạnh hơn!
tutorial_dialogText_15.de: Die getragene Rüstung kann <font color=0x932A09>verstärkt</font> werden, um noch mehr Kraft zu benutzen!
tutorial_dialogText_15.pt: O equipamento equipado pode ser usado para <font color=0x932A09>aprimoramento</font> para aumentar o poder!

tutorial_dialogText_16.cn: 我们获得了<font color=0x932A09>终结技碎片</font>，前往激活后就能在战斗中使用了！
tutorial_dialogText_16.en: We have acquired <font color=0x932A09>Finishing Move Shards</font>. Go activate it to use it in the battle!
tutorial_dialogText_16.th: เราได้รับ<font color=0x932A09>ชิ้นส่วนสกิลสุดท้าย</font>แล้ว หลังเปิดใช้เราจะสามารถใช้ในการต่อสู้ได้！
tutorial_dialogText_16.tw: 我們獲得了<font color=0x932A09>終結技碎片</font>，前往啟動後就能在戰鬥中使用了！
tutorial_dialogText_16.vi: Nhận được <font color=0x932A09>Mảnh Tuyệt Kỹ</font>, kích hoạt xong có thể dùng trong chiến đấu!
tutorial_dialogText_16.de: Wir haben <font color=0x932A09>ult. Fähigkeit Fragment</font> erhalten. Geh zum Aktivieren, um es im Kampf zu verwenden.
tutorial_dialogText_16.pt: Ganhamos <font color=0x932A09>fragmentos de habilidade final</font>. Vá ativá-lo para usá-lo na batalha!

tutorial_dialogText_17.cn: 点击<font color=0x932A09>一键升级</font>可以便利地操作。
tutorial_dialogText_17.en: Tap on <font color=0x932A09>Auto-upgrade</font> to complete the action.
tutorial_dialogText_17.th: กด<font color=0x932A09>อัพเวลทั้งหมด</font>จะสามารถดำเนินการโดยสะดวก
tutorial_dialogText_17.tw: 點擊<font color=0x932A09>一鍵升級</font>可以便利地操作。
tutorial_dialogText_17.vi: Nhấp chọn <font color=0x932A09>Lên cấp ngay</font> để thao tác nhanh.
tutorial_dialogText_17.de: Tippe <font color=0x932A09>direktes Upgrade</font>, um leichter zu bedienen.
tutorial_dialogText_17.pt: Toque em <font color=0x932A09> Atualização com Um Toque </font> para concluir a ação.

tutorial_dialogText_19.cn: <font color=0x932A09>能量</font>满足条件后，点击释放终结技！
tutorial_dialogText_19.en: After <font color=0x932A09>Energy</font> meets the condition, tap to unleash Finishing Move!
tutorial_dialogText_19.th: เมื่อ<font color=0x932A09>พลังงาน</font>ครบตามเงื่อนไข กดปล่อยสกิลสุดท้าย！
tutorial_dialogText_19.tw: <font color=0x932A09>能量</font>滿足條件後，點擊釋放終結技！
tutorial_dialogText_19.vi: Sau khi <font color=0x932A09>Năng Lượng</font> đạt điều kiện, nhấp tung Tuyệt Kỹ!
tutorial_dialogText_19.de: Nachdem die Anforderung für die <font color=0x932A09>Energie</font> erfüllt wurden, tippe, um die endgültige Fähigkeit zu benutzen!
tutorial_dialogText_19.pt: Depois que <font color=0x932A09>Energia</font> atender à condição, toque para lançar a habilidade final!

tutorial_dialogText_20.cn: 未知的冒险就在眼前，接下来就请勇往直前吧！
tutorial_dialogText_20.en: The unknown adventure is right in front of you, go ahead and fight bravely!
tutorial_dialogText_20.th: การผจญภัยที่ไม่มีใครรู้อยู่ตรงหน้า ต่อจากนี้เรามาเดินหน้าต่อกันเถอะ！
tutorial_dialogText_20.tw: 未知的冒險就在眼前，接下來就請勇往直前吧！
tutorial_dialogText_20.vi: Thám hiểm đang ở trước mắt, hãy dũng cảm tiến lên!
tutorial_dialogText_20.de: Das unbekannte Abenteuer ist da, also mach bitte weiter!
tutorial_dialogText_20.pt: A aventura desconhecida está bem na sua frente, vá em frente e lute bravamente!

tutorial_dialogText_21.cn: 我们还为各位船长准备了强力的伙伴，他们很快就将加入您的队伍！
tutorial_dialogText_21.en: We have prepared strong partners for you, they will join you soon!
tutorial_dialogText_21.th: เราได้จัดเตรียมคู่หูเอาไว้ให้กับกัปตันแต่ละท่าน พวกเขากำลังจะเข้าร่วมทีมของท่านแล้ว！
tutorial_dialogText_21.tw: 我們還為各位船長準備了強力的夥伴，他們很快就將加入您的隊伍！
tutorial_dialogText_21.vi: Chúng tôi còn chuẩn bị đồng hành mạnh cho các vị thuyền trưởng, họ sẽ gia nhập vào đội nhanh thôi!
tutorial_dialogText_21.de: Wir haben auch starke Partner für alle Kapitäne vorbereitet, und sie werden bald deinem Team beitreten!
tutorial_dialogText_21.pt: Preparamos parceiros fortes para você, eles se juntarão a você em breve!

tutorial_dialogText_22.cn: 对了，冒险刚开始，多看看这里的<font color=0x932A09>任务</font>能更好地提升哟！
tutorial_dialogText_22.en: Oh right, the adventure has just begun. You can check out the <font color=0x932A09>Quests</font> here to improve yourself better!
tutorial_dialogText_22.th: การผจญภัยเริ่มขึ้นแล้ว อย่าลืมมาอัพเดท<font color=0x932A09>ภารกิจ</font>ที่นี่เพื่อให้อัพเกรดตัวเองนะ！
tutorial_dialogText_22.tw: 對了，冒險剛開始，多看看這裡的<font color=0x932A09>任務</font>能更好地提升喲！
tutorial_dialogText_22.vi: Thám Hiểm vừa mới bắt đầu, hãy thường xuyên xem <font color=0x932A09>Nhiệm Vụ</font> nơi này để tăng nhanh hơn!
tutorial_dialogText_22.de: Ah ja, das Abenteuer hat erst jetzt begonnen. Sieh dir die <font color=0x932A09>Aufgaben</font> hier an, damit kann man sich schneller verbessern!
tutorial_dialogText_22.pt: Oh certo, a aventura apenas começou. Você pode conferir as <font color=0x932A09>Missões</font> aqui para melhorar ainda mais!

tutorial_dialogText_23.cn: 获得相同的英雄可以用于<font color=0x932A09>英雄觉醒</font>，觉醒将会提升资质，获得大量属性！
tutorial_dialogText_23.en: The same hero can be used for <font color=0x932A09>Hero Awakening</font>. Awakening will improve their credit, granting ample stats!
tutorial_dialogText_23.th: เมื่อได้รับฮีโร่ที่เหมือนกันสามารถใช้<font color=0x932A09>ปลุกพลังฮีโร่</font> ปลุกพลังจะสามารถเพิ่มคุณภาพได้รับสเตตัสจำนวนมาก！
tutorial_dialogText_23.tw: 獲得相同的英雄可以用於<font color=0x932A09>英雄覺醒</font>，覺醒將會提升資質，獲得大量屬性！
tutorial_dialogText_23.vi: Nhận Tướng giống nhau có thể dùng để <font color=0x932A09>Thức Tỉnh Tướng</font>, thức tỉnh tăng tư chất, nhận nhiều thuộc tính!
tutorial_dialogText_23.de: Nachdem man gleiche Helden erhalten hat, kann man die <font color=0x932A09>Helden erwecken</font>, durch das Erwecken wird die Qualität erhöht und man erhält große Mengen an Attributen!
tutorial_dialogText_23.pt: O mesmo herói pode ser usado para <font color=0x932A09>despertar de herói</font>. O despertar melhorará seu crédito, concedendo amplos atributos!

tutorial_dialogText_24.cn: <font color=0x932A09>经验副本</font>开放了，通关副本可以得到经验卡和玩家经验！
tutorial_dialogText_24.en: <font color=0x932A09>Exp Instance</font> has unlocked. Clearing instance can now grant Exp Pass and Player Exp!
tutorial_dialogText_24.th: <font color=0x932A09>ดันเจี้ยนEXP</font>เปิดแล้ว ผ่านด่านดันเจี้ยนจะได้รับบัตรEXPและEXPผู้เล่น！
tutorial_dialogText_24.tw: <font color=0x932A09>經驗副本</font>開放了，通關副本可以得到經驗卡和玩家經驗！
tutorial_dialogText_24.vi: <font color=0x932A09>PB EXP</font> đã mở, vượt ải PB được nhận Thẻ EXP và EXP người chơi!
tutorial_dialogText_24.de: Das <font color=0x932A09>Erfahrung-Dungeon</font> wurde eröffnet! Bestehe das Dungeon, um Erfahrungskarten und Spieler-EP zu erhalten!
tutorial_dialogText_24.pt: <font color=0x932A09>Instância de Experiência</font> foi desbloqueada. Passe a instância pode ganhar cartão de experiência e experiência do jogador!

tutorial_dialogText_25.cn: <font color=0x932A09>竞技场</font>开放了，与其他玩家一争高下吧！
tutorial_dialogText_25.en: <font color=0x932A09>Arena</font> has unlocked. Come and compete against other players!
tutorial_dialogText_25.th: <font color=0x932A09>อารีน่า</font>เปิดแล้ว มาต่อสู้ตัดสินกับผู้เล่นอื่นๆ กันเถอะ！
tutorial_dialogText_25.tw: <font color=0x932A09>競技場</font>開放了，與其他玩家一爭高下吧！
tutorial_dialogText_25.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Đấu Trường</font> đã mở, đã đến lúc chứng tỏ thực lực!
tutorial_dialogText_25.de: <font color=0x932A09>Arena</font> wurde eröffnet! Messe dich jetzt mit den anderen Spielern!
tutorial_dialogText_25.pt: A <font color=0x932A09>Arena</font> foi desbloqueada. Venha competir contra outros jogadores!

tutorial_dialogText_26.cn: 参与竞技场之前，需要先设置<font color=0x932A09>防守阵容</font>。
tutorial_dialogText_26.en: Before joining in Arena, you need to set up <font color=0x932A09>Defense Lineup</font> first.
tutorial_dialogText_26.th: ก่อนเข้าร่วมอารีน่า จะต้องตั้งค่า<font color=0x932A09>ค่ายตั้งรับ</font>ก่อน
tutorial_dialogText_26.tw: 參與競技場之前，需要先設置<font color=0x932A09>防守陣容</font>。
tutorial_dialogText_26.vi: Trước khi tham gia Đấu Trường, cần cài <font color=0x932A09>đội phòng thủ</font>.
tutorial_dialogText_26.de: Stelle bitte <font color=0x932A09>Verteidigungsteam</font>auf, bevor du an der Arena teilnimmst.
tutorial_dialogText_26.pt: Antes de entrar na Arena, você precisa configurar a <font color=0x932A09>Formação de Defesa</font> primeiro.

tutorial_dialogText_27.cn: 完成<font color=0x932A09>上阵英雄</font>后，点击确定阵容即可。
tutorial_dialogText_27.en: After completing <font color=0x932A09>Hero Deployment</font>, tap on confirm to confirm the lineup.
tutorial_dialogText_27.th: หลังจากเคลียร์<font color=0x932A09>ฮีโร่ที่ลงสู้</font>แล้ว เพียงแค่กดยืนยันค่ายก็พอ
tutorial_dialogText_27.tw: 完成<font color=0x932A09>上陣英雄</font>後，點擊確定陣容即可。
tutorial_dialogText_27.vi: Sau khi <font color=0x932A09>cho Tướng ra trận</font>, nhấp xác nhận đội hình.
tutorial_dialogText_27.de: Tippe nach dem <font color=0x932A09>Einsatz von Helden</font> und bestätige die Formation.
tutorial_dialogText_27.pt: Depois de concluir <font color=0x932A09>implantação de heróis</font>, toque em confirmar para confirmar a formação.

tutorial_dialogText_28.en: Tap on the enemy to challenge!
tutorial_dialogText_28.th: กดที่ศัตรูเพื่อท้าดวล！
tutorial_dialogText_28.vi: Nhấp vào kẻ địch để khiêu chiến!
tutorial_dialogText_28.de: Tippe den Feind, um zu herausfordern!

tutorial_dialogText_29.cn: <font color=0x932A09>突破副本</font>开放了，通关副本可以得到突破卡和玩家经验！
tutorial_dialogText_29.en: <font color=0x932A09>Breakthrough Instance</font> has unlocked. Clearing instance can now grant Breakthrough Pass and Player Exp!
tutorial_dialogText_29.th: <font color=0x932A09>ดันเจี้ยนทะลวง</font>เปิดแล้ว ผ่านด่านดันเจี้ยนจะได้รับการ์ดทะลวงและEXPผู้เล่น！
tutorial_dialogText_29.tw: <font color=0x932A09>突破副本</font>開放了，通關副本可以得到突破卡和玩家經驗！
tutorial_dialogText_29.vi: <font color=0x932A09>PB Đột Phá</font> đã mở, vượt ải PB được nhận Thẻ Đột Phá và EXP người chơi!
tutorial_dialogText_29.de: Das <font color=0x932A09>Durchbruch-Dungeon</font> wurde eröffnet! Bestehe das Dungeon, um Durchbruch-Karten und Spieler-EP zu erhalten!
tutorial_dialogText_29.pt: A <font color=0x932A09>Instância de Descoberta</font> foi desbloqueada. Passe a instância pode ganhar cartão de descoberta e experiência do jogador!

tutorial_dialogText_30.cn: <font color=0x932A09>深海大监狱</font>开放了，击败越来越强的敌人前往监狱最深处吧！
tutorial_dialogText_30.en: <font color=0x932A09>Impel Down</font> is unlocked. Defeat the stronger enemy to venture deep into the prison now!
tutorial_dialogText_30.th: <font color=0x932A09>คุกนรกอิมเพลดาวน์</font>เปิดแล้ว เอาชนะศัตรูที่ยิ่งแข็งแกร่งเพื่อไปยังคุกที่ลึกขึ้น！
tutorial_dialogText_30.tw: <font color=0x932A09>深海大監獄</font>開放了，擊敗越來越強的敵人前往監獄最深處吧！
tutorial_dialogText_30.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Nhà Lao Biển Sâu</font> đã mở, đánh bại kẻ địch mạnh dần để đến nơi sâu nhất!
tutorial_dialogText_30.de: <font color=0x932A09>Großes Impel Down</font> wurde eröffnet! Besiege die immer stärker werdenden Feinde in den Tiefen des Gefängnisses!
tutorial_dialogText_30.pt: <font color=0x932A09>Impel Down</font> está desbloqueado. Derrote o inimigo mais forte para se aventurar profundamente na prisão agora!

tutorial_dialogText_31.cn: <font color=0x932A09>体术</font>开放了，使用耐力卡来锻炼体术，增强属性！
tutorial_dialogText_31.en: <font color=0x932A09>Martial Arts</font> has unlocked. You can use Stamina Pass to train your martial arts to enhance the stats!
tutorial_dialogText_31.th: <font color=0x932A09>ทักษะกาย</font>เปิดแล้ว ใช้การ์ดทนทานเพื่อฝึกฝนทักษะกาย เพิ่มสเตตัสสุดแกร่ง！
tutorial_dialogText_31.tw: <font color=0x932A09>體術</font>開放了，使用耐力卡來鍛煉體術，增強屬性！
tutorial_dialogText_31.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Thể Thuật</font> đã mở, dùng Thẻ Bền Bỉ rèn luyện Thể Thuật, tăng thuộc tính!
tutorial_dialogText_31.de: <font color=0x932A09>Körperliche Kunst</font> wurde eröffnet! Benutze Ausdauer-Karten, um die Körperliche Kunst zu trainieren und die Attribute zu erhöhen!
tutorial_dialogText_31.pt: As <font color=0x932A09>artes marciais</font> foi desbloqueada. Você pode usar cartas de treinamento físico para treinar suas artes marciais para melhorar os atributos!

tutorial_dialogText_32.cn: <font color=0x932A09>长环岛冒险</font>开放了，在“残酷游戏”中获取奖励吧！
tutorial_dialogText_32.en: <font color=0x932A09>Long Ring Island Adventure</font> has unlocked. Go and earn your rewards in “Cruel Game”!
tutorial_dialogText_32.th: <font color=0x932A09>ผจญภัยเกาะลองไอส์แลนด์</font>เปิดแล้ว ไปรับรางวัลใน“เกมสุดโหด”กันเถอะ！
tutorial_dialogText_32.tw: <font color=0x932A09>長環島冒險</font>開放了，在“殘酷遊戲”中獲取獎勵吧！
tutorial_dialogText_32.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Thám Hiểm Long Island</font> đã mở, mau đoạt thưởng trong “Trò Chơi Khốc Liệt”!
tutorial_dialogText_32.de: <font color=0x932A09>Long Island</font> wurde eröffnet! Hole dir deine Belohnungen im "unbarmherzigen Spiel"!
tutorial_dialogText_32.pt: A <font color=0x932A09>Aventura das Ilhas dos Anéis</font> foi desbloqueada. Vá e ganhe suas recompensas no “Jogo Cruel”!

tutorial_dialogText_33.cn: <font color=0x932A09>超新星激斗</font>开放了，向聚集在香波地的其他玩家挑战吧！
tutorial_dialogText_33.en: <font color=0x932A09>Supernova Showdown</font> has unlocked. You can now challenge other players gathering at Sabaody!
tutorial_dialogText_33.th: <font color=0x932A09>การต่อสู้ซูเปอร์โนวา</font>เปิดแล้ว ไปสมทบกับผู้เล่นอื่นๆ ที่รวมตัวกันที่หมู่เกาะฟองสบู่เพื่อท้าดวลกันสิ！
tutorial_dialogText_33.tw: <font color=0x932A09>超新星激鬥</font>開放了，向聚集在香波地的其他玩家挑戰吧！
tutorial_dialogText_33.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Siêu Tân Tinh Chiến</font> đã mở, hãy đến Sabaody khiêu chiến những người khác!
tutorial_dialogText_33.de: <font color=0x932A09>Supernova-Kampf</font> wurde eröffnet! Bekämpfe die Spieler, die sich auf Sabaody versammelt haben!
tutorial_dialogText_33.pt: O <font color=0x932A09> Confronto Supernova </font> foi desbloqueado. Agora você pode desafiar outros jogadores reunidos em Sabaody!

tutorial_dialogText_34.cn: <font color=0x932A09>公会</font>开放了，与其他玩家组成冒险伙伴吧！
tutorial_dialogText_34.en: <font color=0x932A09>Guild</font> has unlocked. Become adventure buddies with other players now!
tutorial_dialogText_34.th: <font color=0x932A09>กิลด์</font>เปิดแล้ว รวมกลุ่มกับผู้เล่นอื่นๆ เพื่อผจญภัยกับคู่หูสิ！
tutorial_dialogText_34.tw: <font color=0x932A09>公會</font>開放了，與其他玩家組成冒險夥伴吧！
tutorial_dialogText_34.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Hạm Đội</font> đã mở, kết bạn đồng hành cùng thám hiểm!
tutorial_dialogText_34.de: <font color=0x932A09>Gilde</font> wurde eröffnet, finde jetzt andere Partner, um zusammen Abenteuer zu machen!
tutorial_dialogText_34.pt: A <font color=0x932A09>Guilda</font> foi desbloqueada. Torne-se amigo de aventura de outros jogadores agora!

tutorial_dialogText_35.cn: <font color=0x932A09>BOSS争夺战</font>开放了，与所有玩家一起争抢BOSS！
tutorial_dialogText_35.en: <font color=0x932A09>BOSS Contest</font> has unlocked! Fight for the Boss against all the other players!
tutorial_dialogText_35.th: <font color=0x932A09>สงครามชิงBOSS</font>เปิดแล้ว ร่วมมือกับผู้เล่นอื่นๆ เพื่อชิงBOSSกันเถอะ！
tutorial_dialogText_35.tw: <font color=0x932A09>BOSS爭奪戰</font>開放了，與所有玩家一起爭搶BOSS！
tutorial_dialogText_35.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Tranh Đoạt BOSS </font> đã mở, mau đến cướp BOSS với các thuyền trưởng khác!
tutorial_dialogText_35.de: <font color=0x932A09>Boss-Schlacht</font> ist jetzt geöffnet. Kämpfe mit allen Spielern um den BOSS!
tutorial_dialogText_35.pt: A <font color=0x932A09>Batalha BOSS</font> foi desbloqueada! Lute pelo BOSS contra todos os outros jogadores!

tutorial_dialogText_36.cn: <font color=0x932A09>武器</font>开放了，快前往穿戴吧！
tutorial_dialogText_36.en: <font color=0x932A09>Weapon</font> has unlocked. Go and equip them now!
tutorial_dialogText_36.th: <font color=0x932A09>อาวุธ</font>เปิดแล้ว ไปสวมกันเถอะ！
tutorial_dialogText_36.tw: <font color=0x932A09>武器</font>開放了，快前往穿戴吧！
tutorial_dialogText_36.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Vũ khí</font> đã mở, mau đeo thử!
tutorial_dialogText_36.de: <font color=0x932A09>Waffe</font> wurde eröffnet! Gehe sie jetzt ausrüsten!
tutorial_dialogText_36.pt: A <font color=0x932A09>Arma</font> foi desbloqueada. Vá e equipe-os agora!

tutorial_dialogText_37.cn: <font color=0x932A09>海上列车</font>开放了，击败CP9赢取奖励吧！
tutorial_dialogText_37.en: <font color=0x932A09>Sea Train</font> has unlocked. Defeat CP9 and earn your rewards!
tutorial_dialogText_37.th: <font color=0x932A09>รถขบวนเดินทะเล</font>เปิดแล้ว เอาชนะCP9เพื่อรับรางวัลสิ！
tutorial_dialogText_37.tw: <font color=0x932A09>海上列車</font>開放了，擊敗CP9贏取獎勵吧！
tutorial_dialogText_37.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Đoàn Tàu Trên Biển</font> đã mở, đánh bại CP9 đoạt thưởng!
tutorial_dialogText_37.de: <font color=0x932A09>Seezug</font> wurde eröffnet! Besiege CP9, um reichhaltige Belohnungen zu erhalten!
tutorial_dialogText_37.pt: O <font color=0x932A09>Trem do Mar</font> foi desbloqueado. Derrote o CP9 e ganhe suas recompensas!

tutorial_dialogText_38.cn: <font color=0x932A09>锻造石副本</font>开放了，通关副本可以得到锻造石和玩家经验！
tutorial_dialogText_38.en: <font color=0x932A09>Forge Stone Instance</font> has unlocked. Clearing instance can now grant Forge Stone and Player Exp!
tutorial_dialogText_38.th: <font color=0x932A09>ดันเจี้ยนหินหลอมสร้าง</font>เปิดแล้ว ผ่านด่านดันเจี้ยนจะได้รับหินหลอมสร้างและEXPผู้เล่น！
tutorial_dialogText_38.tw: <font color=0x932A09>鍛造石副本</font>開放了，通關副本可以得到鍛造石和玩家經驗！
tutorial_dialogText_38.vi: <font color=0x932A09>PB Đá Rèn</font> đã mở, vượt ải PB được nhận Đá Rèn và EXP người chơi!
tutorial_dialogText_38.de: <font color=0x932A09>Schmiedestein-Dungeon</font> wurde eröffnet! Bestehe das Dungeon, um Schmiedesteine und Spieler-EP zu erhalten!
tutorial_dialogText_38.pt: A <font color=0x932A09> Instância de Pedras de Forja </font> foi desbloqueado. Passe a instância pode ganhar pedra de forja e experiência do jogador!

tutorial_dialogText_39.cn: <font color=0x932A09>装备副本</font>开放了，通关副本可以得到装备和玩家经验！
tutorial_dialogText_39.en: <font color=0x932A09>Gear Instance</font> has unlocked. Clearing instance can now grant Breakthrough Pass and Player Exp!
tutorial_dialogText_39.th: <font color=0x932A09>ดันเจี้ยนอุปกรณ์</font>เปิดแล้ว ผ่านด่านดันเจี้ยนจะได้รับอุปกรณ์และEXPผู้เล่น！
tutorial_dialogText_39.tw: <font color=0x932A09>裝備副本</font>開放了，通關副本可以得到裝備和玩家經驗！
tutorial_dialogText_39.vi: <font color=0x932A09>PB Trang Bị</font> đã mở, vượt ải phụ bản nhận trang bị và EXP người chơi!
tutorial_dialogText_39.de: Das <font color=0x932A09>Rüstung-Dungeon</font> wurde eröffnet! Bestehe das Dungeon, um Rüstungen und Spieler-EP zu erhalten!
tutorial_dialogText_39.pt: A <font color=0x932A09>Instância de Equipamentos</font> foi desbloqueada. Passe a instância pode ganhar equipamentos e experiência do jogador!

tutorial_dialogText_40.cn: <font color=0x932A09>永久指针</font>开放了，快前往激活吧！
tutorial_dialogText_40.en: <font color=0x932A09>Permanent Compass</font> has unlocked. Go and activate them now!
tutorial_dialogText_40.th: <font color=0x932A09>เข็มทิศถาวร</font>เปิดแล้ว รีบไปเปิดใช้เร็วเข้า！
tutorial_dialogText_40.tw: <font color=0x932A09>永久指針</font>開放了，快前往啟動吧！
tutorial_dialogText_40.vi: <font color=0x932A09>La Bàn Vĩnh Viễn</font> đã mở, mau đi kích hoạt!
tutorial_dialogText_40.de: <font color=0x932A09>Ewiger Zeiger</font> wurde eröffnet! Gehe es aktivieren!
tutorial_dialogText_40.pt: A <font color=0x932A09>bússola permanente</font> foi desbloqueada. Vá e ative agora!

tutorial_dialogText_41.cn: <font color=0x932A09>航海大冒险</font>开放了，在海上搜寻各种宝物吧！
tutorial_dialogText_41.en: <font color=0x932A09>Voyage Adventure</font> has unlocked. Go and search fro various treasures!
tutorial_dialogText_41.th: <font color=0x932A09>เดินเรือผจญภัยครั้งใหญ่</font>เปิดแล้ว ไปค้นหาสมบัติต่างๆ ในทะเลกันเถอะ！
tutorial_dialogText_41.tw: <font color=0x932A09>航海大冒險</font>開放了，在海上搜尋各種寶物吧！
tutorial_dialogText_41.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Thám Hiểm Hàng Hải</font> đã mở, hãy tìm các bảo vật biển!
tutorial_dialogText_41.de: <font color=0x932A09>Seereise</font> wurde eröffnet! Gehe auf See, um nach den Schätzen zu suchen!
tutorial_dialogText_41.pt: A <font color=0x932A09>Aventura da Grande Navegação</font> foi desbloqueada. Vá e procure vários tesouros!

tutorial_dialogText_43.cn: <font color=0x932A09>空岛竞速</font>开放了，与其他玩家竞赛吧！
tutorial_dialogText_43.en: <font color=0x932A09>Skypiea Race</font> has unlocked. Go and race against other players!
tutorial_dialogText_43.th: <font color=0x932A09>ดวลความเร็วเกาะท้องฟ้า</font>เปิดแล้ว ไปประลองกับผู้เล่นอื่นๆ กันเถอะ！
tutorial_dialogText_43.tw: <font color=0x932A09>空島競速</font>開放了，與其他玩家競賽吧！
tutorial_dialogText_43.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Đua Tốc Độ Đảo Trời</font> đã mở, cùng so tài với người chơi khác!
tutorial_dialogText_43.de: <font color=0x932A09>Skypiea-Rennen</font> wurde eröffnet! Kämpfe gegen andere Spieler!
tutorial_dialogText_43.pt: A <font color=0x932A09>Corrida em Skypiea</font> foi desbloqueada. Vá e corra contra outros jogadores!

tutorial_dialogText_46.cn: <font color=0x932A09>空贝</font>开放了，快前往穿戴吧！
tutorial_dialogText_46.en: <font color=0x932A09>Dial</font> has unlocked. Go and equip them now!
tutorial_dialogText_46.th: <font color=0x932A09>ไดอัล</font>เปิดแล้ว รีบไปสวมเร็วเข้า！
tutorial_dialogText_46.tw: <font color=0x932A09>空貝</font>開放了，快前往穿戴吧！
tutorial_dialogText_46.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Vỏ Sò</font> đã mở, mau đến mang thử!
tutorial_dialogText_46.de: <font color=0x932A09>Himmelsschale</font>wurde eröffnet! Gehe sie jetzt ausrüsten!
tutorial_dialogText_46.pt: A <font color=0x932A09>concha</font> foi desbloqueada. Vá e equipe-a agora!

tutorial_dialogText_47.cn: <font color=0x932A09>空贝副本</font>开放了，通关副本可以得到空贝和玩家经验！
tutorial_dialogText_47.en: <font color=0x932A09>Dial Instance</font> has unlocked. Clearing instance can now grant Dials and Player Exp!
tutorial_dialogText_47.th: <font color=0x932A09>ดันเจี้ยนไดอัล</font>เปิดแล้ว ผ่านด่านดันเจี้ยนจะได้รับไดอัลและEXPผู้เล่น！
tutorial_dialogText_47.tw: <font color=0x932A09>空貝副本</font>開放了，通關副本可以得到空貝和玩家經驗！
tutorial_dialogText_47.vi: <font color=0x932A09>PB Vỏ Sò</font> đã mở, vượt ải PB nhận Vỏ Sò và EXP người chơi!
tutorial_dialogText_47.de: Das <font color=0x932A09>Himmelsschale-Dungeon</font> wurde eröffnet! Bestehe das Dungeon, um Himmelsschalen und Spieler-EP zu erhalten!
tutorial_dialogText_47.pt: A <font color=0x932A09>instância de concha</font> foi desbloqueada. Passe a instância pode ganhar conchas e experiência do jogador!

tutorial_dialogText_48.cn: <font color=0x932A09>晶粉副本</font>开放了，通关副本可以得到晶粉和玩家经验！
tutorial_dialogText_48.en: <font color=0x932A09>Crystal Dust Instance</font> has unlocked. Clearing instance can now grant Crystal Dust and Player Exp!
tutorial_dialogText_48.th: <font color=0x932A09>ดันเจี้ยนผงคริสตัล</font>เปิดแล้ว ผ่านด่านดันเจี้ยนจะได้รับผงคริสตัลและEXPผู้เล่น！
tutorial_dialogText_48.tw: <font color=0x932A09>晶粉副本</font>開放了，通關副本可以得到晶粉和玩家經驗！
tutorial_dialogText_48.vi: <font color=0x932A09>PB Tinh Hoa</font> đã mở, vượt ải phụ bản nhận Tinh Hoa và EXP người chơi!
tutorial_dialogText_48.de: Das <font color=0x932A09>Kristallpulver-Dungeon</font> wurde eröffnet! Bestehe das Dungeon, um Kristallpulver und Spieler-EP zu erhalten!
tutorial_dialogText_48.pt: A <font color=0x932A09>instância de pó de cristal</font> foi desbloqueada. Passe a instância pode ganhar pó de cristal e experiência do jogador!

tutorial_dialogText_49.cn: <font color=0x932A09>强敌来袭</font>开放了，与全服的玩家一同进行挑战，获得丰厚奖励吧！
tutorial_dialogText_49.en: <font color=0x932A09>Enemy Incoming</font> is unlocked, the players from the whole server will challenge together to get ample rewards!
tutorial_dialogText_49.th: <font color=0x932A09>ศัตรูแกร่งบุก</font>เปิดแล้ว ร่วมท้าดวลกับผู้เล่นทั้งเซิร์ฟ รับของรางวัลมากมาย！
tutorial_dialogText_49.tw: <font color=0x932A09>強敵來襲</font>開放了，與全服的玩家一同進行挑戰，獲得豐厚獎勵吧！
tutorial_dialogText_49.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Cường Địch Tập Kích</font> đã mở, khiêu chiến người chơi toàn SV, nhận thưởng hậu hĩnh!
tutorial_dialogText_49.de: <font color=0x932A09>Ankunft der Mächtigen</font> wurde eröffnet! Kämpfe mit allen Spielern des Servers, um reichhaltige Belohnungen zu erhalten!
tutorial_dialogText_49.pt: O <font color=0x932A09>Assalto Intenso</font> está desbloqueado, os jogadores de todo o servidor irão desafiar juntos para ganhar amplas recompensas!

tutorial_dialogText_50.cn: <font color=0x932A09>委托</font>开放了，设置英雄执行委托，挂机收取丰厚战利品！
tutorial_dialogText_50.en: <font color=0x932A09>job System</font> has unlocked! Set a hero to complete the job, idling to get ample trophy!
tutorial_dialogText_50.th: <font color=0x932A09>ไหว้วาน</font>เปิดแล้ว  ตั้งค่าให้ฮีโร่ทำภารกิจไหว้วาน บอทรับรางวัลโทฟรี่สงครามมากมาย！
tutorial_dialogText_50.tw: <font color=0x932A09>委託</font>開放了，設置英雄執行委託，掛機收取豐厚戰利品！
tutorial_dialogText_50.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Ủy Thác</font> đã mở, cài Tướng thi hành Ủy Thác, treo máy lấy chiến lợi phẩm!
tutorial_dialogText_50.de: <font color=0x932A09>Auftrag</font> wurde eröffnet! Stelle Helden für die Aufgaben ein, und erhalte reichhaltige AFK-Beute!
tutorial_dialogText_50.pt: O <font color=0x932A09>sistema de trabalho</font> foi desbloqueado! Defina um herói para concluir o trabalho, os prêmios do modo de suspensão são muito grandes!

tutorial_dialogText_51.cn: <font color=0x932A09>恐怖三桅帆</font>开放了，在魔幻三角地带的岛屿中探索寻宝吧！
tutorial_dialogText_51.en: <font color=0x932A09>Thriller Bark</font> has unlocked. Go and explore for your treasures in the magical triangular territory!
tutorial_dialogText_51.th: <font color=0x932A09>ทริลเลอร์บาร์ค</font>เปิดแล้ว ไปหาสมบัติภายในหมู่เกาะสามเหลี่ยมเวทมนตร์กันเถอะ！
tutorial_dialogText_51.tw: <font color=0x932A09>恐怖三桅帆</font>開放了，在魔幻三角地帶的島嶼中探索尋寶吧！
tutorial_dialogText_51.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Thuyền Thriller</font> đã mở, đến hòn đảo trên Tam giác Florian thăm dò nào!
tutorial_dialogText_51.de: <font color=0x932A09>Schreckliche Barke</font> wurde eröffnet! Suche auf den Inseln des magischen Dreiecks nach den Schätzen!
tutorial_dialogText_51.pt: <font color=0x932A09>Thriller Bark</font> foi desbloqueado. Vá e explore seus tesouros no território triangular mágico!

tutorial_dialogText_52.cn: 同时仅能上阵5个英雄，已培养的英雄可以通过<font color=0x932A09>重生</font>返还资源。
tutorial_dialogText_52.en: You can only deploy 5 heroes at the same time. The developed hero can return the resources through <font color=0x932A09>Rebirth</font>.
tutorial_dialogText_52.th: ในเวลาเดียวกันสามารถส่งฮีโร่ได้เพียง5รายเท่านั้น ฮีโร่ที่พัฒนาแล้วสามารถใช้<font color=0x932A09>รีบอร์น</font>เพื่อคืนทรัพยากรที่ใช้ไป
tutorial_dialogText_52.tw: 同時僅能上陣5個英雄，已培養的英雄可以通過<font color=0x932A09>重生</font>返還資源。
tutorial_dialogText_52.vi: Chỉ được ra trận 5 Tướng cùng lúc, Tướng đã bồi dưỡng có thể thông qua <font color=0x932A09>trùng sinh</font> để hoàn trả tài nguyên.
tutorial_dialogText_52.de: Es können nur 5 Helden gleichzeitig eingesetzt werden, und die trainierten Helden können durch <font color=0x932A09>Wiedergeburt</font> Ressourcen zurückgeben.
tutorial_dialogText_52.pt: Você só pode implantar 5 heróis ao mesmo tempo. O herói desenvolvido pode devolver os recursos através de <font color=0x932A09>Renascimento</font>.

tutorial_dialogText_53.th: กดตรงนี้เข้าสู่แท่นบูชา
tutorial_dialogText_53.de: Tippe hier, um den Altar zu betreten
tutorial_dialogText_53.pt: Clique aqui para entrar na batalha!

tutorial_dialogText_54.cn: 有英雄阵亡了，点击这里进行复活
tutorial_dialogText_54.en: Some heroes are eliminated. Tap here to perform a revival
tutorial_dialogText_54.th: มีฮีโร่ตาย กดที่นี่เพื่อคืนชีพ
tutorial_dialogText_54.tw: 有英雄陣亡了，點擊這裡進行復活
tutorial_dialogText_54.vi: Có tướng tử vong rồi, nhấp vào đây để hồi sinh
tutorial_dialogText_54.de: Held gestorben. Klicke hier, um wiederzubeleben
tutorial_dialogText_54.pt: Um herói morreu, clique aqui para reviver

tutorial_dialogText_55.cn: <font color=0x932A09>全知之树</font>开放了，收集历史石碑抽取英雄！
tutorial_dialogText_55.en: <font color=0x932A09>Tree of Knowledge</font> has unlocked. Gather Historic Stele to draw heroes!
tutorial_dialogText_55.th: <font color=0x932A09>ต้นไม้แห่งความรอบรู้</font>เปิดแล้ว รวบรวมแผ่นศิลาประวัติศาสตร์จับรับฮีโร่！
tutorial_dialogText_55.tw: <font color=0x932A09>全知之樹</font>開放了，收集歷史石碑抽取英雄！
tutorial_dialogText_55.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Cây Tri Thức</font> đã mở, thu thập Poneglyph Lịch Sử lấy Tướng!
tutorial_dialogText_55.de: <font color=0x932A09>Historische Stele</font> wurde eröffnet! Sammle historische Stelen, um Helden zu ziehen!
tutorial_dialogText_55.pt: <font color=0x932A09>A Árvore da Onisciência</font> está aberta, colete estelas históricas para sortear heróis!

tutorial_dialogText_56.cn: 收集<font color=0x932A09>历史石碑</font>，可以获得任选SR或任选SSR
tutorial_dialogText_56.en: Gather <font color=0x932A09>Historic Stele</font> to gain SR or SSR
tutorial_dialogText_56.th: รวบรวม<font color=0x932A09>แผ่นศิลาประวัติศาสตร์</font> จะได้รับSRหรือSSRเลือกเอง
tutorial_dialogText_56.tw: 收集<font color=0x932A09>歷史石碑</font>，可以獲得任選SR或任選SSR
tutorial_dialogText_56.vi: Thu thập <font color=0x932A09>Poneglyph Lịch Sử</font>, có thể nhận SR (Chọn) hoặc SSR (Chọn)
tutorial_dialogText_56.de: Sammle <font color=0x932A09>historische Stele</font>, um optionalen SR oder SSR zu erhalten
tutorial_dialogText_56.pt: Colete <font color=0x932A09>estela histórica</font> para ganhar SR opcional ou SSR selecionável

tutorial_dialogText_57.cn: <font color=0x932A09>霸气</font>开放了，选择合适的霸气，增强属性！
tutorial_dialogText_57.en: <font color=0x932A09>Haki</font> is available. Pick the correct Haki to boost your stats!
tutorial_dialogText_57.th: <font color=0x932A09>ฮาคิ</font>เปิดแล้ว เลือกฮาคิที่เหมาะสมเพิ่มเสริมสเตตัสให้แข็งแกร่ง！
tutorial_dialogText_57.tw: <font color=0x932A09>霸氣</font>開放了，選擇合適的霸氣，增強屬性！
tutorial_dialogText_57.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Haki</font> đã mở, chọn Haki phù hợp, tăng thuộc tính!
tutorial_dialogText_57.de: <font color=0x932A09>Haki</font> wurde eröffnet! Wähle das passende Haki, um die Attribute zu erhöhen!
tutorial_dialogText_57.pt: <font color=0x932A09>Haki</font> está aberta, escolha a Haki apropriada para aprimorar os atributos!

tutorial_dialogText_58.cn: <font color=0x932A09>霸气修炼室</font>开放了，获取霸气材料强化霸气技能吧！
tutorial_dialogText_58.en: <font color=0x932A09>Haki Training Room</font> is available. Acquire the Haki materials to enhance the Haki skill now!
tutorial_dialogText_58.th: <font color=0x932A09>ห้องฝึกฝนพลัง</font>เปิดแล้ว รับวัสดุฮาคิเพื่ออัพเกรดสกิลฮาคิสิ！
tutorial_dialogText_58.tw: <font color=0x932A09>霸氣修煉室</font>開放了，獲取霸氣材料強化霸氣技能吧！
tutorial_dialogText_58.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Phòng Luyện Haki</font> đã mở, nhận Vật Liệu Haki cường hóa Skill Haki nào!
tutorial_dialogText_58.de: <font color=0x932A09>Haki-Trainingsraum</font> wurde eröffnet! Erhalte das Haki-Material, um die Haki-Fähigkeiten zu verstärken!
tutorial_dialogText_58.pt: <font color=0x932A09>A Sala de Treinamento de Haki </font> está aberta, ganhe materiais de Haki para fortalecer as habilidades Haki!

tutorial_dialogText_59.cn: <font color=0x932A09>英雄共鸣</font>开放了，SR以上英雄可以通过共鸣直接提升战斗力！
tutorial_dialogText_59.en: <font color=0x932A09>Hero Resonance</font> is available. The SR or above heroes may increase the power through resonance!
tutorial_dialogText_59.th: <font color=0x932A09>ประสานฮีโร่</font>เปิดแล้ว ฮีโร่SRขึ้นไปจะสามารถใช้การประสานเพิ่มพลังต่อสู้ทันที！
tutorial_dialogText_59.tw: <font color=0x932A09>英雄共鳴</font>開放了，SR以上英雄可以通過共鳴直接提升戰鬥力！
tutorial_dialogText_59.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Cộng Hưởng Tướng</font> đã mở, Tướng SR trở lên có thể thông qua Cộng Hưởng tăng lực chiến!
tutorial_dialogText_59.de: <font color=0x932A09>Heldenresonanz</font> wurde eröffnet! Helden über SR können jetzt direkt durch die Resonanz ihre Kampfkraft  erhöhen!
tutorial_dialogText_59.pt: <font color=0x932A09>Ressonância de Herói</font> está aberto, os heróis acima de SR podem melhorar diretamente seu poder de batalha através da ressonância!

tutorial_dialogText_60.cn: <font color=0x932A09>挂机up</font>开放了，通关深海大监狱获得“海盗船”，提升挂机效率，获得更多的道具！
tutorial_dialogText_60.en: <font color=0x932A09>Idling Up</font> is available. Clear the Impel Down to gain "Pirate Ship". Increasing idling efficiency to gain more items!
tutorial_dialogText_60.th: <font color=0x932A09>บอท UP</font>เปิดแล้ว จากคุกนรกอิมเพลดาวน์ได้รับ“เรือโจรสลัด” เพิ่มอัตราการบอท ได้รับไอเทมมากยิ่งขึ้น！
tutorial_dialogText_60.tw: <font color=0x932A09>掛機up</font>開放了，通關深海大監獄獲得“海盜船”，提升掛機效率，獲得更多的道具！
tutorial_dialogText_60.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Treo Máy UP</font> đã mở, vượt ải Nhà Lao Biển Sâu nhận “Tàu Hải Tặc”, tăng hiệu suất treo máy, nhận nhiều đồ hơn!
tutorial_dialogText_60.de: <font color=0x932A09>AFK UP</font> wurde eröffnet! Bestehe Großes Impel Down und erhalte ein "Piratenschiff", um die AKF-Effizienz zu erhöhen und mehr Gegenstände zu erhalten!
tutorial_dialogText_60.pt: <font color=0x932A09>Modo de Suspensão</font> está aberto, limpe a Impel Down para ganhar um “navio pirata”, melhore a eficiência do modo de suspensão e ganhe mais itens!

tutorial_dialogText_61.cn: 现在前往上阵界面装备终结技吧！
tutorial_dialogText_61.en: Go to deployment page to equip the Finishing Move now!
tutorial_dialogText_61.th: ขณะนี้ไปยังหน้าลงสู้เพื่อติดตั้งสกิลสุดท้ายเถอะ！
tutorial_dialogText_61.tw: 現在前往上陣介面裝備終結技吧！
tutorial_dialogText_61.vi: Đến giao diện ra trận trang bị Tuyệt Kỹ nào!
tutorial_dialogText_61.de: Gehe jetzt zur Formationsseite, um die ult. Fähigkeit auszurüsten!
tutorial_dialogText_61.pt: Agora vá para a interface de batalha para equipar as habilidades finais!

tutorial_dialogText_62.cn: <font color=0x932A09>庞克实验室</font>开放了，达到资质要求后可以挑战守军获得丰厚的奖励！
tutorial_dialogText_62.en: <font color=0x932A09>Vegapunk's Lab</font> has unlocked. You can now challenge guardians to gain ample rewards after your Credit reached the requirements!
tutorial_dialogText_62.th: <font color=0x932A09>ห้องทดลองพังค์</font>เปิดแล้ว​ เมื่อบรรลุ​เงื่อนไข​คุณสมบัติสามารถ​ท้าดวลทหารยามเพื่อรับรางวัล​จำนวนมากได้！
tutorial_dialogText_62.tw: <font color=0x932A09>龐克實驗室</font>開放了，達到資質要求後可以挑戰守軍獲得豐厚的獎勵！
tutorial_dialogText_62.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Phòng Thí Nghiệm Punk</font> đã mở, tư chất đạt yêu cầu có thể khiêu chiến quân phòng thủ nhận thưởng!
tutorial_dialogText_62.de: <font color=0x932A09>Punk Labor</font> wurde eröffnet! Nachdem die Anforderungen der Qualität erfüllt wurden, kann man die Verteidiger angreifen, um reichhaltige Belohnungen zu erhalten!
tutorial_dialogText_62.pt: <font color=0x932A09>Laboratório de Vegapunk</font> está aberto. Depois de atingir os requisitos de qualificação, você pode desafiar os defensores para ganhar recompensas valiosas!

tutorial_dialogText_63.cn: <font color=0x932A09>赏金事件</font>开放了，完成随机事件获得生命卡等稀有奖励！
tutorial_dialogText_63.en: The <font color=0x932A09>Bounty Event</font> is available. Complete the random events to gain Vivre card and other rare rewards!
tutorial_dialogText_63.th: <font color=0x932A09>เรื่องราวค่าหัว</font>เปิดแล้ว บรรลุเรื่องราวสุ่มได้รับรางวัลหายากเช่นบัตรHP！
tutorial_dialogText_63.tw: <font color=0x932A09>賞金事件</font>開放了，完成隨機事件獲得生命卡等稀有獎勵！
tutorial_dialogText_63.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Sự kiện Treo Thưởng</font> đã mở, hoàn thành sự kiện ngẫu nhiên nhận thưởng quý như Thẻ Sinh Mệnh!
tutorial_dialogText_63.de: <font color=0x932A09>Kopfgeldhandlung</font> wurde eröffnet! Beende zufällige Handlungen, um Lebenskatzen und andere seltene Belohnungen zu erhalten!
tutorial_dialogText_63.pt: <font color=0x932A09>eventos de recompensa</font> desbloqueado, conclua eventos aleatórios para ganhar recompensas raras, como Vrive Cards!

tutorial_dialogText_64.cn: <font color=0x932A09>个人团本</font>开放了，参与团本挑战，获得丰厚奖励吧！
tutorial_dialogText_64.en: <font color=0x932A09>Personal Team Instance</font> is available. Join the team instance challenge to win ample rewards now!
tutorial_dialogText_64.th: <font color=0x932A09>ดันเจี้ยนกลุ่มบุคคล</font>เปิดแล้ว เข้าร่วมท้าดวลดันเจี้ยนกลุ่ม รับรางวัลจำนวนมาก！
tutorial_dialogText_64.tw: <font color=0x932A09>個人團本</font>開放了，參與團本挑戰，獲得豐厚獎勵吧！
tutorial_dialogText_64.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Binh Đoàn Cá Nhân</font> đã mở, khiêu chiến nhận thưởng hậu hĩnh!
tutorial_dialogText_64.de: <font color=0x932A09>Persönliche Gruppenmission</font> wurde eröffnet! Nehme an der Gruppenmission teil, um reichhaltige Belohnungen zu erhaten!
tutorial_dialogText_64.pt: <font color=0x932A09>Instância de equipe pessoal</font> está disponível. Junte-se ao desafio de instância de equipe para ganhar grandes recompensas agora!

tutorial_dialogText_65.cn: <font color=0x932A09>装备升红</font>开放了，获取你的红色装备吧！
tutorial_dialogText_65.en: <font color=0x932A09>Gear Deification</font> is available. It’s time to claim your deified gear!
tutorial_dialogText_65.th: <font color=0x932A09>อัพเลเวลอุปกรณ์เป็นสีแดง</font>เปิดแล้ว รับอุปกรณ์สีแดงของคุณสิ!
tutorial_dialogText_65.tw: <font color=0x932A09>裝備升紅</font>開放了，獲取你的紅色裝備吧！
tutorial_dialogText_65.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Trang Bị Thần Hóa</font> đã mở, hãy nhận trang bị nào!
tutorial_dialogText_65.de: <font color=0x932A09>Rote Rüstung</font> wird freigeschaltet. Erhalte deine rote Rüstungen!
tutorial_dialogText_65.pt: <font color=0x932A09>Deificação da Equipamento</font> foi desbloqueado, pegue seu equipamento vermelho agora!

tutorial_dialogText_66.cn: 恭喜获得<font color=0x932A09>头像框</font>，快去装备华丽的头像框吧
tutorial_dialogText_66.en: Congratulations on obtaining the <font color=0x932A09>Portrait Frame</font>. Go and try on your gorgeous Portrait Frame!
tutorial_dialogText_66.th: ยินดีด้วยได้รับ<font color=0x932A09>กรอบรูปโปรไฟล์</font> รีบไปสวมใส่กรอบรูปโปรไฟล์ที่งดงามเถอะ
tutorial_dialogText_66.tw: 恭喜獲得<font color=0x932A09>頭像框</font>，快去裝備華麗的頭像框吧
tutorial_dialogText_66.vi: Chúc mừng nhận được <font color=0x932A09>khung avatar</font>, mau trang bị nào
tutorial_dialogText_66.pt: Parabéns por ganhar a<font color=0x932A09>Moldura de Avatar</font>. Experimente sua linda moldura de avatar!

tutorial_dialogText_67.cn: <font color=0x932A09>关注</font>队友，可以在小地图上看到队友的位置哟
tutorial_dialogText_67.en: <font color=0x932A09>Following</font> teammate allows you to see the teammate's location on the mini-map
tutorial_dialogText_67.th: <font color=0x932A09>ติดตาม</font>เพื่อนร่วมทีม สามารถมองเห็นตำแหน่งของเพื่อนร่วมทีมในแผนที่เล็กได้นะ
tutorial_dialogText_67.tw: <font color=0x932A09>關注</font>隊友，可以在小地圖上看到隊友的位置喲
tutorial_dialogText_67.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Theo dõi</font> đồng đội, có thể xem vị trí đồng đội trên map nhỏ
tutorial_dialogText_67.de: <font color=0x932A09>Folge</font> deine Teamkollegen, und du kannst ihren Standort auf der Minikarte sehen
tutorial_dialogText_67.pt: <font color=0x932A09>seguir</font> aliado de equipe permite que você veja a localização do aliado de equipe no minimapa

tutorial_dialogText_68.cn: 这里可以选择关注的队友,最多能关注五位队友
tutorial_dialogText_68.en: You can select the teammate to follow here, and you can follow up to 5 teammates
tutorial_dialogText_68.th: ที่นี่สามารถเลือกติดตามเพื่อนร่วมทีมได้ ติดตามเพื่อนร่วมทีมได้สูงสุด5คน
tutorial_dialogText_68.tw: 這裡可以選擇關注的隊友,最多能關注五位隊友
tutorial_dialogText_68.vi: Có thể chọn theo dõi đồng đội, tối đa 5 người
tutorial_dialogText_68.de: Hier kannst du die Teamkollegen zu folgen auswählen, bis zu fünf Teamkollegen können gefolgt werden
tutorial_dialogText_68.pt: Você pode selecionar o aliado de equipe para seguir aqui e pode seguir até 5 aliados de equipe

tutorial_dialogText_69.cn: 关注的队友会在小地图上显示哟！
tutorial_dialogText_69.en: The followed teammate will be shown on the mini-map!
tutorial_dialogText_69.th: เพื่อนร่วมทีมที่ติดตามจะแสดงในแผนที่เล็กนะ！
tutorial_dialogText_69.tw: 關注的隊友會在小地圖上顯示喲！
tutorial_dialogText_69.vi: Đồng đội được theo dõi sẽ hiển thị trên map nhỏ!
tutorial_dialogText_69.de: Gefolgte Teamkollegen werden auf der Minikarte angezeigt!
tutorial_dialogText_69.pt: O aliado de equipe seguido será mostrado no minimapa!

tutorial_dialogText_70.cn: 遇见队友后，可以将自己的道具和积分<font color=0x932A09>赠送</font>给队友
tutorial_dialogText_70.en: After seeing your teammate, you can <font color=0x932A09>gift</font> your items and points to your teammate
tutorial_dialogText_70.th: หลังจากพบเพื่อนร่วมทีมแล้ว สามารถนำไอเทมและคะแนนของตัวเองไป<font color=0x932A09>มอบ</font>ให้กับเพื่อนร่วมทีมได้
tutorial_dialogText_70.tw: 遇見隊友後，可以將自己的道具和積分<font color=0x932A09>贈送</font>給隊友
tutorial_dialogText_70.vi: Sau khi gặp đồng đội có thể tặng <font color=0x932A09>tặng</font> đạo cụ và tích điểm cho đồng đội
tutorial_dialogText_70.de: Wenn du deine Teamkollegen getroffen hast, kannst du deinen Teamkollegen Gegenstände und Punkte <font color=0x932A09>geben</font>
tutorial_dialogText_70.pt: Depois de ver seu aliado de equipe, você pode <font color=0x932A09>presentear</font> seus itens e pontos para seu aliado de equipe

tutorial_dialogText_71.cn: 可以选择道具赠送给队友，每个队友一天只能赠送一个道具
tutorial_dialogText_71.en: You can choose to gift the item to your teammate. Each teammate can only gift one item daily
tutorial_dialogText_71.th: สามารถเลือกไอเทมไปมอบให้กับเพื่อนร่วมทีมได้ แต่ละวันจะมอบไอเทมให้เพื่อนร่วมทีมแต่ละคนได้เพียง1ชิ้น
tutorial_dialogText_71.tw: 可以選擇道具贈送給隊友，每個隊友一天只能贈送一個道具
tutorial_dialogText_71.vi: Có thể chọn đạo cụ tặng cho đồng đội, mỗi ngày mỗi đồng đội chỉ được tặng 1 đạo cụ
tutorial_dialogText_71.de: Kann Gegenstände zu geben auswählen, kann jeder Teamkollege nur einen Gegenstand pro Tag geben
tutorial_dialogText_71.pt: Você pode optar por presentear o item para seu aliado de equipe. Cada aliado de equipe só pode presentear um item diariamente

tutorial_dialogText_72.cn: 这里可以将积分赠送给队友，积分赠送不限次数
tutorial_dialogText_72.en: You can gift the points to your teammate, and the point gifting has no attempts limit
tutorial_dialogText_72.th: ที่นี่สามารถนนำคะแนนไปมอบให้กับเพื่อนร่วมทีมได้ มอบคะแนนไม่จำกัดจำนวนครั้ง
tutorial_dialogText_72.tw: 這裡可以將積分贈送給隊友，積分贈送不限次數
tutorial_dialogText_72.vi: Có thể tặng tích điểm cho đồng đội, không giới hạn số lần
tutorial_dialogText_72.de: Hier kannst du den Teamkollegen Punkte geben, kein Limit
tutorial_dialogText_72.pt: Você pode presentear os pontos para seu aliado de equipe, e o presente de pontos não tem limite de vezes

tutorial_dialogText_73.cn: <font color=0x932A09>无限监狱</font>开放了，完成指定的条件并通关，获得丰厚奖励！！
tutorial_dialogText_73.en: <font color=0x932A09>Endless Prison</font> is available. You can complete a specific condition and clear the stage to obtain ample rewards! !
tutorial_dialogText_73.th: <font color=0x932A09>คุกอินฟินิตี้</font>เปิดแล้ว บรรลุเงื่อนไขที่กำหนดและผ่านด่านสำเร็จ จะได้รับรางวัลมากมาย！！
tutorial_dialogText_73.tw: <font color=0x932A09>無限監獄</font>開放了，完成指定的條件並通關，獲得豐厚獎勵！！
tutorial_dialogText_73.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Nhà Lao Vô Tận</font> đã mở, hoàn thành điều kiện vượt ải nhận thuởng nào!
tutorial_dialogText_73.de: Das <font color=0x932A09>Unendliche Gefängnis</font> hat geöffnet. Erfülle Bedingungen und bestehe Levels zum Erhalt von üppigen Belohnungen!!
tutorial_dialogText_73.pt: <font color=0x932A09>Prisão Infinita</font> está disponível. Você pode completar uma condição específica e passar a fase para ganhar grandes recompensas!!

tutorial_dialogText_74.cn: <font color=0x932A09>药剂制作</font>开放了，可以消耗材料制作药剂，材料可通过SSS实验室及无限监狱产出！
tutorial_dialogText_74.en: <font color=0x932A09>Potion Crafting</font> is available. You can now spend materials to craft potions. The materials can be obtained through SSS Lab and Endless Prison!
tutorial_dialogText_74.th: <font color=0x932A09>ผลิตยา</font>เปิดแล้ว สามารถใช้วัตถุดิบผลิตยาได้ วัตถุดิบสามารถผลิตได้จากห้องทดลองSSSและคุกอินฟินิตี้！
tutorial_dialogText_74.tw: <font color=0x932A09>藥劑製作</font>開放了，可以消耗材料製作藥劑，材料可通過SSS實驗室及無限監獄產出！
tutorial_dialogText_74.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Điều chế thuốc</font> đã mở, có thể tiêu vật liệu Điều chế thuốc, nhận vật liệu trong Phòng Thí Nghiệm SSS và Nhà Lao Vô Tận!
tutorial_dialogText_74.de: <font color=0x932A09>Medizin Herstellung</font> hat geöffnet. Verbrauche Materialien zur Herstellung von Medizin. Material kann durch SSS Labor und Unendliches Gefängnis erhalten werden!
tutorial_dialogText_74.pt: <font color=0x932A09>Criação de Poções</font> está disponível. Agora você pode gastar materiais para criar poções. Os materiais podem ser obtidos através do Laboratório SSS e Criação de Poções!

tutorial_dialogText_75.cn: 可通过更改药剂制作倾向提升不同药剂的产出概率，熟练度越高提升的概率越高。
tutorial_dialogText_75.en: You can change the potion yield chance of different potions by changing their creative direction. Higher proficiency grants a higher chance.
tutorial_dialogText_75.th: สามารถเพิ่มอัตราผลิตยาที่แตกต่างกันได้จากการเปลี่ยนแนวโน้มการผลิตยา ความชำนาญยิ่งสูง อัตราที่เพิ่มจะยิ่งมาก
tutorial_dialogText_75.tw: 可通過更改藥劑製作傾向提升不同藥劑的產出概率，熟練度越高提升的概率越高。
tutorial_dialogText_75.vi: Có thể thay đổi hướng điều chế thuốc để tăng tỷ lệ sản sinh các loại thuốc khác nhau, Độ Thành Thạo càng cao tỷ lệ tăng càng cao.
tutorial_dialogText_75.de: Durch Änderung der Medizin Herstellung Präferenz kann die Herstellungsrate unterschiedlicher Medizin erhöht werden. Je höher die Kompetenz desto mehr kann die Rate erhöht werden.
tutorial_dialogText_75.pt: Você pode alterar a chance de rendimento da poção de diferentes poções, alterando sua direção criativa. Maior proficiência concede uma chance maior.

tutorial_dialogText_76.cn: <font color=0x932A09>天赋</font>开放了，可使用药剂提升战斗力。
tutorial_dialogText_76.en: <font color=0x932A09>Talent</font> is unlocked, you can use potion to raise the power.
tutorial_dialogText_76.th: <font color=0x932A09>พรสวรรค์</font>เปิดแล้ว สามารถใช้ยาเพิ่มพลังต่อสู้ได้
tutorial_dialogText_76.tw: <font color=0x932A09>天賦</font>開放了，可使用藥劑提升戰鬥力。
tutorial_dialogText_76.vi: <font color=0x932A09>Thiên Phú</font> đã mở, có thể dùng thuốc tăng lực chiến.
tutorial_dialogText_76.de: <font color=0x932A09>Talent</font> hat geöffnet. Es kann Medizin zur Erhöhung der Kampfkraft verwendet werden.
tutorial_dialogText_76.pt: <font color=0x932A09>Talento</font> desbloqueado, você pode usar a poção para aumentar o poder de batalha.

tutorial_dialogText_302.cn: 欢迎来到海贼王的世界！大海贼时代来临了，无数人都冲向了大海。
tutorial_dialogText_302.en: Welcome to the world of One Piece! The great time of Pirates have come. Countless people rushed towards the ocean.
tutorial_dialogText_302.th: ยินดีต้อนรับสู่โลกของราชาโจรสลัด！ยุคแห่งโจรสลัดผู้ยิ่งใหญ่มาถึงแล้ว คนนับไม่ถ้วนต่างมุ่งหน้าสู่ท้องทะเล
tutorial_dialogText_302.tw: 歡迎來到海賊王的世界！大海賊時代來臨了，無數人都沖向了大海。
tutorial_dialogText_302.vi: Chào mừng đến với thế giới Vua Hải Tặc! Thời đại Hải Tặc đã đến, người người đổ xô ra biển lớn.
tutorial_dialogText_302.de: Willkommen in der Welt von One Piece! Die Zeit der Piraten ist gekommen, alle haben sich auf den Weg in die Meere gemacht.
tutorial_dialogText_302.pt: Bem-vindo ao mundo de One Piece! A grande época dos piratas chegou. Incontáveis pessoas correram em direção ao oceano.

tutorial_dialogText_303.cn: 玩家可使用对应药剂增加英雄的攻击、生命属性。
tutorial_dialogText_303.en: The player can use the corresponding potion to raise the hero's ATK or HP stats.
tutorial_dialogText_303.th: ผู้เล่นสามารถใช้ยาที่สอดคล้องในการเพิ่มสเตตัสโจมตี、HPให้กับฮีโร่
tutorial_dialogText_303.tw: 玩家可使用對應藥劑增加英雄的攻擊、生命屬性。
tutorial_dialogText_303.vi: Người chơi có thể dùng thuốc để tăng thuộc tính Công, HP cho Tướng.
tutorial_dialogText_303.de: Spieler kann entsprechende Medizin verwenden zur Erhöhung der ANG, LP Attribute der Helden.
tutorial_dialogText_303.pt: O jogador pode usar a poção correspondente para aumentar os atributos de ataque ou vida do herói.

tutorial_dialogText_304.cn: 当左右节点都激活时可点亮中间的奖励节点，获得属性点奖励。
tutorial_dialogText_304.en: When both left and right nodes are activated, you can activate the reward node in the middle, gaining stats points as rewards.
tutorial_dialogText_304.th: เมื่อเปิดใช้งานจุดต่อทั้งซ้ายและขวาแล้ว จะสามารถจุดประกายจุดต่อรางวัลที่อยู่ตรงกลาง เพื่อรับรางวัลแต้มสเตตัสได้
tutorial_dialogText_304.tw: 當左右節點都啟動時可點亮中間的獎勵節點，獲得屬性點獎勵。
tutorial_dialogText_304.vi: Khi nút bên trái phải đều được kích hoạt sẽ được thắp sáng nút thưởng chính giữa, nhận điểm thuộc tính.
tutorial_dialogText_304.de: Wenn Knotenpunkte links und recht aktiviert sind, kann Belohnungspunkt in der Mitte erleuchtet werden und Attributpunkte Belohnung erhalten werden.
tutorial_dialogText_304.pt: Quando os nós esquerdo e direito são ativados, você pode ativar o nó de recompensa no meio, ganhando pontos de atributos como recompensa.

tutorial_dialogText_305.cn: 玩家可对获得的属性点自由分配。
tutorial_dialogText_305.en: The player can freely assign the acquired stats points.
tutorial_dialogText_305.th: ผู้เล่นสามารถแบ่งแต้มสเตตัสที่ได้รับได้อย่างอิสระ
tutorial_dialogText_305.tw: 玩家可對獲得的屬性點自由分配。
tutorial_dialogText_305.vi: Có thể tự do cộng điểm thuộc tính
tutorial_dialogText_305.de: Spieler können erhaltene Attributspunkte selbst verteilen.
tutorial_dialogText_305.pt: O jogador pode atribuir livremente os pontos de atributos adquiridos.

tutorial_dialogText_306.cn: <font color=0x932A09>武器升红</font>开放了，获取你的红色武器吧！
